title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.


Key job responsibilities
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:

• You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
• You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
• You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
• You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
• You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews


A day in the life
As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:
• Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
• Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
• Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
• Work on rotational shift-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
• Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
• This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.


About the team
About AWS

descriptionHtml:

title: Associate Security Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security, APJC Customer Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an Associate Secure AI Solution Architect to join our APJC Customer Security team. Customers across the region are moving fast on AI and need guidance on building securely. The patterns and frameworks that answer their questions exist — but they don't reach the field at scale without someone who owns the packaging, the events, the community, and the enablement. That's you.

Your primary mandate is the scale engine: the webinars, community events, enablement series, and builder circles that build Secure AI skills across the field, and the packaging of reference patterns into content a Solutions Architect or partner can pick up and use without a specialist in the room. You own this end to end — logistics, scheduling, content readiness, delivery, and follow-up.

Alongside the scale work, you get real keyboard time. You help build and test prototypes and reference implementations in sandbox environments, learning the AWS AI and security services (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) and modern development tooling as you go. You take well-scoped pieces of work through to done with guidance, and grow toward owning harder problems independently over time.

This is a role for someone early in their career who is genuinely excited by security and AI, learns fast, loves helping others succeed, and wants to build a deep technical foundation in one of the most important areas in the industry.

Key job responsibilities
Organise and run the channels that build Secure AI skills at scale — webinars, community events, enablement series, and builder circles — owning end-to-end coordination across multiple areas and time zones.
Package reference patterns and frameworks into field-ready enablement — briefings, guides, and workshop kits — that a Solutions Architect or partner can pick up and use without a specialist in the room.
Grow a community of practice around Secure AI, keeping content current and accessible so skills build consistently across the field and customers.
Track reach, engagement, and field adoption of the content and events you run, and share what you learn so the next round is sharper.
Get hands-on keyboard time building and testing prototypes and reference implementations in sandbox environments — learning the AWS AI and security services and modern development tooling as you go.
Take well-scoped, straightforward pieces of technical work through to done with guidance — learning the Secure AI control patterns (agent identity, prompt-injection defense, AI development lifecycle controls, guardrails, governance evidence) as you contribute to them.
Grow your technical depth and judgment over time, building toward owning harder problems independently.

A day in the life
You start the morning in a sandbox, helping build out and test part of an agentic-identity reference pattern. You pick up a well-scoped piece — wiring up and validating one of the guardrail configurations — and take it to done, learning how the whole pattern fits together as you go.

Mid-morning you switch to the scale side of the role: you are running a webinar next week that brings a new pattern to the field, so you finalise the run-sheet, line up the presenter, and send the invites across the areas. You also tidy a workshop kit so any field Solutions Architect can deliver the session themselves.

After lunch you turn a reference architecture that was just published into a crisp enablement guide and a short briefing a Solutions Architect can take straight into a customer conversation. You check in with a builder-circle community you help run and clear a couple of small blockers for the organisers.

You close the day looking at how the last community event landed — who joined, what resonated, which content got reused — and share a short read-out with the team. No two days look the same, but the thread is consistent: you are learning to build, and making sure what the team builds reaches everyone

About the team
APJC Customer Security helps customers across the region adopt AI on AWS with confidence — ensuring security, risk, and regulation accelerate AI adoption rather than slow it down. We run two coupled programmes: Secure AI (making AWS the best place to build securely with AI) and AI for Security (using AI to help customers defend themselves). As an Associate Secure AI Solution Architect, you own the enablement and community engine that helps the whole programme scale. You will have a clear development path, a peer community to learn from, and the chance to build a deep technical foundation in one of the most important areas in the industry.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
- Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
- Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

title: Windows Systems Engineer, Region Services Corporate Infrastructure (Vector) Team
descriptionHtml:
Region Services Corporate Infrastructure (RSCI) delivers foundational Windows infrastructure services across Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) environments supporting U.S. Government customers. Our team owns Active Directory, DFS, DHCP, DNS, Enterprise Configuration Manager (ECM), and Group Policy - services that every other team in the environment depends on.

We are looking for a Windows Systems Engineer who knows Windows infrastructure and is ready to transform how we manage it. Our direction is Infrastructure as Code - we need someone who can support production services today while building the automation that eliminates manual operations tomorrow. You don't need to be a deep expert in every service we own, but you need to be comfortable operating across all of them and confident enough to codify their configuration and deployment.

This is a hands-on role. You will support and maintain critical Windows services, build Ansible-based automation to manage them at scale, troubleshoot complex cross-service issues, and drive operational improvements that make our services more reliable and our team more efficient.


This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Support and maintain Windows infrastructure services across multiple isolated ADC environments: Active Directory, DFS, DHCP, DNS, ECM, and Group Policy

- Troubleshoot and resolve service issues across the Windows infrastructure stack, providing escalation support for Tier 1/2 teams

- Migrate existing manual operational processes to code-defined, repeatable automation

- Define and monitor service health metrics; build and maintain alarming that enables proactive response

- Ensure services meet security compliance and hardening requirements in partnership with the Security Compliance team

- Create and maintain operational documentation including runbooks, architecture diagrams, and standard operating procedures

- Participate in on-call rotation for service-impacting events

We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
 
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
 
Work/Life Balance

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

About the team
We are dedicated to supporting our new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

descriptionHtml:
Own the network and device technology infrastructure strategy for Amazon's fastest-growing Quick Commerce operation across an entire country. As the single-threaded infrastructure owner, you'll define the technology roadmap, drive vendor relationships, and enable hundreds of sites to launch at unprecedented speed while maintaining enterprise-grade availability and cost optimization.

Key job responsibilities
As an TIPM with the Network and Assets for Nimble Operations (NANO) Team you will:
- Define country-level infrastructure strategy by establishing architecture standards and readiness criteria that guide all site launches, ensuring consistency and quality across the fleet
- Own end-to-end network infrastructure scope from vendor selection through service level agreement governance to financial outcome management, driving performance and cost efficiency
- Identify and recommend end-user equipment (associate-facing devices such as scanners, workstations, and printers) that meet regional cost and performance targets, partnering with device technology teams for certification

You own the network and device technology infrastructure of Quick Commerce — the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores. Your day moves between defining regional network strategy that scales from hundreds to thousands of sites, steering technology capability investments toward fleet-scale readiness, evaluating transitions that deliver cost reduction compared to traditional models, and presenting infrastructure roadmaps to senior business operations leadership. You make architecture and vendor selections that determine availability, cost trajectory, and launch velocity for an entire geography.

We are the Network and Assets for Nimble Operations (NANO) team within Operations Infrastructure Services. title: Senior ML Kernel Performance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon builds Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium.

The Acceleration Kernel Library team is at the forefront of maximizing performance for Amazon's custom ML accelerators. Working at the hardware-software boundary, our engineers craft high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every FLOP counts in delivering optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

The Amazon Neuron SDK, developed by the Annapurna Labs team at Amazon, is the backbone for accelerating deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon's Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators. This comprehensive toolkit includes an ML compiler, runtime, and application framework that seamlessly integrates with popular ML frameworks like PyTorch, enabling unparalleled ML inference and training performance.

As part of the broader Neuron Compiler organization, our team works across multiple technology layers - from frameworks and compilers to runtime and collectives. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, working closely with customers to enable their models and ensure optimal performance. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology

This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge products at the intersection of machine-learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures. You will architect and implement business-critical features, publish cutting-edge research, and mentor a brilliant team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on Amazon's ML accelerators.

Explore the product and our history!
https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-guide/neuron-cc/index.html
https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk
https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success


Key job responsibilities
Our kernel engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. In this role, you will:

* Design and implement high-performance compute kernels for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models
* Analyze and optimize kernel-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks
* Implement compiler optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling
* Work directly with customers to enable and optimize their ML models on AWS accelerators
* Collaborate across teams to develop innovative kernel optimization techniques



A day in the life
As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects. You’ll also:

Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.

Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.

Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.

Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- * Expertise in accelerator architectures for ML or HPC such as GPUs, CPUs, FPGAs, or custom architectures
- * Experience with GPU kernel optimization and GPGPU computing such as CUDA, NKI, Triton, OpenCL, SYCL, or ROCm
- * Demonstrated experience with NVIDIA PTX and/or AMD GPU ISA
- * Experience developing high performance libraries for HPC applications
- * Proficiency in low-level performance optimization for GPUs
- * Experience with LLVM/MLIR backend development for GPUs
- * Knowledge of ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and their GPU backends
- * Experience with parallel programming and optimization techniques
- * Understanding of GPU memory hierarchies and optimization strategies

title: Buyer, Vendor Management, Sports / スポーツ＆アウトドア事業部 商品戦略部 バイヤー
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Japan / Sports & Outdoors 事業部について
Amazonは「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業」をビジョンに掲げ、日本では2000年から事業を展開しています。Sports & Outdoors事業部は、チームスポーツ・アウトドア レジャー・釣り・サイクリング・フィットネス・ゴルフなど幅広いカテゴリーを管掌し、お客様のアクティブなライフスタイルを支えています。このポジションでは、事業部が取り扱うチームスポーツに関連するカテゴリー(野球・バレーボール・バスケットボール・サッカー・卓球等)を担当いただくことを想定しており、担当カテゴリーにおいて、取引先メーカーとAmazonユニークなお客様バリューをJBP(Joint Business Planning)に落とし込み、日々の実行を通じてカテゴリービジネスを継続的に改善・成長させます。
また、担当カテゴリーの品揃えの拡大、売上・利益の最大化を目指し、事業責任者およびシニアバイヤーの方針の下で、成長戦略に基づく施策の立案と成果実現を担い、お客様の利便性と満足度の向上や効率的なオペレーションを追求することで、担当カテゴリーのビジネスを新たな成長ステージに乗せる役割を担います。(カテゴリーは変更となる可能性があるので面接時にご確認ください)
このポジションは、成果達成のために、社内の各職種(ウェブコンサルタント、マーケティング担当、広告担当、購買担当など)と協力しながら、成長戦略に基づく最適なアクションプランを策定し、最適な商品仕入れ・販売促進プロモーション・広告/宣伝を企画し提案し実行します。担当チームの一員として、上記業務を効率的に完遂し、高いパフォーマンスを提供することが求められています。
なお、当ポジションでは、生成AIおよび社内で提供される各種AIツールを日常業務で積極的に活用し、分析・資料作成・意思決定の質とスピードを高めることが求められます。


【職務内容詳細】
1. 担当カテゴリーの売上・利益目標の設定と実行・実現
予算作成・実行プロセスに責任をもち、社内外の関係者からの情報を踏まえて担当カテゴリーの売上・利益目標を設定し、その実行を推進します。

2. 販売データ・市場動向の分析と、それに基づく販売戦略・品揃え拡大の立案、実施、改善
販売データ・市場動向分析を行い、担当カテゴリーの販売戦略および品揃え拡大計画を立案し、それを実行するとともに、必要に応じた改善を行います。

3. 最適な仕入れ先の選定・開拓と、仕入れ条件の最適化
担当カテゴリーにおける仕入れ先の開拓・選定に関して分析を行い、最適な仕入れ計画を立案し、それを実行します。

4. 取引先メーカーとのパートナーシップの確立・維持
ディストリビューター/メーカーの経営層・マネジメント層とのトップエンゲージメントを通じて、担当カテゴリーの中長期的な成長に資する強力なパートナーシップを確立・維持し、JBPをはじめとする戦略的な合意形成を推進します。

5. カテゴリーレベルのプロモーション戦略の推進
担当カテゴリー全体の販売促進・マーケティング戦略を立案し、社内マーケティング/広告部門およびメーカーとの協働を通じて、大型セールイベントや重点販促施策など、カテゴリー全体に影響するプロモーションを推進します。

6. 社内関連部署との連携
社内関連部署（在庫管理担当者、ウェブ制作担当者、出品者事業担当者、およびマーケティング部門など）と密接に連携し、効率化と高質化を目指しながら上記の各業務を遂行します。

7. プロジェクトへの参画
担当カテゴリーおよび事業部全体に関わるプロジェクトに参画し、メンバーとして実績を残します。

8. AI活用による業務推進
生成AIおよび社内AIツール(社内で承認された各種AIアシスタント・分析ツール等)を日常業務に取り入れ、以下を実現します。
- 販売データ・市場動向分析、資料作成、メール・議事録などの定型業務の効率化
- 交渉準備・提案書作成におけるドラフト生成と品質向上
- 業務プロセスの再設計とチーム内での活用ノウハウ共有
なお、社内のセキュリティ・情報開示ポリシーおよびAI利用ガイドラインを遵守した上で活用することが前提です。


■求められる知識・スキル
- 実行・行動力：目標達成への強いコミットメントをもち、全社的な視点で状況を的確に判断し、優先順位を明確にしながら機動的に行動できる。
- 論理的思考・分析力：ロジカルに考え、自らの仮説に基づき、市場領域動向や販売データの的確な分析・検証を迅速に行うことができる。
- 問題解決力：市場領域動向・販売動向を素早く的確にとらえ、社内外の関係者・関連部署と協働し、リスクをとった複雑な問題解決にあたることができる。
- 企画・立案力：常に改善と創造の意識を持ち、効率と高質を目指した企画・立案ができる。他社などのベストプラクティスをもとに、新たな観点での戦略構築に関わる企画・立案ができる。特に、担当カテゴリー全体の販売促進戦略や成長施策を構想し、実行に落とし込むことができる。
- 交渉力：取引先との信頼関係を構築し、複雑な状況下においても有用情報を引き出しながら相手の立場・状況・ニーズを理解し、中長期的な視点に立った折衝・交渉を成功裏に行うことができる。特に、経営視点に立ったWin-Winの関係構築と、メーカー経営層・マネジメント層とのトップエンゲージメントを通じたJBP合意形成ができることを期待。
- コミュニケーション力：対外的な折衝に加えて、社内外のシニアマネジメント層および多様な社内機能（マーケティング、広告、在庫管理、ウェブ制作、出品者事業等）と円滑なコミュニケーションができる。
- AI活用力：生成AIおよび社内で承認されたAIツールを実務で使いこなし、分析・資料作成・意思決定の質とスピードを高めるために活用できる、または高い学習意欲をもって活用に取り組める。※社内のセキュリティ・情報開示ポリシー、AI利用ガイドラインを遵守した上で活用すること。
- PCスキル：Excel（VLOOKUP等の関数操作を含む）、Word/PowerPointによる文書作成スキル
- 日本語力：日本語でのビジネスコミュニケーション能力（必須）


【ダイバーシティ・ワークライフバランスの取り組みについて】
Amazonでは、家族と過ごす時間や、趣味に没頭するなど充実したプライベートの時間を大事にすることは、常にInnovativeであり続けるためにとても重要なことと考えます。
Amazon ライフ＆レジャー事業本部では、出産、育児、介護など、様々なライフステージイベントなどに合わせ、社員が自由な勤務体系を選択できる環境が整備されており、多くの社員がこうした制度を活用しながら活躍しています。

・フレックスタイム制度：
Amazonでは社員ひとりひとりの業務量やライフスタイルに合わせて、メリハリのある働き方を推進します。フレックスタイム制もそのひとつです。
効率的な時間の使い方やワークライフバランスの実現のために多くの社員が利用しています。

・ワークフロムホ－ム制度：
Amazonでは仕事と育児・介護・看護などプライベートの両立、集中できる環境の確保などを通じたメリハリある働き方の促進を目的として、一定の範囲内でワークフロムホーム（自宅等での就業）が認められています。

産休・育休の取得は勿論のこと、出産後の育児短時間勤務などを活用した自由な勤務体系が選択できます。
また、Amazonでは新しい家族を迎える社員が安心して子育てができ、育児休業から職場への復帰がより円滑にできるよう、育児支援プログラムとして『ファミリーボーナス』『慣らし勤務プログラム』を導入しています。
このプログラムの導入により女性だけではなく、男性の育児参加を促進し安心して働ける環境を提供しています。

・介護休業、介護短時間勤務：

title: Facilities Service Coodinator, 施設管理部
descriptionHtml:
当ポジションの勤務地は愛知県名古屋市です。

Amazonは、何百万もの商品をお客様のもとへ届け続けることで、世界的に高い認知を得たグローバルリーディングカンパニーです。
その物流を最前線で支える物流拠点がフルフィルメントセンター（以下FC）であり、そのFCを「安全・快適・効率的」に保ち続けるのが、私たちRME-Facilities（施設管理）チームです。
快適な現場も、雰囲気の良いオフィスも、みんなが楽しみにするイベントも、あなたが整える施設の一つひとつが、Amazonで働く一人ひとりの毎日を支えています。

**あなたの仕事で、数千人の「働く」が変わる。**
施設管理の専門経験は問いません。 Amazonの施設に興味があり、働く人のために動くのが好きな方であれば大歓迎です。
建物・設備の知識は、先輩のサポートを受けながら現場で少しずつ身につけていけます。
本ポジションは、FCで働くすべての人を"カスタマー"と捉え、魅力的で働きやすい職場づくりを推進する役割になります。

主な業務
はじめは先輩と一緒に、慣れてきたら少しずつ任される範囲を広げていきます。
■働く環境と人を支える仕事
オフィス環境の整備 — レイアウト変更や快適な職場づくりなど、従業員が気持ちよく働ける環境を整えます。
備品・消耗品の管理と購買・請求書処理 — 必要なものが不足しないよう手配し、日々の購買・請求書処理を進めます。
売店・Cafeteriaの運営管理 — 従業員満足度の向上に向けて、食堂運営会社と協力してサービスレベルの維持・改善に取り組みます。
従業員向けイベントの企画・運営 — FCで働く人が楽しめるイベントを自ら企画・運営します。自分が企画したイベントで従業員が笑顔になる瞬間に立ち会えることも、このポジションならではのやりがいです。
社内外の窓口・調整 — ベンダーや業者、行政などとの窓口を担い、必要な調整を進めます。
■建物・設備を守る仕事
施設の維持管理 — 建築・電気・空調・衛生・消火・昇降設備といった建物全体のインフラについて、点検結果の確認や修繕の手配・発注を行い、倉庫の安定稼働を支えます。
省エネルギー活動 — エネルギー使用量のデータをもとに、照明のLED化や空調運転スケジュールの見直しなどを進め、環境負荷の低減とコスト削減の両立を目指します。
廃棄物・リサイクル管理 — FC内で発生する産業廃棄物やリサイクル品の回収・分別を、安全・品質・生産性の観点で管理・改善します。マニフェスト管理や行政報告など、法令に沿った手続きも担います。

**このポジションの魅力**
幅広い経験がキャリアの土台になる — 建物・設備・環境・総務・イベント企画まで、施設に関わることを幅広く経験できます。特定分野に偏らない経験は、この先どんなキャリアにも活きる強みになります。
若手でも「任される」 — 発注者側の立場で、業者やベンダーへの依頼・調整を自分で進めていきます。指示を待つのではなく、自分で考えて動ける環境です（最初は先輩がしっかりサポートします）。
カスタマーの声がダイレクトに届く — 「美味しい食事が食べられて快適に働ける」「オフィスの雰囲気が良くなった」といったポジティブな声を、すぐそばで直接受け取れます。
AI・生成AIを日常業務に — Amazonでは最新のAIツールや生成AIを日々の業務に取り入れています。学習を継続する文化が根付いており、ご自身のペースでAIや施設管理の知識を深められるリソースが用意されています。

こんな方を歓迎します
- 施設管理の仕事に興味がある方
- 人と関わり、誰かのために動くことにやりがいを感じる方
- 新しい知識を学ぶことに前向きで、自分で考えて行動できる方
- チームや職場全体のために、情報を共有しサポートし合える方

Key job responsibilities
Amazonの業務は数値で管理されています。キーとなる数値目標がセットされ、業務の改善を通してパフォーマンスを引き上げていくことがミッションです。
たとえば電気使用量や社員食堂の満足度には数値目標があり、電気は節電、社員食堂はメニュー改善、廃棄物はリサイクル率の向上などを、各協力会社とともに進めて目標達成を目指します。

A day in the life
1日は朝礼から始まります。朝礼後はチーム別に分かれて当日の業務内容を確認し、メールチェックや現場巡回を行います。
ランチはカフェtリアや売店を利用し、あわせてサービスレベルもチェックします。会議は1日に1〜2件ほど、サプライヤーとの定例会議が中心で、主に業務進捗の報告を受けます。
困ったときは先輩やチームに相談しながら進められます。

メンバーは多くの場合、1 FCあたり1〜2名が配属されています。少人数だからこそ幅広い業務を経験でき、成長のスピードが速い環境です。
全国各地のメンバーが一斉に集まる定例オンライン会議が毎週あり、成功事例の共有や困りごとの相談ができます。

title: InStore Experience (ISX) Partner Coach, Reverse Logistic Services (RLS), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS)
descriptionHtml:
Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In Germany, we deliver that experience across a large network of partner and carrier locations, through convenience-led options such as Label-Free, Box-Free (LFBF) drop-off and every other way a customer can return an item in-store.

The ISX Partner Coach, Germany owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the territory of the German network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next — and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest.

This role is grounded in field execution. Alongside coaching individual sites, you will help deploy the network-wide improvements that lift the German network as a whole: in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will feed what you learn in the field back into these programs, work with internal teams to roll them out in Germany, and surface local insight that helps improve the broader EU standards — turning on-the-ground observation into lasting improvement.

This is also a founding, build-from-scratch role. You'll be one of the first ISX Partner Coaches in Germany and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet — you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with drive, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus on the work that matters most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape.

Key job responsibilities
Deliver the in-store returns experience across your assigned German territory, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable across all return types.

Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience.

Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere — use performance data to find the locations and partners falling furthest behind and focus where you improve the customer experience most.

Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: speed of service, processing reliability, customer satisfaction, and site readiness.

Deploy network-wide improvements. Support the rollout of scalable programs — in-store signage and wayfinding, supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns-processing tools — adapting them for local sites.

Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow-up cycle for underperforming sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail, Transportation for carriers) when issues need escalation.

Help build the foundation. As a founding team member, contribute to how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, and feed your field insights into monthly ISX reporting.

A day in the life
Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns Amazon's returns journey end-to-end — everything after a customer decides to send something back, until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, across one of retail's largest reverse-logistics networks.

Within RLS, the In-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world — the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build mechanisms that lift the whole network.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in German
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in operations, field operations, retail or logistics
- Experience using data to prioritize where to focus across a multi-site, distributed, or partner environment
- Willingness to travel frequently within Germany and to work hands-on in an operational store/drop-off environment

Preferred qualifications

- In-store retail operations, field operations, retail, logistics, or program management experience
- Experience in reverse logistics, returns, last-mile, or third-party partner/carrier operations, ideally in the EU
- Experience contributing to new programs, teams, or country operations (founding-member or early-team experience)
- Experience deploying or supporting operational programs across a partner network, beyond single-site execution
- Familiarity with field auditing, coaching, and structured performance-management cycles
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent operational experience
- Experience coaching, influencing, or holding others accountable without direct authority
- Comfort operating independently in an ambiguous, build-from-scratch environment, prioritizing the highest-impact work without a fully defined playbook

title: Facility Operations Center (FOC) Engineer, Facility Operations Center
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive on solving real-time problems that keep critical infrastructure running? As an Operations Technology II engineer within the Facility Operations Center (FOC), you will remotely monitor data center power and cooling systems across the globe, acting as the first line of response when alarms fire. Your analysis and quick decision-making directly protect the availability of AWS Data Centers and the millions of customers who depend on them. If you enjoy working with complex mechanical and electrical systems in a fast-paced environment and want to grow your technical expertise, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Analyze alarm monitoring systems in real time, identify abnormal conditions, and execute established escalation processes to protect data center availability.
- Review work requests submitted by field technicians for compliance with safety and operational standards, ensuring work is authorized before execution.
- Create, document, and track incident tickets while coordinating with onsite data center teams to drive timely resolution.
- Troubleshoot moderate-to-high-complexity issues across mechanical, electrical, and fire-protection systems using technical documentation, prints, and operational dashboards.
- Provide process-improvement feedback to site leadership based on operating experience, and assist in developing updated maintenance procedures.

A day in the life
Your shift begins with a handoff briefing and a review of active alarms and open tickets from the prior watch. Throughout the day you monitor dashboards covering power, cooling, and fire-protection systems, triaging alerts and coordinating remotely with onsite engineers. Between alarm events you review incoming work requests for compliance, document findings, and collaborate with teammates to refine response procedures. The FOC operates on a follow-the-sun model, so your fixed daytime schedule supports 24/7 coverage without overnight shifts.

About the team
The Facility Operations Center is the command center for AWS Data Center operations, providing continuous global monitoring 24/7/365 through a follow-the-sun model. Our work is guided by three pillars: Safety, Security, and Availability. We are an inclusive team that values collaboration, clear communication, and a shared commitment to keeping AWS infrastructure reliable for customers worldwide. If you want to make a tangible impact on cloud reliability at a global scale, the FOC is the place to do it.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience
- Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration
- Experience in data center engineering
- Experience in relevant work

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of data center engineering experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

title: Senior Manufacturing Design Engineer, QxAME
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, Amazon Echo and Amazon Show. The Amazon Devices group delivers delightfully unique Amazon experiences, giving customers instant access to everything, digital or physical.
We disrupt manufacturing with latest technological solutions while digitizing assembly and now we are taking it to the next level.

Key job responsibilities
As an Senior MDE Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and implementing DFMA good practices to the design of our product. You will be a key member of the development team and will be the main interface between the Hardware and Product Design Engineering teams with local and Offshore Operations teams within Lab126 and our OEM partners. In this role, you will:


- Work with design engineering to identify and escalate manufacturing challenges by enforcing DFM, DFA and DFS principles

- Investigate and introduce new manufacturing technology and methodology to enhance product quality and production efficiency

- Develop manufacturing process at the ODM, including defining fixture requirements, critical dimensions on parts and critical requirements in assembly

- Drive all factory-related operational issues related to final assembly processes during pre-production builds; ensure effective closure to enable operational success of the new product introduction cycle, and put products into mass production

- Identify and develop assembly jig and fixture for new products

- Work within Operations, Hardware, and Product Design engineering departments to implement and optimize manufacturing 1st pass yields and efficiency from prototype through product ramp

- Bridge the gap from OEM to Lab126 by supporting development builds and production

- Support cost reduction and sustaining activities


A day in the life
In a dynamic environment collaboratively executing design reviews, making plans with instructions on how the assembly will be achieved in a well architected manufacturing environment.

About the team
Highly skilled individuals working collaboratively to solve complex issues and coming up with new ways to improve the overall product design to delight our customers.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Experience in mechanical assembly, including Tolerance Analysis and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)
- Experience in mechanical metrology, including OMM, Displacement Lasers, Accelerometers, Confocal Microscopy, and other inspection equipment.
- Experience in process characterization and validation using statistical tools such as SPC, GR&R, Cp/Cpk, Design of Experiments.
- Experience with design for manufacturability, design for automation, and creating process documentation from scratch
- Experience with assembly jig and fixture design
- Experience working with International OEM Partners

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Ability to work independently and ensure timely and accurate communication between the Lab126 and our OEM partners
- Good understanding of manufacturing strategy and DFMA best practices
- Experienced with CAD, CREO preferred
- Experience with Statistical Analysis Software, Minitab, JMP, MATLAB, etc.
- Experience in Mechanical FEA, Abaqus, COMSOL, ANSYS, etc.
- Mechanically inclined, strong problem-solving skills, hands-on individual
- Excellent oral and written communication skills; capable of interfacing at all levels of a business from equipment operators to platform VP

title: System Development Engineer, Backbone, Enterprise and Regional Engineering BERE
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Global Connectivity and Network Availability (GCNA) Organization is looking for a System Development Engineer to join our Backbone Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) team. System Development Engineers partner with our broader Infrastructure organization on configurations standards and tools, and collaborate with Systems and Software Engineers to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, and also deploy and sustain networking software tools.

AWS GCNA is the backbone that connects the global AWS network and focuses on managing the internet traffic that allows users to access their information and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is responsible for building and designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between data centers and customers.

If you like to work with new technologies, optimizing existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or service provider environment, we would like to meet you. Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next- generation IP networks. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
As a System Development Engineer, you will perform high quality network and/or systems automation, sustaining engineering, best practices application, optimization, internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate technical documentation.

Create and implement automation changes on the network.
Lead network projects in the areas of network sustaining engineering, network implementation, network scaling, best practices application, and/or network optimization.
Sustain Amazon Web Services’ next generation networks for significant AWS customers by providing critical support to deep dive and mitigate large-scale networking events.
Develop automation for network routing, interconnectivity, platforms, performance, and configurations issues; including necessary low-level application interaction, Unix systems, and new age networking software tools.
Drive and support innovation from Top of Rack to the Network Border, and everything in between.
Partner with our broader Network/Infrastructure organization in the areas of network engineering, configurations standards, and tools.
Work closely with our Network/Systems/Software Engineering teams to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, as well as, assist with deployment and sustaining of networking software tools.
Maintain standards across the networking toolset and ensure that we are fully compliant to those standards and policies.
Deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions and processes.
Collaborate with the highest tier escalation engineers/resolvers.
Create and review documentation and process regarding network recurring issues, new standard operating procedures, knowledge transfer material, etc.

A day in the life
A day in the life
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Engineers in the BERE organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we work with internal partners to develop and implement the next gen platforms along with the tooling ecosystems to support these platforms driving efficiency and scalability through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blue print at our scale allowing our engineers to develop solutions to the complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact to our customers during events.

About the team
Within AWS Networking, the Backbone Enterprise, and Regional Engineering (BERE) organization is responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations.

BERE provides the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a network that grows by 70% annually. In addition, they have teams that are responsible for the design and operation of our global corporate office and data center network, allowing tens of thousands of Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers.

title: Applied Scientist, Bidding Science and Experimentation
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our products are strategically important to our businesses driving long term growth. We deliver billions of ad impressions and millions of clicks and break fresh ground in product and technical innovations every day!

The Bidding Experimentation and Science Team is responsible for both real-time pricing and ranking decisions on the Amazon RTB (Real-Time Bidding) system as well as our experimentation infrastructure and methodology. As the owners of ranking, we have one of the most important job in the DSP which is to set the bid price on advertising opportunities. Even small incremental improvement is making a huge impact for the company, and we are responsible for developing the next generation of pricing algorithms to drive these improvements. As owners of experimentation, we work closely with not only scientists within our team but also our partners teams to develop new online experiment designs, propose new analysis methodologies to increase the statistical validity and power of our results, and build tools to enable experimenters to rapidly iterate on their ideas. Experimentation is ultimately the engine that drives our decision-making when launching new products and algorithms. The visibility of our team's work is very high and we receive high support from the management and peer teams. These systems are optimizing the price of every individual opportunity on behalf of Amazon Advertising advertisers.

You will play a significant role in building and improving our production algorithms, leveraging the latest advances in ML, online optimization, optimal control, forecasting, and causal inference, to name a few. You will construct prototypes to validate your hypotheses, work with engineers to turn these prototypes into production systems, and perform offline analysis and online A/B experimentation. You will also join the Amazon science community, with opportunities to write papers, attend workshops and conferences (internal and external), participate in science events, and obtain early access to Amazon ML technologies.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will work directly with a highly motivated team of ML scientists and engineers who are passionate about applying data science and ML techniques to solve advertiser needs. You will also join the Amazon ML community, with opportunities to write papers, attend workshops and conferences (internal and external), participate in science events, and obtain early access to Amazon ML technologies.

As an Applied Scientist II, you will
- Be a technical leader in ML, optimization, and causal inference and drive full life-cycle projects within this team and across other teams
- Build machine learning models, perform proof-of-concept, experiment, optimize, and deploy your models into production.
- Develop algorithms for online optimization and control, bandits, and reinforcement learning and bring them to production.
- Develop, design, and run A/B experiments, gather data, and perform statistical analysis.
- Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for monitoring and feedback.
- Work closely with software engineers to assist in productionizing your work.
- Research new and innovative machine learning and optimization approaches.
- Recruit Applied Scientists and Data Scientists to the team and mentor scientists on the team.

A day in the life
- Conduct offline analyses of data to guide design decisions with the product team
- Conduct A/B tests and analyze results to guide rollout, go to market, or development priority decisions
- Suggest models, algorithms, designs, and/or features to sophisticate the marketing products or solutions we offer to our customers

About the team
Why you will love this opportunity: Amazon is investing heavily in building a world-class advertising business. This team defines and delivers a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our solutions generate billions in revenue and drive long-term growth for Amazon’s Retail and Marketplace businesses. We deliver billions of ad impressions, millions of clicks daily, and break fresh ground to create world-class products. We are a highly motivated, collaborative, and fun-loving team with an entrepreneurial spirit - with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate.

Impact and Career Growth: You will invent new experiences and influence customer-facing shopping experiences to help suppliers grow their retail business and the auction dynamics that leverage native advertising; this is your opportunity to work within the fastest-growing businesses across all of Amazon! Define a long-term science vision for our advertising business, driven from our customers' needs, translating that direction into specific plans for research and applied scientists, as well as engineering and product teams. This role combines science leadership, organizational ability, technical strength, product focus, and business understanding.

Team video https://youtu.be/zD_6Lzw8raE

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

title: Senior Software Dev Engineer , AWS Elastic Container Service
descriptionHtml:
AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS) is building a new team in Seattle to dramatically accelerate how quickly containerized workloads become ready to run. This is a foundational performance challenge at massive scale — and we believe a step-function improvement is technically within reach.

The Workload Optimization team is a greenfield team tackling one of the most impactful challenges in container compute. As a Senior SDE, you will lead the system design and technical direction for low-latency container startup at massive scale. You'll work deep in the stack — Linux kernel, containerd/runc, Bottlerocket, and container networking — to reimagine the launch path from instance creation to workload execution.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the architecture and technical roadmap for container start-up optimization at scale
- Drive system design across the container runtime, OS, and networking layers
- Mentor and grow a team of engineers building foundational infrastructure
- Work directly with senior ECS leadership to shape the future of Fargate performance
- Ensure strong operational practices across your team, including appropriate monitoring, telemetry, runbooks, and retrospective processes, while proactively identifying and resolving root causes of systemic issues.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing operational metrics and addressing any alerts from overnight. By mid-morning, you are deep in a design discussion with engineers on your team, working through trade-offs for a new feature that spans multiple services. After lunch, you pair with a teammate on a tricky implementation, then join a cross-team architecture review where your expertise helps shape a shared interface. You wrap up the afternoon writing a technical design document and providing feedback on a colleague's code review.

About the team
Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) makes it easy for customers to run, scale, and secure containerized applications on AWS. ECS powers some of the most demanding workloads on the planet — from startups launching their first container to enterprises running millions of tasks across global infrastructure.

The Workload Optimization team is a brand-new team within ECS, based in Seattle, with a focused mission: fundamentally reduce the time it takes for a containerized workload to become ready to run on AWS Fargate. For the vast majority of Fargate customers, launch latency is one of the biggest factors in their end-to-end experience — and we believe a step-function improvement is achievable.

This is a greenfield team, which means you won't be inheriting legacy systems or processes — you'll be building from scratch. You'll work deep in the systems stack (Linux kernel, container runtimes, OS, networking) alongside a small, senior group of engineers who care deeply about performance, correctness, and customer impact at scale.

We value engineers who think from first principles, are comfortable with ambiguity, and are energized by hard problems that don't have obvious solutions. Our culture is direct, low-ceremony, and high-ownership — you'll have real influence over what we build and how we build it from day one.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building or operating container-based services, microservices platforms, or cloud infrastructure on AWS.
- Familiarity with container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or ECS.

title: Controls Engineer , EMEA Controls
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

The Global Services team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls team as Controls Engineer, responsible for the building automation systems within Amazon. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for!

Our Controls Engineers possess a construction management, mechanical, electrical or technology background that enables him/her to undertake the challenges of sophisticated controls platforms and a demonstrated ability to think broadly and strategically in aligning building controls and automation with the larger objectives of the business.

Key job responsibilities
- Understanding of: electrical diagrams, control diagrams, building operations, control circuits, industrial HVAC.
- Ability to ascertain customer needs to help develop scope and specifications.
- Ability to manage scope of work relative to the site specifics and customer needs.
- Ability to manage engineering to determine the scope of work relative to the design intent of the customer needs.
- Ability to read and interpret specifications and implementing those specifications as they apply the work environment.
- Development of control panel BOM’s.
- Development of ISA sheets for temperature, level, flow, and pressure transmitters along with ISA sheets for control valves, positioners, analytical, and various other types of instrumentation.
- Development of drawings for control panels, power distribution, junction boxes. Included in the drawings are the general arrangement, internal layout, schematics and interconnection and wire diagrams.
- Development of logic diagrams in the International Automation format for complex logic devices such as Programmable Logical Controller and Distributed Control System.
- Preparation of cable, routing plans and schedules.
- Performing inspects, testing, and commission of the facility systems.
- Work individually and as part of a team to develop new products, support existing products, test and evaluate equipment.

A day in the life
You will own controls infrastructure delivery across one of AWS's most strategically significant European clusters. You will hold vendors to schedule, quality, and safety standards while navigating complex construction programs and communicating across technical and non-technical audiences. title: Sr. Program Manager, WW FBA
descriptionHtml:
The WW FBA (Fulfilment by Amazon) team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.
We are looking for a Program Manager who will partner closely with in-country FBA, Supply Chain, Retail, and Operations teams in International Emerging Stores (IES) stores to drive key FBA inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, excess/Aged inventory. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive programs informed by experimentation and country-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.

Key job responsibilities
• Partner with in-country FBA, Supply Chain, Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
• Build and maintain root-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
• Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in country Business Review forums and ensuring that system-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
• Design and run structured experiments with sellers - adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build an evidence-based product and program roadmap.
• Work with Product, science, and BI teams to translate operational insights and experiment results into scalable product improvements; identify IES-specific requirements and ensure they are reflected in WW roadmaps.
• Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve how metrics are tracked, root causes are diagnosed, and corrective actions are triggered.
• Coordinate peak readiness (Prime Day, BFCM) by identifying inventory risks early, stress-testing operational workflows, and working with partner teams on mitigation plans.
• Serve as the connective tissue between WW FBA and in-country stakeholders — validating hypotheses, surfacing local edge cases, supporting system rollouts, consolidating country-specific inputs for OP1/OP2, and ensuring smooth knowledge transfer in both directions

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources or related field
- • Demonstrated experience owning business metrics end-to-end — defining measurement frameworks, diagnosing root causes, and leading cross-functional teams to drive improvement
- • Proficiency in SQL or equivalent querying tools to independently extract, analyze, and communicate operational insights without relying on a dedicated analytics resource
- • Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing and presenting structured reviews to senior leadership
- • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across teams you do not directly manage, in ambiguous or evolving organizational contexts
- • Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation tools to redesign an analytical or operational workflow — not just familiarity with the concepts

Preferred qualifications

- • Experience in inventory planning, or supply chain operations; or equivalent experience in marketplace or platform supply chain, or seller/vendor-facing operations at scale
- • Familiarity with generic inventory systems — including placement logic, restock recommendations, capacity management, or seller-facing tools
- • Experience working in or closely with non-US Amazon stores (EU, JP, IN)
- • Demonstrated ability to build operating mechanisms from scratch — metric definitions, attribution frameworks, review cadences — in an environment without established playbooks

title: Principal Customer Solutions Manager, Global Financial Services, Global Financial Services - Principal CSM
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to join our Global Financial Services (GFS) team to work with one or more leading FSI customers. As a CSM, you will help customers realize sustained business value by accelerating their customer transformation journey.

Are you passionate about shaping the future of the financial services industry by translating customer’s objectives to actions that realize long-term value through innovation? Do you have the business and technical savvy to earn trust with C-level executives and project team members alike? Have you delivered transformations for large enterprises with global operations, operating as multi-layered hierarchical organizations with complex stakeholder landscapes and decision-making processes?

At AWS we value critical thinking, self-motivation, and the ability to deal with ambiguity. You are detail oriented, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and an exemplary communicator. Your technical expertise and operational excellence will influence your decisions and help drive robust customer solutions. We love people who innovate, use data to make decisions, and can express themselves thoughtfully. We want you to be passionate about delivering a great customer experience, and to love to reach and exceed goals.

As a trusted customer advocate, you will help large global financial services organizations understand best practices around adopting advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. Together with them, you will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within financial services firms. We are also looking for individuals with a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and delivery challenges.

As an AWS Customer Solutions Manager (CSM), you will establish a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture and processes. You will lead the successful adoption of AWS, guiding customers through the people, process, and technology facets of their cloud transformation journey. You will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and voice of customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. You leverage your communication, program management, technical, operations, and transformation acumen to understand your customer's strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and deliver successful, often industry changing, customer outcomes on AWS.

Successful candidates are motivated by the customer's long-term success, have a mix of technical and business expertise, are data and detail driven, and have experience delivering large-scale programs. You are a proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and team levels. You collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, while navigating across geographical and organizational boundaries. You are a natural problem solver who steers ambiguity and leads autonomously.

Key job responsibilities
Customer Solutions Managers (CSMs) are obsessed with accelerating our customer’s cloud adoption and driving value from investments in the cloud. CSMs have ownership of customers’ cloud enablement / adoption readiness, driving migrations at scale, leading digital transformations, and benefit/ value realization for AWS customers.

For effective adoption of AWS, CSMs focus on driving customers’ people and operating model change. CSMs ensure customer leaders have sufficient knowledge of AWS and establish an education strategy to up-skill technical and non-technical roles across the customer’s organization. CSM’s work closely with customer stakeholders, to define their cloud’s business case, establish a vision / roadmap for their cloud program. CSMs are customer advocates, driving resolution of blockers to migrations and new solutions on AWS by delivering successful proof of concepts and creating paths towards value realization.

For migration success, digital transformation and value realization, CSMs work backwards from the customers’ cloud business case and defines the customer’s cloud migration/ digital transformation strategy which guides people, process and operating model changes for customer success. CSMs defines a detailed plan which includes key milestones collectively owned by Customer, AWS and Partner teams. CSMs partner with our customers to install and mature their Cloud Business Office capabilities, accelerate migrations and broader adoption of AWS at scale. CSMs work with our customers to establish the Cloud Leadership team and broader governance structures to effectively govern both our partnership with the customer, and the customer’s adoption of AWS. With a focus on accelerating adoption, CSMs drive the effective use of mechanisms to improve migration velocity and customers’ ability to operate business applications at scale on AWS, reducing the customer’s time to benefit.

The primary focus for a CSM, is serving as the cloud change agent for our customers, bringing structure, programmatic discipline and thought leadership to drive forward migration readiness, migration velocity and digital transformation/ modernization. CSMs balance bringing best practice AWS learnings to the customer, with the freedom to explore to find innovative ways to help tailor existing learnings and/or build something new that is more relevant and impactful to our customer needs on AWS. Ultimately, the CSM is driven by making sure the customer realizes their goals and ambition on AWS, key obstacles are rapidly unblocked enabling the customers cloud journey to efficient.

CSMs are measured on customer’s success of cloud adoption, based on:
· cloud enablement capabilities installed to drive customers’ People and Operating Model change for effective adoption of AWS. Including, training strategy to upskill technical and non-technical roles across the customer’s organization.
· workloads migrated to AWS, new customer solutions built on AWS, and by the breadth of AWS services employed by the customer.
· customer engagement effectiveness, including writing effective briefing documents and establishing key relationships with stakeholders to drive migrations at scale.
· establishing and managing an outcome-driven adoption plan to realize customer’s account vision and strategy while reporting on customer maturity and adoption progress.

About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 12+ years of experience delivering technology initiatives, including 5+ years of customer-facing experience engaging with senior customer stakeholders (Director+ level), with a demonstrated ability to earn trust and influence senior stakeholders, serving as a trusted technical and business advisor up to C-suite, and delivering technology-enabled transformations
- 3+ years of cloud computing experience
- PMP or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification

Preferred qualifications

- Consultancy experience as a technology delivery lead and trusted advisor to external customer(s), with executive-level presence and communication skills
- Experience working within a public cloud sales organization.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement (ISCaP) organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!

We are seeking a Hardware Commodity Specialist to join a team that handles one of Amazon’s fastest growing commodities – Battery Backup Units (BBUs). In this role, the candidate will manage procurement and related operational supply chain activities in close collaboration with both internal and external cross functional teams. These are critical for AWS to achieve continuity of supply and cost goals.

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of Seattle, WA, USA.




Key job responsibilities

The successful candidate must be a self-starter and have ability to work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. Candidates must have excellent analytical capabilities, supply chain experience. Candidate should be comfortable with diving deep into data sources to debug data related issues, and have strong writing skills.

The ideal candidate will not only raise the bar on delivering the right supply at the right time, but also is a person who actively participates with a strong curiosity to understand the business end-to-end, and has a track record of using data to influence decision makers.

In this role you will:

Understand forecasting, demand planning, material planning, and manufacturing processes to verify supply commitments

Work with internal and external stakeholders to forecast battery demand and manage supply positioning globally to support last mile operations

Own capacity planning with key OEMs and optimize supply chain network to best deliver for customers.

Work with various analytics and software development teams to drive operational excellence

Develop analytical tools and dashboards to track metrics, monitor SLAs, and report findings

Drive EOL management, collaborate with engineering, DC operations and finance to ensure cross-functional alignment on supply, product roadmap and budget requirements

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience
- 3+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
- 3+ years of working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services experience
- 3+ years of working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT. experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in online advertising or high-tech products/services
- Experience scaling a publisher monetization product or service
- Knowledge of battery industry / market

title: Sr. Solutions Architecture Manager, Amazon Web Services, Sweden
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced Sr. Solutions Architect Manager to lead the Swedish solutions architecture team, that helps customers across multiple industries succeed using AWS technologies.

In this role, you will hire and develop some of the industry’s best cloud-based solutions architects, coach them on cloud adoption best practices, empower them to further develop their technical areas of depth as well as their communication, presentation and strategic advisory skills. You will be partnering with other teams within AWS such as account management, service teams, marketing, and professional services, prioritizing your initiatives and aligning goals to maximize long term value.

You and your team will shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS services in Sweden. You will be interacting directly with customers to better understand their needs and align the right resources and tools to maximize their success. You will be measuring and delivering results, while staying in touch with the pace of innovation of the AWS technology and its use cases. You will need to be technically capable and credible in your own right so that you can shape the customer and solutions-focused initiatives of your team. You will get to practice your creativity in driving the link of technology to tangible solutions and educating customers about the art of the possible. Central to this will be your leadership in driving Solutions Architects to create advanced solutions, demos and architectures for a variety of use cases.

The ideal candidate has experience building, leading and developing talented teams of senior engineers or solutions architects. Customer-facing experience is preferred, practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have sound leadership skills and a strong technical foundation in secure, scalable and reliable IT architectures.

As the Solutions Architecture Manager for Sweden you will be part of the tech leadership team for Northern Europe, reporting to the area Technology Director.

At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.

Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.

Key job responsibilities
Hire, on-board, train, and develop new Solutions Architects and Solution Architecture Managers; you should be an exceptional builder of great people.

Coach Solutions Architects to conduct one-to-few and one-to-many technical sessions so they can transfer deep technical skills to customers who are considering or using AWS.

As the tech leader of Sweden represent AWS in public events and with customers.

In partnership with account management teams, formulate and execute a customer-focused strategy to drive adoption of AWS.

Guide and prioritize the development of whitepapers, data sheets, and other high-value customer facing guidance and best practices.

Own the technical strategy that will increase customer value and adoption of well-architected AWS solutions across customers.

Act as a conduit and liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
