Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Telecoms Network Planner, Network Planning and Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Connectivity and Infrastructure Delivery (GCID) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Telecom's Network Planner, you are responsible for managing the planning and development of Amazon’s telecom's network infrastructure. You will be experienced in planning and designing physical network infrastructure (dark fiber, colocation and ISP cabling), optical transport technologies, backbone network engineering design principles, and you will have good market knowledge of network infrastructure providers in your region. This role requires extensive collaboration, driving strategic planning initiatives, designing high-availability solutions at scale, and delivering precise documentation. You will actively drive infrastructure solutions within your designated region, working with Business Developers, suppliers, technology partners, as well as Amazon networking teams to meet our customers’ demands.

Key job responsibilities
Act as the EMEA subject matter expert on topology and infrastructure demand planning.

Collaboratively develop network infrastructure execution plans in partnership with Business Developers that involve leased wavelengths, dark fibre, conduit infrastructure and submarine cable capacity/builds.

Develop strategic regional network plans for approval by internal customers and stakeholders, with a focus on short-, medium- and long-term needs

Work with network engineering to ensure that the highest degree of design consistency, network efficiency, cost optimization, and long-term scalability of the backbone network is delivered.

Compile topology information and performance metrics and make recommendations for improvements based on their findings.

Manage network change (migrations) as our network evolves to support increased traffic volumes and geographic expansion.

Translate network demand forecasts into actionable network infrastructure projects.

Own network availability, performance and remediation plans to address non-compliance.

Document and maintain the network inventory detail in platforms and inventory management systems.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or experience related IT
- Experience working in a network planning, network construction/implementation, or commercial implementation role at an ISP, telecoms operator, or Hyperscaler
- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers
- Ability to influence the planning, design, development, contracting, implementation, and operation of telecom networks.
- Extensive knowledge of IP peering ecosystems, fiber optic networks, submarine cables and the interconnection of these networks
- Sound business judgment, proven ability to influence others, and strong analytical thinking skills.
- Candidates must have strong leadership and written communication skills.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in large-scale networking environments
- Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross-functional teams
- Experience with co-location ecosystem, and site selection and development for data-center and networking scaling and expansion projects.
- Demonstrated ability to anticipate customer requirements and development of strategic plans.

title: Sr. Security Engineer, Leo Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are a specialized security team that sits inside a global satellite communications business. Our job is to make sure security lessons become permanent: when a security event happens, we find the root cause, close the immediate gap, and build the mechanism that keeps it closed. We watch across the whole environment, spot the trends others are too busy to chase, and turn them into initiatives that measurably reduce risk.

We work shoulder to shoulder with the builder teams designing, launching, and operating the product, and we partner closely with incident response, detection, and enterprise security functions. Over the coming years our focus is shifting further upstream: getting ahead of incidents through proactive posture improvement, hunting for gaps before they are exploited, and investing in automation so security scales with the business rather than against it. If you want your work to protect customers of a system being built at a scale few companies attempt, you will find that purpose here.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national.

Key job responsibilities
You will analyze the security events observed across Amazon Leo, separating each one into the immediate fixes it demands and the longer-term, systemic trends it reveals across the organization.

You will prioritize this work by the severity and business impact of the threat to Leo, concentrating your effort on the most serious security issues and making sound risk-based trade-offs to deliver against them on time.

You will drive immediate fixes to closure by identifying the right team or individual to own each task, and by creating the mechanisms needed to ensure security outcomes are prioritized and tracked to completion across teams with competing priorities.

You will lead time-boxed Find and Fix missions to investigate and clarify emerging security trends, turning early and ambiguous signals into a validated understanding of the underlying problem.

You will own security initiatives end-to-end that resolve the root cause of systemic trends, favoring centralized, secure-by-default controls that measurably and durably reduce risk across the organization.

You will serve as tier-3 escalation support during security incidents, advise partner teams on difficult security decisions, and advocate for new detection mechanisms and testing tools that reduce security operations cost over time.

A day in the life
In this highly dynamic role, you will decide where your time investments deliver the most security value, balancing proactive posture-improvement work against reactive support when security events arise. Teams across the business will reach out for guidance on a wide variety of security problems, and you can anticipate questions like:

"What's the right way to handle authentication tokens in service-to-service communications?"

"We're planning a confidential new product launch and need to define its security requirements."

"We just had a security event and need to run a root cause analysis to identify and correct what produced it."

When you're not responding to builder teams, you will evaluate overall security posture across the organization to surface architectural defects, hunt for gaps before they become incidents, and propose new security initiatives that correct systemic problems. Through this blend of consultation, investigation, and long-term mechanism building, you will help maintain a high bar for customer security.

About the team
Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build
experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- 5+ years of any combination of the following: application security frameworks, identity and access controls, incident response, mobile security, cloud computing and security, AI security, threat intelligence, and penetration testing experience
- 3+ years of cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system experience
- 5+ years of driving cross organizational security initiatives.
- 2+ years experience using AI to automate security.
- This position requires U.S. citizenship in order to access AWS GovCloud

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans
- Experience in threat hunting, detection engineering, or product/application security, including moving from a security hypothesis to a validated detection, control, or remediation within a time-boxed engagement
- Experience owning security remediation initiatives end-to-end, including scoping the problem, driving cross-team execution without direct authority, and measuring the resulting outcome

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video (PV) is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to own Operational Excellence and Development Efficiency across the business. Reporting directly to the Director of READI, this is a strategic, single-threaded leadership role for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and can set direction where the problem itself is not yet defined.

As a Principal TPM, you will operate across VP organizations, exercising broad strategic influence over how Prime Video plans, measures, and improves the operational health of its services and the productivity of its engineers. You will own high-visibility operating mechanisms — most notably the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review — and set the overall strategy, goals, and initiatives for Operational Excellence across PV. You will manage significantly complex, cross-functional initiatives, remediate endemic problems, and force-multiply your impact through the mechanisms and standards you create. This is a role for someone who is regularly escalated to, rather than one who escalates.

Key job responsibilities
Operational Excellence Strategy & Goals

Define and own the multi-year strategy, annual goals, and initiative portfolio for Operational Excellence across Prime Video, aligning teams and organizations toward a simple, coherent approach.

Establish the operational metrics, standards, and paved-road practices that define what “good” looks like for PV services — covering availability, resilience, incident management, and operational readiness.

Set and track org-level operational goals planning, translating leadership priorities into measurable outcomes and holding teams accountable to them.

Remediate critical and endemic operational problems by identifying systemic root causes and driving durable, cross-org fixes rather than point solutions.

High-Visibility Mechanisms (PV Quarterly Operations Review)

Own the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review end-to-end — its agenda, data, narrative, and follow-through — as the authoritative forum where PV leadership inspects operational health and commits to improvements.

Design, run, and continuously improve the portfolio of operating mechanisms (weekly/monthly business and ops reviews, metrics dashboards, and governance cadences) that create predictable inspection and drive action.

Curate crisp, accurate, and timely written narratives and data for senior leaders (up to and including VPs and S-Team-facing readouts), ensuring decisions are well-informed and action items are tracked to closure.

Create the connective tissue between mechanisms so that signals surfaced in one forum reliably drive prioritization, resourcing, and roadmap decisions across PV.

Development Efficiency

Own the strategy for improving developer productivity and delivery velocity across PV — reducing friction in the software lifecycle from design through deployment and operations.

Define and instrument developer efficiency metrics (e.g., build and deployment health, cycle time, change failure rate, time-to-recover) and use them to target the highest-leverage investments.

Drive adoption of paved-road tooling, standards, and best practices that simplify how PV teams build and operate, eliminating undifferentiated heavy lifting and unnecessary process.

Partner with builder-tools and infrastructure teams to unblock innovation and increase the speed and safety of delivery at scale.

Cross-Org Influence & Force Multiplication

Operate across VP organizations with broad strategic influence, building consensus, securing commitments, and negotiating positive outcomes among senior engineering and product leaders.

Drive clarity in ambiguity — frame problems that are not yet defined, align stakeholders on the path forward, and deliver with complete independence.

Force-multiply through the mechanisms, standards, and structures you create, raising the operational bar across teams without being in the critical path of every decision.

Actively develop the TPM community at PV — mentoring senior TPMs, contributing to promotion assessments, and elevating program-management craft across the organization.



A day in the life
No two days look the same, but the through-line is mechanism ownership and strategic influence. You might begin the morning diving deep into operational metrics ahead of the Quarterly Operations Review — pressure-testing the data, sharpening the narrative, and pre-aligning VP-org leaders on the decisions that need to be made. Midday, you facilitate a working session with engineering directors to unblock a cross-org resilience initiative, making the trade-off calls between business opportunity, resources, and long-term sustainability.

In the afternoon, you shift to development efficiency — reviewing delivery-velocity trends, identifying the systemic bottlenecks slowing teams down, and shaping the paved-road investments that will remove them. Throughout, you are the person leaders are escalated to when operational health is at risk, and the owner who ensures every commitment coming out of a mechanism is tracked to closure. Your success is measured not by the work you personally execute, but by the durable systems, standards, and mechanisms you leave behind.

About the team
READI is a central function in Prime Video that drives strategy, tooling, and programs for Scale Readiness, Operational Excellence, Resilience & Observability, and Development Efficiency. READI’s value as a central team relies heavily on outward-facing influence: its strategy, decisions, and guidance are amplified across all of PV. Prime Video operates a global, high-scale streaming service, spending hundreds of millions in infrastructure and allocating hundreds of engineers to operational load each year — a surface area where disciplined operational rigor and improved development efficiency translate directly into customer experience, cost, and speed of innovation.

Today, ownership of PV-wide Operational Excellence strategy and its supporting mechanisms is distributed, creating diffusion of responsibility and inconsistent standards across teams. This role exists to close that gap: to be the single-threaded owner who defines what operational excellence means for PV, instruments it, runs the mechanisms that inspect it, and drives the initiatives that continuously raise the bar.

Basic qualifications

- 12+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 10+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

title: Senior Data Scientist, Customer Experience and Business Trends
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) organization is hiring a Senior Data Scientist for its Benchmarking, Economics, Analytics and Measurement (BEAM) team. BEAM's mission is to improve customer experience across every Amazon business by turning fragmented internal and external data into decision-grade intelligence for senior leaders.

This role spans two of BEAM's core products. The Topline View of Retail is an always-on competitive intelligence capability that fuses third-party transaction panels with Amazon's internal signals to answer how Amazon is winning or losing share of wallet, across segments, categories and time. The Intelligence Engine is an LLM-powered analytics assistant that lets teams across Amazon ask business questions in natural language and get trustworthy, data-backed answers. You will not just analyze metrics. You will decide which metrics should exist and build the models that generate, forecast and explain them. And as the Intelligence Engine scales, you will own how we measure its quality and drive its accuracy forward: defining evaluation standards, diagnosing where and why it fails, building the labeled data that improves it, and running the experiments, including fine-tuning, that prove which changes actually work.

We are looking for someone with exceptional business judgment and metric intuition, paired with deep hands-on modeling skills: a strong point of view on what to measure, and the technical ability to measure it at scale, whether the subject is customer spending or the quality of an LLM's answers. You should be equally comfortable pressure-testing a model's assumptions and explaining its "so what" to a VP in two sentences.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the definition, methodology and evolution of competitiveness metrics such as share of wallet and segment penetration, including validation and calibration of third-party panel data against internal sources.
• Design and validate causal inference, forecasting, segmentation and anomaly detection models that explain what drives shifts in customer spending.
• Define the evaluation framework for the Intelligence Engine: representative benchmark question sets, accuracy and groundedness metrics, LLM-as-judge methods validated against human labels, and clear launch bars.
• Run systematic error analysis on LLM outputs to identify failure patterns, and turn those insights into targeted improvements across knowledge base content, prompts and model behavior.
• Curate and maintain high-quality labeled datasets from expert review and user feedback, and use them to design and measure the impact of model improvement experiments, such as supervised fine-tuning and preference-based tuning, in partnership with applied scientists and engineers.
• Build reproducible pipelines that combine panel and internal data, and productionize recurring analyses and evaluations with data engineers.
• Translate ambiguous business questions into defensible metrics and answers, and communicate findings to senior leadership through written narratives and monthly reporting.
Set modeling, evaluation and scientific rigor standards for the team, and mentor scientists and analysts.

About the team
CXBT is a group of diverse functions dedicated to understanding, improving, and influencing customer experience globally, across all of Amazon. We are builders who develop products, services, and data-driven approaches that shape offerings for nearly every Amazon business and customer type — consumers, developers, sellers, brands, employees, investors, streamers, and gamers. We work backwards from customer needs, combine technical and non-technical methods, and track industry and business trends. Our roles span Product Managers, Data Scientists, Economists, Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Engine, Applied Scentist, and Product Manager.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree or above in a quantitative field, or PhD and 6+ years of data scientist experience
- Experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning methods (e.g., regression, forecasting/time series, classification, clustering, causal inference) to business problems.
- Proficiency with data scripting and modeling languages (SQL and Python or R) and building analyses on large, messy datasets.
- Demonstrated experience defining metrics and KPIs from scratch and connecting them to business decisions.
- Experience communicating analytical and modeling results to senior, non-technical business audiences in writing.

Preferred qualifications

- Familiarity with experimentation/A-B testing and with modern ML tooling and cloud data environments (e.g., AWS, Spark).
- Experience mentoring scientists/analysts and providing technical leadership on modeling and metric-design decisions.
- Strong background in retail, e-commerce, or CPG competitive and market-share analytics (share-of-wallet, category penetration, price/selection benchmarking).

And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Construction Manager, you will be part of a creative, diverse team tasked with solving fascinating problems in constructing Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry-leading examples of energy-efficient, cost-effective designs. You will work alongside partner teams such as Operations, Networking, Controls, Security, and Commissioning to build Data Centers that directly support our Customers.

As our Data Center Construction Manager, you will build some of the most interesting electrical and mechanical systems in the world. You will be on the construction site daily, interacting with the construction trades as Amazon's owner's representative. You will be directly responsible for driving cost, schedule, and quality while managing construction vendors and contractors building data centers.

We are a diverse, upbeat, creative team of engineers and managers working daily to develop innovative data centers for our Customers.

Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Construction Manager will be responsible for construction project management and oversight of construction-related activities as they relate to new builds or general capital projects. This includes ownership of the project scope, quality, schedule, and budget.

APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers six disciplines of deployments, projects, service, colo, on-call support, and management.

Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade collocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.

Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:
- Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
- Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours

title: Sr Systems Development Engineer, AWS AI/ML Servers
descriptionHtml:
AWS runs the world's largest fleet of AI/ML accelerator servers. When a model with billions of parameters trains across a large scale of GPUs, every minute of downtime costs real progress. We are building the automation, diagnostics, and predictive intelligence that keeps this fleet running at peak. If you want to work at the intersection of hardware, software, and scale — where your code directly prevents customer-impacting failures — this is the role.

We are seeking a Systems Development Engineer to build automation software, diagnostic tooling, and fleet health infrastructure for our accelerated compute platforms. You will work across multiple teams and organizations to design scalable, reliable systems for our accelerated compute fleet.

What You Will Do
You will tackle problems no one has fully defined yet — spanning hardware, firmware, kernel, and software simultaneously. You will own systems end to end, writing code that prevents failures rather than reacts to them, and building automation that replaces manual toil with intelligent self-healing. You will work across PCIe topology, GPU diagnostics, Linux drivers, and telemetry pipelines to correlate signals and isolate faults at fleet scale. When your system catches a failing GPU before a training job crashes, that is your impact.

Why You Will Love It
Your automation runs at a large scale across servers in the cloud. When you ship, you see failure rates move within days. The team is small enough that your decisions shape the architecture, and large enough that you will always have experts to learn from across hardware, firmware, and software.

The Ideal Candidate
You know the full stack from bare-metal to userland. You debug at the intersection of components, not just within them. You build at cloud scale and care how your systems decisions impact customers. You are an excellent communicator who can drive alignment across hardware, software, and operations teams.


Key job responsibilities
Fleet Health & Predictive Infrastructure

1. Build and own the automation infrastructure for accelerator (AI/ML) fleet health at a large scale of servers, driving toward zero-touch operations that detect, diagnose, triage, and remediate faults without human intervention
2. Design and develop test frameworks, test coverage strategies, and diagnostic tooling to validate hardware functionality, detect faults, and ensure qualification coverage across the platform lifecycle.
3. Design predictive failure detection using telemetry, sensor data, error trending, and log correlation to identify degrading components before customer impact
4. Develop monitoring dashboards and alerting for real-time fleet health visibility across manufacturing, lab, and production environments
5. Define and track fleet health metrics: failure rates, mean time to detect and resolve issues, first-time fix rate, test dwell time, and predictive accuracy

Debugging & Troubleshooting

1. Debug complex system-level issues across compute, GPU, and networking in production — including Linux boot/runtime failures, PCIe, power, NIC, NVMe, and GPU subsystems on x86 and ARM
2. Perform root cause analysis correlating across firmware, kernel, driver, and physical layer; feed findings into manufacturing quality and design improvements

Systems Development & Automation

1. Design scalable test automation for hardware bring-up, regression, and qualification — reducing manufacturing test cycle times without sacrificing coverage through intelligent test sequencing and parallel execution
2. Build data pipelines correlating test results, sensor telemetry, and component-level data to identify systemic yield issues and drive upstream fixes
3. Develop and maintain Linux device drivers on ARM and x86; work with OS internals and accelerator/GPU software stacks
4. Build and manage tests covering all functional aspects of the system and CI/CD pipelines for rapid deployment to manufacturing lines and production fleet

Cross-Team Collaboration

1. Work across engineering teams and internal customers to ensure new accelerated compute hardware meets data path, control path, and onboarding requirements
2. Engage with ODMs and design partners on testability, diagnostic coverage, and automation requirements during hardware design and bring-up phases — influencing functional and performance readiness of the platform
3. Partner with datacenter operations to close the loop between field failures, manufacturing escapes, and design improvements

Operational Excellence

1. Participate in post-incident reviews, identify contributing causes and drive permanent fixes that eliminate whole classes of risk
2. Produce clear, maintainable documentation for systems, runbooks, and automation to enable others to operate and extend your work
3. Drive process improvements that increase team agility — reducing development friction, eliminating unnecessary gates, and improving delivery velocity

May require occasional (<10%) regional and international travel to Design and Manufacturing Partner sites.


A day in the life
You start the day reviewing overnight validation run results, triaging a cluster of GPU errors that correlate with a specific firmware version. Mid-morning, you push a fix to your diagnostic automation pipeline and validate it catches the failure pattern in your test environment. In the afternoon, you join a hardware bring-up call with your ODM partner to debug a PCIe link training failure on a new EVT board, walking the team through kernel logs and signal integrity data. You end the day reviewing a pull request from a teammate on a new telemetry correlation engine, and updating your manufacturing test coverage dashboard with the latest yield data.

About the team
The Hardware Engineering AI/ML UltraServer platform team is a group of engineers and technical program managers directly responsible for launching GPU-accelerated servers into the AWS fleet. Located in Seattle, Austin, and Cupertino, we collaborate with global development teams and ODM partners to deliver next-generation AI/ML infrastructure deployed in datacenters worldwide. We move fast with small, empowered teams delivering end-to-end — from server conception through fleet-scale operations.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of systems design, software development, operations, automation, and process improvement experience
- 6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 6+ years of programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby experience
- 6+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience
- 5+ years of Linux/Unix operating systems experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience taking a leading role in building complex software or computing infrastructure that has been successfully delivered to customers
- 5+ years of building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments experience
- Experience with general troubleshooting/debugging of hardware, or experience with CUDA kernels or ML/low-level kernels
- 5+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- Experience leading technical teams through daily operations and maintenance evolutions, or experience in data center engineering or operations

title: Vendor Operations Specialist, Retail DI Vendor Service
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. Amazon Global Logistics connects suppliers worldwide to Amazon's fulfillment network, ensuring products reach customers quickly and reliably across US, EU, and international marketplaces.
The Vendor Operations Specialist is part of the Retail Direct Import Vendor Service team and serves as a critical liaison in Amazon's global cross-border supply chain, managing vendor operations across US, EU, and multiple international marketplaces including CA, MX, AU, JP, TR, and MENA. Acting as the first point of contact for all origin vendor inquiries and escalations, the specialist owns recurring operational tasks that keep origin logistics flowing on time.
This position demands comprehensive understanding of Amazon's inbound shipping methods including FOB (Free on Board), FCA (Free Carrier), and DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), each requiring distinct vendor coordination and documentation workflows. Team members must be well versed in the direct import end-to-end process, covering vendor onboarding, purchase order management, booking, shipment coordination, packaging and loading specifications, customs clearance, and final delivery. Critical timeline management is essential, including booking deadlines prior to ship window starts, estimated delivery date accuracy, and shipping label upload requirements before vessel departure.
Beyond reactive case management, the role drives proactive vendor performance engagement, operational standardization, and process improvement. On the standardization side, team members contribute to case handling process design, reason code framework development, and internal knowledge base maintenance. On the analytics and tooling side, they support performance scorecard management, data centralization and visualization, and AI tool development to improve operational efficiency across the global supply chain network.

Key job responsibilities
• Resolve vendor inquiries through internal case management systems across categories including booking guidance, destination tracking, purchase order management, shipping documents, product and trade compliance, shipping order release, origin charges, and labeling requirements, maintaining 100% response rate within 24 hours and 48-hour resolution targets.
• Manage internal tickets from cross-functional Amazon teams on origin logistics topics.
• Navigate booking systems, process shipment exception validations by working with retail teams, and coordinate with compliance teams to facilitate vendors' documentation submission.
• Review chargeback waivers to ensure accuracy and appropriateness while maintaining positive vendor relationships.
• Drive proactive vendor performance engagement including unbooked purchase order tracking, late booking and late delivery root-cause investigation, vendor order confirmation tracking, and shipping label upload compliance monitoring.
• Execute high-volume daily shipment exception approvals, accessorial charge approvals, fulfillment center rejection root-cause analysis, and customs clearance escalation management.
• Deliver structured vendor onboarding training sessions across all regions and manage vendor satisfaction surveys.
• Contribute to operational standardization, including case handling process design, reason code framework development, escalation path definition with priority tiers and response SLAs, batch task intake and lifecycle management, and internal knowledge base maintenance.
• Build and maintain the datasets and reporting behind the metrics the role is responsible for: translate a business need into a data requirement, define how the metric is calculated, and validate the logic before results are published. Investigate data discrepancies end to end, determining whether the cause sits in the analysis, the data refresh, or the underlying data logic, and raise the fix with the data engineering partner teams.
• Use AI and automation tooling to remove recurring manual work in reporting and case handling, and share reusable approaches with the team.
• Prepare inputs for recurring operational reporting, including the weekly business review and monthly initiative and metric reviews, and explain the drivers behind a metric that missed its target.
• Configure and maintain the system settings for operational needs.

A day in the life
You start your morning by reviewing the case queue in the case management system, prioritizing vendor inquiries by urgency and shipment deadlines. You resolve a booking guidance question from an overseas vendor, then follow up on a customs clearance escalation where a container has been held at the destination port. Mid-morning, you process a batch of shipment exception approvals and review several chargeback waiver requests, checking each against policy before making a decision. After lunch, you join a weekly business review preparation call, pulling the latest performance metrics and preparing the root-cause analysis for a metric that missed its target. In the afternoon, you dig into a data discrepancy flagged in the dashboard, trace it back to a refresh timing issue, and raise the fix with the data engineering team. Later, you reach out to a vendor whose purchase orders are approaching the booking deadline, guiding them through the process to avoid late shipment. title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time.

As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
- Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
- Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation.

A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of advanced English at CEFR level B2/C1
- Experience in data analysis
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience in a relevant field
- Experience in the management of large teams (50+ members)
- Work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including your peers and leadership
- Experience in a logistics/operations environment
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment, or experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

title: Director of Software Development India, Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies
descriptionHtml:
Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). Our work directly impacts every Alexa+ customer interaction, and we're obsessed with making it fast, reliable, and efficient - increasingly by putting generative AI and agentic systems at the center of how we build and operate.
We're seeking a Director of Software Development to own all India-based charters and teams. This role will manage AACT's charter and lead our teams based in Bangalore and Chennai consisting of SDMs, SDEs, TPMs, and SQEs. This leader will recruit and develop high-caliber leaders and individuals and will set the standard for how an AI-first engineering organization operates - where large language models, agents, and AI-assisted development are integral to strategy, execution, and day-to-day engineering.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross-functional environment.


Key job responsibilities
• Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives — whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both.
• As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams.
• Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India-based charters — accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale.
• Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org — in the products you ship (LLM-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) — while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it.
• Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence.

Basic qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
• 15+ years of software engineering experience.
• 8+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers.
• Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team.
• Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.
• Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.
• Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations.

Preferred qualifications

• Master's degree in computer science or related field.
• Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user-facing technologies.
• Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market.
• Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production-ready solutions.
• Familiarity with generative AI models and their application in customer interactions and process automation.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• AI Leadership Competencies -We expect a director at this level to be fluent in AI as both a product capability and an engineering multiplier. Specifically:
o AI fluency and technical judgment — A working understanding of modern generative AI: LLMs, foundation models, prompting, fine-tuning/RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and inference optimization. Able to engage credibly with scientists and senior engineers, ask the right questions.
o AI strategy and prioritization — Able to identify genuine, durable AI opportunities and to translate them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap tied to customer and business outcomes (latency, cost-per-interaction, trust).
o Driving AI-assisted engineering productivity — Actively raises the leverage of the org by adopting AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Sets expectations, mechanisms, and guardrails so teams use these tools effectively and consistently, and measures the impact on throughput and quality.
o Cost, latency, and scale economics of AI — Understands the economics of inference at scale and drives the right tradeoffs across model selection, orchestration, caching, and infrastructure to keep experiences fast, reliable, and efficient.
o Talent and culture for an AI-first org — Attracts, develops, and retains leaders and builders who thrive in an AI-native environment, and fosters a culture of experimentation, learning, and responsible innovation.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Amazon Lists
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Lists team within the Core Shopping org builds experiences that help customers seamlessly save inspiration they discover on or off Amazon, evaluate, share, and purchase them. Our vision is to create the most intelligent, easy-to-use, and personalized lists experience in the world that supports both shopping and non-shopping use cases. We own the Amazon Lists CX (e.g., Wishlist) that hundreds of millions of customers world wide use and love. The Lists team consists of multiple 2-pizza teams consisting of Engineers, Product Managers, and User Experience designers. We also partner closely with several teams, including Alexa teams so that customers get a seamless list-building experience whether they are on an Alexa device, Mobile shopping app, or desktop.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Program manager (Individual contributor role) to lead the delivery of a new S-Team goal, which aims to build a completely new CX that revolutionizes how customers save their inspiration - whether it is an item they want to purchase later or something else to complete a task. This role will have significant influence on the strategy and execution of this new initiative, and will work with partner teams across Shopping, Alexa, and other orgs to execute. You will work closely with product, engineering, and UX leaders to deliver a PR-worthy launch as part of the S-Team goal, and build a roll-out plan to iterate and get customer feedback quickly to influence the product direction. You will work very closely with other technical leaders to launch AI / Agentic capabilities that make it easier for customers to organize their saved inspiration, and take relevant actions. You will also have the opportunity to influence the broader Lists roadmap, including contributing to 3 Year Planning, OP1, etc., and have very strong technical acumen to unblock engineering teams.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the overall delivery of high-visibility initiatives (e.g., S-Team goal) to radically improve the saving experience for customers
- Partner closely with engineering team, product management, and UX design teams to ensure we're building the best customer experience.
- Serve as the key tech point of contact (POC) for partner teams contributing to your goals, such as Alexa, and within the Shopping org. This includes managing stakeholder relationships and owning crisp written and verbal executive-level communications.
- Establish and improve processes for managing complex, cross-functional programs and coordinating product demo and release schedules.
- Escalating risks/issues on a timely basis to senior leaders, and owning their resolution. This includes unblocking engineers as needed, and coordinate with partner teams.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience in customer-facing roles

Preferred qualifications

title: Robotics Systems Eng II, Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics across North America's fulfillment network. In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end-to-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.

You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.

You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)

You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization

You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.

You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.

You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains

You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment

You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results



A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options

3. Paid Time Off (PTO)

4. 401(k) Plan

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

- 5+ years experience in troubleshooting robotics systems or other complex mechanical-electrical or networked systems to resolve escalations including quality hand-off, live order testing, site acceptance testing, operational readiness testing, and monitoring system performance
- 5+ years experience in project management related to the deployment, retrofits or technical maintenance of large-scale industrial robotics
- 5+ years experience using project management and supply management tools/software including managing Bills of Material, deployment work instructions, and project task management.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to embed with FDE delivery teams and own the security posture of production AI systems deployed in customer environments.

You conduct security reviews, perform threat modeling, build security automation, and ensure every FDE-delivered system meets both AWS and customer security standards. You move at the speed of the FDE team: weeks, not quarters. You don't just flag risks and hand them back. You find the vulnerability, design the fix, and ship the control.

This role combines the depth of a senior application security engineer with the urgency and customer-facing presence of forward-deployed engineering. You secure AI/ML pipelines end-to-end, build reusable security tooling that scales the FDE practice, and operate with a production mindset from day one of deployment.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct security design reviews, threat modeling, and architecture assessments for production AI systems (agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, orchestration layers, model integrations, customer data pipelines)
- Embed with FDE delivery teams in customer environments; assess infrastructure security posture, identify gaps, implement controls while maintaining delivery velocity
- Build security automation and tooling: scanning, testing, monitoring capabilities purpose-built for forward-deployed AI systems; create reusable security accelerators
- Implement controls for AI-specific threats: prompt injection, guardrail bypass, model endpoint hardening, training data protection, output filtering, data isolation
- Integrate security into FDE engineering workflows: CI/CD security gates, secrets management, dependency scanning, container security
- Triage and respond to security incidents in production AI systems; build monitoring and alerting for AI-specific security signals
- Document solutions as reusable patterns, playbooks, and architectural guidance
- Requires up to 25% travel

10047

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing a pull request from an FDE engineer building a multi-agent orchestration system for a healthcare customer, catching an authorization gap before it ships. Mid-morning you're on-site with the customer's security team walking through your threat model for their RAG pipeline. After lunch you're writing a reusable Terraform module that enforces data isolation for multi-tenant AI deployments. You close out the day running automated guardrail tests against a Bedrock-powered application before it goes live. Every week brings a different customer, a different architecture, and a new AI security challenge.

About the team
AWS Forward Deployed Engineering embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to build production AI systems. AWS invested $1B in this initiative. We move at the speed of the customer: demonstrating ROI in weeks, not quarters. We are customer-obsessed. We lead customers toward outcomes, build together, and leave behind scalable patterns. Security is our enabling function: without it, nothing goes to production. Our culture is people-first, anti-burnout, bold, and engineering-excellence-driven.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Annapurna Labs Silicon Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS-Annapurna team develops the silicon used in our most advanced machine learning accelerator servers at cutting edge process nodes. These SoCs are used in massively scaled server clusters to provide best hardware platform for our customers to run training and inference workloads.

Our final product is a server, not just the silicon, so you will find yourself stretching beyond traditional silicon product engineering boundaries and dealing with various system issues and data sets, providing ample opportunities to learn.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end execution for complex silicon products from development through qualification, production ramp, and high-volume manufacturing.

You will own the integrated product schedule across Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Design, DFT, System Validation, Packaging, Quality, Reliability, Supply Chain, Foundry, OSAT, and external silicon partners.

This role requires you to be the owner of the outcome, not the status update -
You will identify the critical path, expose technical and execution risks early, establish clear owners and dates, drive decisions, and hold teams accountable for closure. You will dive deep enough into technical issues to identify owners, distinguish real blockers from noise and escalate when a decision is required.

Success means products hit committed milestones with the required quality, capacity, and manufacturing readiness


Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end silicon product schedule from tapeout and first silicon through bring-up, characterization, qualification, production release, ramp, and HVM.

Build and maintain integrated execution plans across silicon, package, test, quality, reliability, manufacturing, and supply-chain dependencies.

Define milestones, entry and exit criteria, owners, critical paths, and recovery plans.

Drive Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Design, DFT, Packaging, System Validation, Quality, Reliability, and Supply Chain teams to committed deliverables.

Dive deep on execution blockers; identify owner, root cause, decision required, and recovery path.

Drive closure of risks affecting schedule, quality, yield, test coverage, qualification, cost, capacity, or production readiness.

Own execution/communication of schedules and needs across foundry, OSAT and other external manufacturing partners.

Identify long-lead dependencies early, including wafer starts, masks, test hardware, package material, sockets, load boards, qualification hardware, equipment capacity, and translate product demand into manufacturing-capacity requirements and ensure capacity is available when the product needs it.

Drive readiness reviews for first silicon, characterization, qualification, production release, and volume ramp.

Establish mechanisms that expose schedule health, risks, decisions, and dependencies without relying on manual status collection.

Escalate early when teams cannot meet commitments. Bring options, trade-offs, and a recommended path.

Drive decisions when engineering quality, schedule, cost, capacity, and product requirements conflict.

Communicate program health to senior leadership with clear facts: what changed, why it matters, what decision is required, who owns the action, and when it will close.

Identify recurring execution failures and drive mechanism changes so the same problem does not reoccur on the next product.

Scale common planning, readiness, and execution mechanisms across multiple silicon programs.

About the team
Our team is focused on delivering technology programs that create real impact for Amazon's customers. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a willingness to tackle hard problems together. We are building an inclusive environment where program managers and engineers work side by side to simplify complex systems and ship meaningful improvements. If you are looking for a role where your program management expertise directly shapes outcomes and where you can grow alongside talented colleagues, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology
- 5+ years of experience in semiconductor product engineering, test engineering, silicon operations, manufacturing, or technical program management.
- Demonstrated ownership of semiconductor programs through major milestones such as tapeout, first silicon, bring-up, characterization, qualification, production release, ramp, or HVM.
- Working knowledge of semiconductor product-development and manufacturing flows across wafer fabrication, wafer sort, package assembly, final test, SLT, characterization, qualification, reliability, yield, and failure analysis.
- Experience driving execution across engineering teams that do not report to you.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with CPU, GPU, AI/ML accelerator, networking, or other large advanced-node SoCs.
- Experience driving products into high-volume manufacturing.
- Experience with advanced packaging, chiplets, 2.5D/3D integration, or HBM.
- Experience with ATE, SLT, product characterization, manufacturing test, yield ramp, and product qualification.
- Direct experience with leading foundry and OSAT partners.
- Experience managing capacity across wafer, package, assembly, and test.
- Experience owning multiple products or silicon generations concurrently.
- Experience creating execution mechanisms for a silicon organization that is scaling rapidly.

title: Data Center Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations!
AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include:
- Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators
- Manage the performance of a diverse team(s) of data center operation professionals with varying skills across different locations
- Developing Career Paths for the employees and to make updates in our internal tools.

title: Software Development Engineer Intern - Summer 2027 (CAN)
descriptionHtml:
Shape what comes next | Discover careers in Tech

At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you.

What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.

Our SDE interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As a SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.

By applying to this position, your application will be considered for Summer 2027 internship roles. All intern roles require in-person work and are 12 weeks in duration, starting in May/June and ending in August/September. Applicants will be considered at all locations we host interns in Canada.

Please note that the majority of our internships are in the Summer of 2027 and applicants will be processed based on business need; however, there may be additional openings that include the following periods:
1.Winter 2027 (Start January/February; End April/May)
2.Fall 2027 (Start August/September; End November/December)

During the application process, you will be given the opportunity to select a preference or interest in other seasonal start dates. Please note that placement in a non-summer season is not guaranteed and is subject to availability.

Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.

We will take your location preferences into consideration. Preferences are based on business availability and are not guaranteed. Applicants will be considered at all locations we host interns in Canada including but not limited to:
Vancouver, BC; Toronto, ON; Winnipeg, MN; Victoria, BC; Ottawa, ON; Calgary, AB

• Machine Learning • Distributed Systems and Data Management • Database Systems • Quantum Computing • Network Development • Query Processing and Optimization • Automated Reasoning • Embedded Systems • Data Engineering • Mobile Development • Game Development

title: Software Development Engineer II, PACMAN
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Software Development Engineer (SDE-2) to design, build, and operate scalable software systems that power capacity management decisions across Amazon's outbound fulfillment network in PACMAN team under SCOT organization. In this role, you will be responsible for developing robust, production-grade services that surface capacity utilization trends, detect risk patterns in real time.

The Amazon Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) team works on some of the world's most complex supply chain challenges, at Amazon scale. Within SCOT, the Fulfillment Optimization (FO) organization owns products and services that plan and execute orders for the outbound network worldwide — from designing network topology to providing accurate customer promises and selecting optimal fulfillment paths.

What we're looking for:
- Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, and system design.
- Experience with or passion for: Algorithms, optimizations, and generative AI.
- Ability to break down ambiguous, complex problems into elegant, shippable solutions
- Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where you own your systems end-to-end
- Excellent communication skills and a track record of raising the engineering bar on your team

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software solutions across major portions of your team's systems, balancing new feature development with refactoring and operational improvements to maintain long-term code health.
- Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to understand business requirements and deliver the right solutions, ensuring alignment between customer needs and technical direction.
- Participate actively in the full software development lifecycle, including system design, code reviews, testing, deployment, and production operations, while applying sound judgment on data structures, algorithms, and architectural trade-offs.
- Mentor and coach other engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing, producing clear documentation so that your software can be maintained and extended by those unfamiliar with the codebase.
- Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, continuously improving your team's processes, reliability, and overall software quality.

A day in the life

- Collaborate with Engineering, Science, and Product teams to design and implement new capacity tracking features — owning the technical architecture from high-level design through deployment, testing and including data pipeline construction for capacity ingestion and consumption.
- Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power the end-to-end lifecycle of capacity tracking: from initial configuration by resource owners, through real-time consumption tracking, to detection and risk notification — ensuring low latency, high availability, and data accuracy.
- Own and improve systems that detect discrepancies between expected and actual capacity utilization across outbound resources (sort centers, delivery stations, fulfillment centers) — building automated alerting, self-healing mechanisms, and diagnostic tooling to surface and resolve mismatches proactively using generative AI.
- Partner with capacity resource owners and FO decision-system teams to translate new data requirements and into technical specifications, leading design reviews and driving implementation across the service stack.
- Investigate and resolve production issues — by performing root-cause analysis, authoring corrections of errors (COEs), and driving operational improvements to prevent recurrence.
- Ensure peak event readiness (Prime Day, holiday season) by conducting performance and load testing, identifying and mitigating system bottlenecks, hardening capacity data services for throughput spikes, and participating in operational readiness reviews (ORRs) to guarantee timely and accurate risk signals at scale.

About the team
The PACMAN (Persistence And Capacity Management) team serves as the centralized authority for capacity availability across all of Amazon's physical outbound resources. Accurate, granular, and real-time capacity tracking is foundational for FO planning and execution systems to effectively utilize first and third party resources. From generating reliable network flow plans to providing accurate customer promises on the website and selecting optimal fulfillment paths for customer shipments, capacity information is a critical input at every step of fulfillment decision making.
