Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
1. Sales Execution & Seller Conversion

Receive qualified leads and drive end-to-end sales conversion. Identify key decision-makers within target companies, deliver tailored pitches based on category and seller profile, build trusted relationships with stakeholders across multiple business functions, and convert high-quality brand owners to launch and sell on the platform.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

title: Production Manager, Live Sports Production
descriptionHtml:
Come be a part of Amazon's Live Sports Production team. We are looking for an experienced Production Manager who operates at the intersection of traditional live sports broadcast production management and operations and the tech-forward, build-as-you-go environment of a global streaming platform. This role requires the field operations muscle of someone who has managed remote broadcast compounds, coordinated venue logistics, and staffed large-scale live events, paired with the builder mindset of someone who designs SOPs, dashboards and creates scalable processes in an environment where the infrastructure is still being built.

As a Production Manager, you are the operational engine across your assigned sports properties, working in lockstep with Sr. Production Ops Managers, Coordinating Producers, Technical Operations, and Production Finance to ensure every event is launch-ready and on budget. You will use your production management and field operations experience to drive new property launches and year-over-year sports property restarts. You will own event-level logistics, crewing, travel, vendor coordination, budgeting, and production communications. While much of the day-to-day execution (crewing, travel, payroll) runs through third-party Production Service Partners (PSPs), you own the outcomes and are accountable for meeting our standards. As the business evolves, you will help evaluate where functions should scale in-house versus remain with external partners.

This is an individual contributor role, but it carries a mentorship expectation. You are responsible for onboarding, training, and elevating freelancers, contractors, and production partner personnel to meet Amazon's production standards. The successful candidate builds rather than inherits, and takes ownership of the full operational picture, not just their assigned tasks.


Key job responsibilities
• Venue, Compound, and On-Site Logistics: Manage total on-site remote compound operations, serving as Amazon's boots-on-the-ground operational representative. Coordinate compound security, catering, venue and arena access, and credential submissions, working directly with leagues, teams, and venue contacts to ensure all production staff and talent are cleared in advance of air. Oversee shipping, equipment logistics, transportation, and emergency action plans. Operate on a schedule driven by the live sports calendar, which requires flexibility and extended stretches during peak seasons.

• Travel and Crew Administration: Own the end-to-end travel and accommodation process for production personnel and talent, including hotels, ground transportation, and travel and expense management. Coordinate travel logistics across overlapping production schedules, ensuring crew and talent are deployed efficiently and without conflict.

• Above-The-Line (ATL) and Below-The-Line (BTL) Staffing: Source, onboard, and evaluate local and freelance production support roles through 3P crewing providers, ensuring crew meets Amazon's production requirements and events are fully staffed across all positions across in-game and shoulder programming. Serve as the bridge between internal teams (Production Operations, Technical Operations, Editorial/Creative) and 3P crewing providers to align crew complement with show scope and budget.

• Show Budgeting and Billing: Own event-level operational budgets alongside Sr. Production Ops leads, Sr. Coordinating Producers, and Production Finance. Track expenses across vendor, freelance, and production cost categories. Process and approve invoices, review timecards, and reconcile cost reports. Flag variances and find tradeoffs when costs trend over budget.

• Production Memos and Communications: Publish production memos and dashboards detailing operational schedules, logistical event or show details, and emergency protocols across technical and production teams. Create and distribute production books, call sheets, and daily schedules, working with production counterparts to ensure each event is accurate. Maintain property dashboards with launch readiness and season information, ensuring all stakeholders have current operational visibility.

• Launch Readiness and Property Planning: Operationalize new property launches and year-over-year season restarts by building workback timelines, coordinating site surveys with Technical Operations and venue contacts, and setting up the tools and mechanisms required for operational execution (dashboards, tracking documents, distribution lists). Own the production management launch readiness roadmap for assigned properties, escalating risks when timelines are at jeopardy.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate across Editorial/Creative, Technical Operations, Talent, Programming, Business Development, Legal, and Production Finance to ensure operational alignment. Work with internal partner teams and PSPs on production safety, security, insurance, and planning needs. Support league and venue relationships as the operational point of contact.

• Vendor and PSP Coordination: Serve as the primary liaison with 3P Production Service Providers and crewing vendors, ensuring the hiring, scheduling, and deployment of crew meets Amazon's production standards. Establish clear roles and responsibilities with vendor counterparts. Review production service agreements and statements of work to validate contractual terms, ensuring deliverables and billing align with operational requirements.

About the team
The Production Operations team is responsible for delivering high-quality event and studio productions on all global live sports properties to Prime Video customers worldwide. We drive production excellence through purpose-built processes and scalable operational frameworks that empower the team to work more efficiently and grow with increasing demand.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of budgeting, scheduling and cost reporting experience
- 3+ years of producer, production manager or line producer experience
- 3+ years of overseeing and managing projects and deadlines experience
- 5+ years of editing/writing in long form audio, long form magazine, or television/film experience
- 5+ years in live sports production management or event operations, with hands-on remote and event production experience including compound and venue management. Has coordinated crewing and staffing through 3P vendors, including Above-The-Line and Below-The-Line personnel, across large-scale live broadcasts. Has managed event-level budgets including expense tracking, invoice reconciliation, and cost reporting. Knowledge of broadcast industry rates, crew structures, and market rules across domestic production environments. Has worked with production service providers and managed vendor relationships in a live production environment. Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent productions under tight deadlines.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with a variety of digital media workflows and post production
- Experience working directly with artists, songwriters, or other creative professionals
- Experience in a streaming or non-traditional broadcast production environment. Experience with production scheduling or workforce management platforms. Experience with union and non-union crew engagement across multiple production formats. Knowledge of broadcast technical equipment procurement and workflows.

title: Applied Science Manager, Seller Partner Trust and Store Integrity Science - Global Risk Intelligence and Prevention
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Applied Science Manager III to lead a team of applied scientists building next-generation AI-powered seller risk detection systems. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical science, strategic planning, and cross-organizational partnership. GRIP Science serves a complex stakeholder landscape: enforcement teams, policy owners, marketplace operations, peer science orgs, and senior leadership, each with distinct timelines and priorities. The right leader for this role will navigate that landscape with clarity, balancing urgent operational needs against the long-term scientific investments required to stay ahead of adversarial actors at scale.

You will independently own the vision, roadmap, and execution for a critical detection surface, defining what to build, what to defer, and how to measure success. You will set and maintain a high bar for scientific rigor while cultivating a team culture that rewards creative problem-solving and principled risk-taking.

Key job responsibilities
Strategy & Stakeholder Partnership

• Define the scientific vision and multi-year roadmap for your team's detection domain, ensuring alignment across a broad set of stakeholders with competing priorities and timelines
• Develop strong working relationships with enforcement, policy, operations, and engineering partners; serve as the trusted scientific voice in cross-functional discussions
• Exercise judgment in sequencing work. Distinguish between high-urgency requests that warrant immediate response and those better addressed through systematic, durable solutions
• Influence org-level planning (OP1/OP2) through compelling written narratives and data-driven proposals that articulate both near-term deliverables and long-term scientific bets
• Proactively communicate trade-offs to leadership and stakeholders, building trust through transparency about what your team will and will not prioritize in a given cycle

Science & Technical Leadership

• Lead a team building state-of-the-art detection models that leverage modern AI techniques, including deep learning, foundation models, and generative AI, to identify novel abuse patterns at scale
• Set and uphold a high standard for scientific methodology: model validation, experimentation rigor, reproducibility, and interpretability of results
• Evaluate end-to-end scientific proposals for soundness, scalability, and production readiness; know when to push for deeper investigation and when to ship
• Foster a culture of scientific curiosity and invention. Encourage the team to challenge assumptions, explore out of the box approaches, and invest in research that creates step-function improvements rather than incremental gains
• Identify where emerging AI capabilities (e.g., large language models, multimodal reasoning, self-supervised learning) can be applied to unlock new detection signals or fundamentally reshape existing pipelines
• Make informed trade-offs between model sophistication, delivery timelines, and operational sustainability

Execution & Operational Excellence

• Scope scientific projects, set priorities, and drive schedules; readjust decisively when incoming signals warrant a change in direction
• Structure work to reduce exposure to classic failure modes: ambiguous requirements, untested assumptions, under-instrumented models
• Establish mechanisms and metrics to continuously measure model effectiveness, enforcement precision, and downstream business outcomes
• Drive production readiness: monitoring, alerting, on-call practices, and rapid response for AI/ML systems processing millions of daily decisions

Team Building & Development

• Build and lead a high-performing team of applied scientists; attract and develop talent that combines technical depth with ownership mindset
• Invest in the growth of individual scientists through deliberate project assignment, regular coaching, and actionable feedback tied to career progression
• Create an environment where scientists have the space to do deep work, the support to take calculated risks, and the recognition when they deliver
• Manage performance across the full spectrum. Accelerate top performers toward promotion readiness while addressing gaps constructively and with clear expectations


About the team
GRIP Science (Global Risk Intelligence & Prevention) is the core detection engine within TSI Science. We build and operate state-of-the-art ML and AI models that identify and block bad sellers across Amazon's 24 global marketplaces. Our systems cover the full seller journey, from registration through every action on the marketplace, and score holistic risk across all active sellers. We push the frontier of adversarial detection by combining large-scale deep learning, graph-based reasoning, generative AI, and real-time inference to outpace bad actors who continuously evolve their tactics. This is one of the most technically demanding and high-impact applied science problem spaces at Amazon. Your models directly shape marketplace integrity for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- Knowledge of ML, NLP, Information Retrieval and Analytics
- Ph.D. in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields, or PhD and 5+ years of a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science experience
- 1+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- Experience hiring and leading experienced scientists as well as having a successful record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a successful career track
- Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross-functional teams
- Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers

title: Data Scientist, AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
Own the detection models and the measurement science that find fraudulent and compromised AWS accounts in real time. Join a team of scientists and engineers whose analysis decides how fraud is detected and stopped, and how fast.
The AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention organization keeps AWS a safe place to build for millions of customers. Our team owns the science behind fraud and compromise detection on AWS. Account compromise is the case where a legitimate customer's credentials are stolen or exposed and an attacker uses the account to run unauthorized workloads. Fraud is the case where an account exists to consume resources with no intent to pay. Most accounts our models score belong to legitimate customers, so every decision has to stop fraud while leaving their work undisturbed. As a Data Scientist you will own detection models end to end, from the first look at an emerging pattern through feature design, training, shadow evaluation, production launch and the weekly performance review. You will define how we measure ourselves: precision by outcome, time to detect, runtime of unauthorized resources, and the cost a model prevented.
- Own models that detect and block fraudulent activity in real time, protecting customers and AWS.
- Turn a pattern spotted in a handful of accounts into a model that screens millions.
- Define the metrics your models and systems are measured by and discuss them in weekly and monthly business reviews.
- End-to-end ownership, from the first signal to the enforcement action and the cleanup after it.

Key job responsibilities
- Own detection models and rules end to end: frame the problem with partners, source and engineer features from large-scale activity, sign-in and usage data, train and validate, run shadow evaluations, launch, and monitor performance after launch.
- Investigate new fraud and compromise patterns as they emerge, quantify their scale and design the detection response, from a fast rule to a trained model, with the trade-off between speed and precision stated.
- Define and audit the metrics that measure our systems: outcome-based precision and recall, time to detect, runtime of unauthorized resources, prevented cost. Own the analysis behind weekly and monthly business reviews.
- Evaluate agentic and LLM-based systems: build labeled evaluation sets, measure error rates in both directions, and set the thresholds under which automation is allowed to act.
- Extend detection to new AWS services as they launch, including AI services where spend accrues in minutes.
- Write clear technical documents for scientists and for non-technical partners in operations, engineering and leadership, and present them in science reviews.
- Mentor junior scientists and analysts on method, and help interview for the team.

A day in the life
You begin with the performance review of the models you own: what they caught, what was later overturned, and what slipped past every layer. You pull the misses, find that three share a pattern you have not seen before, size it in the data, write a shadow-mode rule, and put a one-page analysis in front of the team with the precision you expect and the cost of waiting for a full model. In the team's planning session for the next quarter, that analysis becomes a proposal for a new model and you make the case for its place on the roadmap against the other layers of the detection stack. You also audit the cases your agentic system resolved on its own and adjust its evaluation set and thresholds. You use AI coding assistants daily, for SQL, Python and documentation, and you check their work. Your stakeholders are the fraud engineering teams that power your models, the teams that act on their decisions, the AWS service teams whose customers we protect, and the leadership that reads your numbers every week.

About the team
We are a team of scientists, analysts, software and data engineers and a program manager, with close partners across AWS Fraud Prevention worldwide. We own the science behind fraud and compromise detection on AWS, from signal and detection through decision, enforcement, cleanup and reinstatement. We follow a layered detection strategy with online and offline machine learning models and agentic investigation systems. Our models also run in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, where they must work under EU data-residency constraints.
We invest in the growth of every team member through mentorship, careful code and document reviews, and projects sized to stretch you. We celebrate promotions, and new members ship their first project within their first quarter.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science
- Experience with data scripting languages (e.g. SQL, Python, R etc.) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, or Matlab)
- Experience with statistical modeling / machine learning
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience with one of the following areas: machine learning technologies, Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP) or related applications
- Experience in fraud, risk, security or another adversarial domain where the data shifts in response to your models.
- Experience deploying machine learning models in cloud infrastructure and monitoring them after launch, including retraining.
- Experience with AWS services such as Redshift, SageMaker, Fargate, Lambda, Bedrock or DynamoDB.
- Experience framing an open-ended business question as a quantitative problem and owning the analysis end to end.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current Active Athletic Trainer Certification by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Design Manager to join its Supply Chain Facilities Management (SCFM) team Dallas Texas.

Key job responsibilities
Our team is responsible for delivering and sustaining the network of supply chain facilities — warehouses, logistics and distribution hubs, integration and staging centres — that underpin the AWS infrastructure build programme. We drive to develop a portfolio of facilities that emphasise security, safety, efficiency, and cost effectiveness, while finding new ways to keep pace with AWS’s growing demand.
As Global Design Manager in SCFM at AWS, you will own the end-to-end design strategy for supply chain facilities across NALA, EMEA, and APAC — defining technical standards, driving design reviews, and ensuring consistency and quality across the global portfolio.. You will be part of a highly creative and efficient team comprised of Architects, Engineers, and Designers tasked with solving problems and challenging the status quo — across new-build, fit-out, extension, and the technical assessment and repurposing of existing buildings.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on — and the supply chain and facilities network that makes that delivery possible. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Key Job Responsibilities
• Communicate conceptual designs and create/maintain project documentation before, during, and after construction and fit-out;
• Lead the technical due diligence of candidate buildings and sites — assessing structural capacity, M&E systems, fire and life safety, compliance, and overall suitability — to inform acquisition, lease, and repurposing decisions;
• Creating and tracking metrics related to cost, quality and duration of design, as well as collecting data from construction and commissioning teams as designs are implemented. Establishing capital project design budgets and contributing to complex business cases for existing region and new region deployment. Collaborating with AWS finance teams to secure funding for projects;
• Working in partnership with AWS Engineering leads to schedule engineering resources and influence design changes based on internal customer needs;
• Partnering with internal customers to establish project scope, schedule and deliverables. Create, review, and release design RFPs. Direct the technical output of external design consultants through the design and construction lifecycle — setting expectations, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring alignment with AWS standards and project requirements. Coordinate with internal and external Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, and Cabling design engineers;
• Think outside of the box to find innovative solutions prior to and during the construction process to reduce costs and schedule without negative impacts on quality or reliability. Travel for site assessments, due diligence surveys, internal design meetings, construction review, and interfacing with design consultants. Anticipated travel not to exceed 25%;
• Coordinate and oversee permitting and design consultant workstreams, ensuring regulatory compliance, schedule adherence, and quality standards are met across concurrent projects.
• Complete after-action reviews and identify opportunities for process improvement.


A day in the life
As a Senior Design Manager you will be a key technical contributor within a global engineering team, partnering with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver supply chain and capacity projects across the Europe, Middle East & Africa geography. This role is an opportunity to collaborate with many facets of the AWS organization, external engineering resources, and regulatory agencies — spanning new facilities, fit-outs, extensions, and the due diligence and technical assessment of existing buildings being brought into the network.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

title: Interdisciplinary System Engineer, Devices & Services Energy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon has co-founded and signed The Climate Pledge, a commitment to reach net zero carbon by 2040. As a team, we leverage GenAI, sensors, smart home devices, cloud services, material science, and Alexa to build products that have a meaningful impact for customers and the climate.

In alignment with this bold corporate goal, the Amazon Devices & Services organization is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Interdisciplinary System Engineer to help build revolutionary products with potential for major societal impact. Great candidates for this position will have expertise in the areas of battery management systems, energy storage optimization, time-series forecasting, and control systems for battery dispatch. This includes owning end-to-end battery system architecture, design, and technical execution across the team's hardware launches, and experience designing ML-driven algorithms for battery management (BMS) that operate reliably under embedded/edge compute constraints, building forecasting models for energy usage and demand response, applying reinforcement learning or control theory to battery dispatch and charge/discharge optimization, and developing predictive models for battery health and degradation. You will strive for simplicity and creativity, demonstrating high judgment backed by statistical proof.

Key job responsibilities
As a Interdisciplinary System Engineer, you'll own end-to-end battery system architecture for new-to-Amazon devices, including power electronics, BMS, wireless connectivity, and HW/FW/SW integration — driving architecture decisions from concept through mass production. You'll serve as a key technical interface with battery vendors on system-level design and component selection, and lead design reviews and validation plans to ensure product quality and safety. You'll design and deploy ML-driven algorithms that autonomously optimize battery charge/discharge behavior, dispatch, and energy usage, and develop forecasting systems that integrate real-world usage data and grid signals to deliver context-aware, cost-saving recommendations to customers.

Beyond technical innovation, you'll drive critical technical trade-offs — BMS algorithm fidelity versus compute constraints, power electronics efficiency versus BOM cost, safety margin versus usable capacity — serving as a subject-matter expert on energy storage systems for Director and VP-level technical reviews. You'll drive end-to-end product development from research through production deployment on embedded and cloud systems, collaborating with cross-functional hardware, firmware, and software teams, and establish rigorous experimentation frameworks to validate model performance and measure business impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
- Experience with electrical systems
- 4+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- Knowledge of battery electro-chemistry and manufacturing processes.
- Familiarity with energy systems and energy devices beyond batteries

title: Sr. Manager Enterprise Support India, ES - Strategic Industries - Strat
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

The AWS Support team is seeking an Enterprise Support Manager that enjoys solving problems, working with customers, and who has a background from a variety of different fields. The Role needs experience of leading teams responsible for building or managing full application stacks from the system (Linux or Windows) up through a custom application, managing part of a network from layer 3 and higher, or web-related programming that includes the consumption of web services we’d like to talk with you!

Key job responsibilities
As Enterprise Support Manager, you will lead a team of Technical Account Managers who are the primary operational point of contact for your customer, helping to plan, review, and oversee ongoing operations of business critical applications. You will leverage your broad experience to work closely with sales leadership to plan and ensure successful launch and operations of AWS’s largest application workloads. You will lead operations reviews, both internally and with your customers, while constantly seeking ways to improve your customer’s AWS experience. In this role, you will also act as the voice of the customer within AWS to escalate problems and to drive prioritization of business needs for our customers.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in direct customer engagement, with a focus on support to senior executives (Vice President and C-level)
- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
- Experience working with enterprise software companies
- Experience demonstrating leadership and people management in Customer Service or customer facing roles
- 15+ years of management experience
- 8+ years of technical team management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving improvement programs in the operations, engineering and support fields
- Experience as a technical account nanager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect or in a similar role
- Experience in AWS services

title: Technical Consultant (TAM) - AMAZON Web Services, Korea , Partner/FSI
descriptionHtml:
As a TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive customer adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, RDS database, Network, ECS/EKS, IoT, Security/Governance, and much more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical direction to help plan and build solutions using standard methodologies, and enthusiastically keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will empower you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.

We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in IT architecting and operations such as OS/middle-ware/DB/Network administration, Customer center system/application management and more. The TAM is our centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers, so if you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

TAM 으로서 여러분은 고객이 EC2, RDS 데이터베이스, Network, ECS/EKS, IoT, 보안/거버넌스 등 다양한 AWS 서비스를 도입 및 사용할 수 있도록 전략의 수립 및 이행을 지원하게 됩니다. 기술적 및 고객 응대 역량을 발휘하여 고객사 환경 내에서 AWS를 효과적으로 대표하고 사고/장애, 트레이드 오프 및 리스크 관리에 대하여 시니어 리더십과의 논의를 주도합니다. 표준적인 방법론을 활용하여 솔루션 기획, 빌드에 있어 전략/기술적 방향성 및 변론을 제공하고, 고객의 AWS 운영 환경을 양호하게 유지하기 위해 적극적으로 개입합니다. 고객과 긴밀한 협력 관계를 구축하여 고객의 비즈니스/운영상의 필요와 기술적 해결 과제를 파악하고 AWS에서 최대한의 가치를 실현할 수 있도록 보조합니다.

우리 팀에서는 IT 아키텍팅 및 운영 (OS/미들웨어/DB/네트워크 관리, 고객센터 시스템/어플리케이션 관리 등 유관 분야) 에 해박한 배경지식을 지닌 후보자를 찾고 있습니다. Enterprise Support 가 고객에게 가치를 제공함에 있어 TAM으로서 중점적 역할을 맡아 혁신의 최전선에서 함께 하고싶은 분이라면 누구나 환영입니다.

Key job responsibilities
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:

* Provide field support to resolve inquiries from Enterprise customers regarding AWS service or Cloud.
* Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer
* Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed prelaunch planning
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
* Foster trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
* Lead technical discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management
* Work directly with AWS global engineering and service teams to resolve customer issue.


여러분은 다음과 같은 직무를 수행하며 매일 새롭고 가슴 뛰는 도전을 하게 될 것입니다:

* 현장 지원을 통해 AWS 서비스 및 클라우드 관련한 기업 고객의 요청/문의 해결
* 운영상의 퍼포먼스에 대한 완전한 분석 및 주기적 검토 결과를 고객에게 제공
* 서비스 중단, 지표 및 구체적인 론칭 전 계획에 대한 자세한 검토 수행
* 비용 및 복잡성을 낮추는 동시에 AWS 환경이 운영상 양호한 상태를 유지하도록 보장
* 고객과 신뢰관계를 구축하고 고객의 비즈니스 니즈 및 기술적 해결과제를 파악
* 사고/장애, 트레이드 오프 및 리스크 관리와 관련하여 시니어 리더십과 기술적 논의를 주도
* AWS 글로벌 엔지니어링 및 서비스 팀과 직접 협력하여 고객 이슈 해결

Key job responsibilities
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:

* Provide field support to resolve inquiries from Enterprise customers regarding AWS service or Cloud.
* Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer
* Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed prelaunch planning
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
* Foster trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
* Lead technical discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management
* Work directly with AWS global engineering and service teams to resolve customer issue.

A day in the life
* Educational Program

You will be given a Ramp-up period for 90 days when you onboard. During this period, you will learn skills and process needed for customer support and also aws cloud service/solution thru various education and practice
Our team encourage knowledge and experience sharing, such as customer support experience and technical knowledge sessions
AWS has various personal development programs. English language program in AWS enhance employees’ business English skills to facilitate working with global engineering and service teams

* Career Opportunity
You can actively communicate and collaborate working with global engineering teams within AWS
AWS provide internal international relocation opportunity, which enables employee to work in the different AWS region

* Work and Life Harmony
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

* Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team supports individuals’ career growth with various programs, such as mentorship and educational seminars. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment of sharing knowledge and experience through mentorship. Our team care about individuals’ career growth and strive to assign projects to develop into a better-rounded professionals.

* 교육 프로그램
온보딩 시 90일간의 집중 교육 기간을 거치게 됩니다. 이 기간 동안 고객 지원에 필요한 스킬 및 프로세스와 aws 클라우드 서비스 및 솔루션에 대해 다양한 교육 및 실습을 통해 배울 수 있습니다.
우리 팀에서는 고객 지원 경험이나 기술 지식 세션 등 지식 및 경험 공유를 권장하고 있습니다.
AWS에서는 다양한 자기 개발 프로그램을 제공합니다. AWS가 제공하는 영어 교육 프로그램은 직원들이 글로벌 엔지니어링 및 서비스 팀과 협업하는 데 필요한 비즈니스 영어 역량을 향상시킵니다.

* 커리어 기회
AWS의 글로벌 엔지니어링 팀과 적극적으로 커뮤니케이션 및 협업 할 수 있습니다.
다른 AWS 리전에서도 근무해 볼 수 있도록 내부적으로 해외 발령 기회를 제공합니다.

* 일과 삶의 조화
우리 팀은 일과 삶의 균형을 중시합니다. 중요한 것은 단순히 집에서 혹은 회사에서 얼마나 많은 시간을 보냈는지가 아니라, 일과 삶 두 측면에 모두 에너지를 분배할 수 있도록 흐름을 만드는 것입니다. 우리는 행복하고 만족스러운 삶을 위해서는 개인적 삶과 일 간의 적절한 균형이 필수적이라 믿으며, 근무시간의 유연성을 제공하고 각자가 자신에게 맞는 일과 삶의 균형점을 찾아가도록 권장합니다.

* 멘토링 & 커리어 성장
우리 팀에서는 멘토링, 교육 세미나 등 다양한 프로그램을 통해 개개인의 커리어 성장을 지원합니다. 다양한 경험, 근속 기간을 지닌 분들이 함께 일하고 있으며 멘토링을 통해 지식과 경험을 공유할 수 있는 환경을 구축해 나가고 있습니다. 우리 팀에서는 개개인의 커리어 성장을 중시하며 프로젝트 할당을 통해 각자가 다방면에 걸친 전문가로 성장할 수 있도록 노력하고 있습니다.

About the team
* The role is within the Korea Enterprise Support team. Enterprise Support team is one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS. AWS Enterprise Support team is looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises that are beginning or in the middle of their digital transformation journey.

* 해당 직무는 Korea Enterprise Support 팀 소속입니다. Enterprise Support팀은 아마존 웹 서비스(AWS) 내에서 가장 빠르게 성장하고 있는 조직 중 하나로 산업 부문이나 규모를 막론하고 모든 고객사가 AWS로부터 최선의 가치와 서비스를 제공받을 수 있도록 지원합니다. AWS Enterprise Support 팀에서는 컴퓨트, 스토리지, 데이터베이스, 데이터 애널리틱스, 애플리케이션 레벨 서비스, 네트워킹, 서버리스 등 다양한 테크놀로지 영역 전반에서 고객의 혁신을 함께할 Technical Account Manager (TAM)을 채용 중입니다. TAM은 세일즈 직무가 아니며, 주요한 기술 고문이 될 수 있는 기회로서 스타트업에서 대기업에 이르기까지 디지털 전환의 여정을 이제 막 시작한, 또는 이어 나가고 있는 다양한 규모의 고객에게 ‘고객의 목소리’가 되어줄 수 있습니다.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical engineering experience
- Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
- Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

title: Security Program Manager, AWS Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a Security Program Manager to be responsible for building and improving processes for project management and project planning and working across all levels and functions of the organization. The role is responsible for the life cycle management of data center physical security systems and technologies including, but not limited to: Access Control, Intrusion Detection, and Video Surveillance systems. Stakeholders include construction, facilities engineering, cabling groups, finance and procurement, among others. A successful Security Program Manager in this role will not be afraid to dive deep, ask challenging questions about complex and ambiguous activities, and get stuff done.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the key business partner working directly with service business partners and internal stakeholders (primarily infrastructure, physical security and operations teams).
- Collaborate with engineers, technicians, project managers, and Sr. Leaders to develop your programs.
- Drive process change and improvement across multiple business and program teams.
- Report ad hoc, weekly, and monthly program and operating metrics.
- Run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.
- Manage security system integration vendor contracts to deliver projects.
- Communicate the status of programs with customers, stakeholders and conduct program reviews.

About the team
The Infrastructure Security Team is accountable for ensuring that the foundation of AWS operates and scales securely. This team is responsible for the security of the hardware supply chain, AWS datacenters, and the AWS network. We build operational security solutions that are critical to the operations of AWS infrastructure, including identity management, security telemetry and threat analysis, hardware component validation, and ensuring third-party suppliers meet the AWS security bar.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- Experienced in vendor management and procurement processes, including the establishment of key performance indicators and service level agreements.

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- BA/BS degree or higher in related field of architecture, engineering, or project management. PSP, CPP, PMP Certification will be an added advantage.
- Working knowledge of network fundamentals, system integration, IoT devices, or centrally managed security platforms.

title: IT Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
IT systems that work effectively keep Amazon’s operations running at full speed. Our IT Support Engineers work behind the scenes to troubleshoot any issues and improve our systems, so that we can operate at our best. Your focus will be to make sure our IT infrastructure is up to the demands of our global business. At the same time, you’ll get to work with the latest technology and learn from leaders who are creating the warehouse environments of the future.

Key job responsibilities
- Support end-user equipment and your building’s IT infrastructure
- Help with key network projects, like the IT setup of new Amazon buildings
- Suggest new processes that improve the way Amazon uses IT in its operational sites
- Train and mentor IT technicians

A day in the life
You’ll be based on site and will travel to other operational sites in your country, and potentially internationally, several times a month. As an IT Support Engineer, you’ll work with remote and on-site colleagues to support them with any issues. You’ll use your expertise to make sure our platforms are working at their best, often implementing projects to maintain or improve our IT infrastructure. In some cases, you may also help design the infrastructure for new buildings and make sure everything is working for the site launch.

No two days are the same at Amazon, which makes this an exciting place to work. You can expect to troubleshoot disruptive IT incidents one day and come up with new processes that make our IT systems better the next. You’ll also spend time training and mentoring your colleagues, giving you the opportunity to see your team develop and your career grow.

About the team
Ops Tech Solutions (OTS) is the field IT organization responsible for first level troubleshoot of IT issues in our FCs, distribution centers and other sites.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
- Experience troubleshooting and identifying the root cause of issues
- Experience with Linux and/or Windows Operating System support including in-depth understanding of one or both OSs, configuring, managing or troubleshooting systems at scale
- Experience with IP networking fundamentals and TCP/IP, UDP, DNS & DHCP
- Experience in IT client, server, and network service delivery
- Valid EU driver's license
- Advanced proficiency in Spanish (C1 level) and English (B2 level), verbally and in writing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a customer-facing environment
- Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization
- Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment
- CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Linux (Redhat), Microsoft hardware (installation), AWS, or other industry relevant certifications
- Experience of working with common network and internet protocols such as, network management protocols, network communication protocols and network security protocols

title: Process Improvement Specialist, GOX - Ops Excellence
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step, look forward to new challenges, and make your ideas come to life. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon, and today is your day to be part of it.

The Process Improvement Specialist in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) owns the expansion of proven EU Operational Excellence solutions into new Amazon regions. You sit within the EU organisation and work hand in hand with regional Operations teams. You are the bridge that takes tools, mechanisms and data-driven solutions already delivering results in the EU, then adapts, extends and rolls them out across a new network.

Your core loop is straightforward: understand what the region needs, partner with technology teams to expand the solution to meet that need, then support the local ACES team in rolling it out on the ground. You will listen to operators and leaders to surface real problems, translate those needs into clear requirements for tech partners, and enable local teams to adopt the solution and sustain it without constant central support. Stakeholder management is the largest part of this job.

Analytics is the backbone. You will mine and interpret large-scale operational datasets to find where a region's gaps are, quantify the opportunity behind each solution, and validate through rigorous pre and post analysis that expanded tools actually move the metrics that matter. You will write SQL against large data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) and use visualisation tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to make insights self-service for stakeholders, connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes. You are not expected to own production data engineering, but you should be comfortable pulling, transforming and analysing data independently, framing operational challenges as structured analytical problems, and holding deep technical conversations with engineering and analytics partners.

We are looking for a process improvement leader who enjoys operational analytics and cross-region collaboration, and who can turn a good idea in one geography into a scaled, sustained, data-backed capability in another. You want to find out what a region does not know yet, equip its stakeholders and ACES teams with the right solutions, and make adoption last beyond launch.

Please note: this role is based in the EU and can be located at any EU node. It requires up to 35% travel, primarily within the EU, with occasional travel to partner regions to support rollouts and stakeholder engagement.

Key job responsibilities
- Act as the primary bridge between EU GOX solutions and regional Operations teams, owning the end-to-end expansion of EU tools and mechanisms into a new network.
- Engage deeply with regional Ops stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs, pain points and priorities, and translate them into a clear, data-backed solution roadmap.
- Perform data mining and analysis across multiple systems (Redshift, Athena and other warehouses) to identify the region's gaps, quantify the opportunity, and prioritize which EU solutions to expand.
- Write advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization) to perform root cause analysis and connect systemic issues to shop-floor and customer delivery impact.
- Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytical tools (QuickSight, automated reports) that let regional stakeholders detect problems ahead of customer impact.
- Develop assessments, readouts and reports that communicate rollout progress, adoption and quantified business impact to regional and EU senior leadership.
- Identify and manage the risks, dependencies and cross-region differences (regulatory, network, systems) that affect successful adoption.
- Build a repeatable, data-backed playbook for expanding EU solutions into new regions that scales to additional workstreams over time.


About the team
The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon's EU fulfillment network and beyond, working at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved and delivered. GOX builds the standards, tools and daily management mechanisms that turn performance into a managed system rather than a daily fire-fight. This role extends solutions proven in the EU into new regions, equipping local Operations teams to deliver flawless fulfillment: on time, at speed and at the lowest cost.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
- Experience in program or project management, delivering initiatives from concept to execution.
- Experience with reporting and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI, or other BI packages.
- Experience working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams, including operations.
- Experience working with operations and business teams to communicate problem impacts and understand business requirements.
- Experience with hands-on SQL coding and working with large, complex data sets to design models and scenarios.
- Experience communicating and influencing stakeholders at all levels, including presenting complex, data-backed recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field.
- Experience in operations, transportation, or supply chain.
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements.
- Experience rolling out tools, processes, or mechanisms across multiple sites or regions.
- Experience with data warehouse architectures, data modeling, ETL/ELT, and analytic tools and environments.
- Experience with AWS technologies such as Redshift, S3, Athena, AWS Glue, EMR, Lambda, and IAM.
- Python programming experience for data manipulation (pandas, numpy) and basic statistical analysis.
- Experience partnering with technology teams to translate business needs into system requirements and new features.

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, Security is our highest priority. title: Site EHS Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We're seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to join our mission of creating the world's safest work environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to directly impact associate well being while driving operational excellence.

As a WHS Manager, you'll be the site's safety champion, leading our Global WHS Program implementation. You'll combine hands-on safety management with strategic thinking to protect our most valuable asset – our people. Your role bridges the gap between safety requirements and operational success, requiring both technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. Working closely with Operations leadership, you'll drive safety initiatives that make a real difference. You'll conduct comprehensive risk assessments, analyze safety data, and implement practical solutions that protect associates while supporting productivity. Your ability to build relationships and influence positive change will be essential as you help shape our safety culture. You'll lead safety compliance efforts, conduct thorough site audits, and analyze incident trends to target improvements where they matter most. Managing our first aid program and emergency response capabilities, you'll ensure immediate care is always available. Your analytical skills will transform safety data into actionable insights, while your leadership abilities will help engage associates in our safety mission.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site


For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in WHS and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations
- 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in people and performance management, or 2+ years of Amazon Safety (blue badge/FTE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Distribution Center or Manufacturing EHS experience with mix of exempt and non-exempt employees at a site of at least 250 people
- Master's degree
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment.
- Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization.
- Certified Safety Professional
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort interfacing with site leader
- Ability to develop and implement department goals and strategies.
- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Engagement Manager (EM) to join our team and lead the delivery of complex cloud solution projects. In this role you will combine technical expertise with strong project leadership skills to drive successful implementations of AWS-based solutions for our clients. You will bridge business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating technical discussions and ensuring alignment with customer outcomes. Applying AWS frameworks like Well-Architected and Cloud Adoption Framework while demonstrating technical credibility across diverse stakeholders, you will distill customer needs into clear technical requirements, decompose complex problems, and make informed trade-off decisions considering performance, scalability, security, and business impact.

Possessing strong technology and program/project management experience, you will validate technical solutions against business goals, recognize when additional technical evaluation is needed, and manage technical risks. You will be expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, develop domain-specific expertise, and effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. As you progress, you’ll lead increasingly complex technical projects, shape cross-organizational technical strategies, and establish best practices in your domain. In this role you will apply your management and leadership capabilities to successfully execute project plans, proactively identify and manage risks, resolve issues, escalate when appropriate, and drive projects to successful completion, while exceeding customer expectation.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.


Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology program/project manager, you will be responsible for:
• Leading and managing complex cloud migration and implementation projects
• Leveraging comprehensive knowledge of AWS services, architectures, and best practices to guide technical decisions and strategic planning
• Bridging business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating engineering discussions and ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes
• Distilling customer needs into clear technical requirements and map them to business outcomes
• Decomposing complex technical problems into actionable, deliverable solutions
• Contributing to technical documentation and define documentation standards

A day in the life
• Owning delivery of complex, outcome-based cloud and AI programs end to end, accountable for customer business outcomes, delivery quality and commercial performance
• Working with sales and solution architects before signature to shape scope, define measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, and confirm what we commit to is deliverable
• Negotiating scope, milestones and trade-offs with customer executives, and managing fixed-price engagements through disciplined change control, earned-value tracking and margin protection
• Managing engagement revenue and financial health: forecasting revenue against milestones, maintaining an accurate estimate at completion, driving timely milestone acceptance and billing, and identifying expansion opportunities that grow the customer relationship
• Leading delivery teams that use AI across the lifecycle (requirements, design, code generation, testing and operations), and applying enough technical depth to challenge AI-generated output and make informed trade-offs on security, performance, scalability and cost
• Orchestrating mixed teams of AWS builders, AWS Partner Network partners and customer-selected integrators to a single quality bar, with clear accountability, consistent acceptance criteria and automated quality gates
• Driving customer-side change management and adoption, so the organization realizes the value of what we build
• Reporting progress to senior stakeholders in terms of business value delivered, and acting on leading indicators of risk (velocity, environment stability, partner quality, team health) before they become escalations
• Contributing reusable assets, patterns and AI-enabled delivery practices that make each engagement faster and more repeatable than the last

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Senior Program Manager - Haul & FFO, Global Logistics - Exports
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking qualified Program Manager candidates to join our Cross Border Exports Logistics team. Amazon reaches customers around the globe on all seven continents and needs individuals who want to help ensure fast, cost-effective solutions for delivering packages worldwide. Do you obsess over improving processes to deliver a superior customer experience? Do the words "that can't be done" drive you to find a solution for how "that can be done"? Do you desire a career focused on globalizing B2C delivery service and setting new industry standards? Do you thrive on detailed data analysis to develop optimized processes and drive continuous improvement? If these characteristics describe you, then come join the Amazon.com Cross Border Exports team and help make the world smaller—one package at a time.

The Cross Border Exports team seeks a qualified candidate for the Program Manager-Global Export Logistics role. This position will optimize the Cross-Border exports network to improve delivery speed globally. The role will serve as a logistics partner to the Amazon Exports business team, focusing on prioritizing transportation and logistics requirements to support growth goals. The Program Manager will gather input from various business partners and develop requirement documents for cross-functional teams. They will also acquire knowledge of Amazon fulfillment and transportation systems, international transportation, and logistics to identify and develop products for the growing cross-border network. Attention to detail is crucial to providing faster and more cost-effective delivery options for customers. The ideal candidate should efficiently manage multiple projects, communicate updates regularly, and demonstrate a track record of project delivery and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The successful candidate will collaborate with internal client groups, third-party partners, and technology partners to enhance Amazon's freight transportation management capabilities for customers and key partners in the supply chain. They will define solutions and services that meet the needs of various segments within our supply base (geographical, size-related, sophistication, etc.). As a data-driven company, Amazon values candidates who can adeptly handle and analyze large amounts of data to assess the current state and determine the business impact of technological changes.

Key job responsibilities
This role will be a Program Manager in the Global Exports Production Planning team for the Amazon Haul store. Day-to-day responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Managing tactical and strategic capacity planning for supply chains from China to the US and a rapidly growing list of international destinations
- Developing KPIs and mechanisms for stakeholder engagement to improve supply chain and 3P operation performance

descriptionHtml:

title: Associate Solutions Architect Internship 2027
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as an Associate Solutions Architect Intern and launch your career in cloud computing. Available to work full-time for either 3 or 6 months during 2027, you'll gain hands-on experience designing cloud and generative AI solutions, learning from experienced architects, and working on real AWS projects that impact millions of customers worldwide.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's leading cloud computing platform, helping millions of customers — from startups to global enterprises — build and run applications without managing physical servers. We're seeking motivated individuals for our Associate Solutions Architect Intern program, a structured learning experience designed to develop the next generation of Cloud Solutions Architects.

This internship serves as a pathway to our Solutions Architect Graduate Program, offering you the opportunity to build foundational knowledge in cloud computing, AWS services, and solutions architecture principles in a supportive, education-first environment. You'll learn to understand customer requirements, build working cloud and AI solutions, and communicate technical recommendations effectively while being mentored by experienced Solutions Architects.

Key job responsibilities
Complete a structured training curriculum to build cloud architecture foundations and develop expertise in AWS services
Analyze customer requirements and learn to translate them into technical solution recommendations
Participate in solution design sessions and observe customer engagements with experienced Solutions Architects
Work on a real AWS project, applying architecture principles and building hands-on experience with AWS services
Develop communication skills by learning to present technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences

A day in the life
As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you'll engage in a mix of structured learning and practical application. Your day might include attending training sessions on AWS services and the Well-Architected Framework, then applying those concepts to a real project you're building on AWS. You'll participate in solution design discussions, observing how experienced architects translate customer needs into technical recommendations. You might shadow customer engagements to see how solutions are presented to diverse audiences, then return to work on your own project, experimenting with AWS services and architecture principles. Throughout your internship, you'll develop presentation skills by communicating technical concepts to colleagues and mentors, receiving feedback that helps you grow as a solutions architect.

About the team
We are the EMEA Student Programs Team within AWS, dedicated to nurturing emerging talent in cloud computing. Our team collaborates across the organization to create meaningful internship experiences that bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world cloud architecture. We work with experienced Solutions Architects who are committed to mentoring the next generation of cloud professionals. Together, we're building a community of architects who understand how to solve complex business problems through innovative cloud solutions. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values your growth, supports your learning journey, and helps you develop the skills needed to succeed in cloud consulting and solutions architecture.

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in penultimate or final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, graduating in 2027 or 2028
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish at C1 level or above
- Experience with at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript)
- Right to work in Spain for the duration of the internship
- Understanding of basic IT systems, software development, or system architecture concepts

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including security, storage, or databases (relational and/or NoSQL)
- Understanding of operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)
- Interest in or experience with generative AI, for example building with LLM APIs, agents or AI coding assistants
- Experience with systems administration (Linux/Windows), network administration (DNS, IPsec, BGP, VPN, load balancing), or programming (Node.JS, Java, Ruby, C#, Python, or PHP)
