title: System Development Engineer, Astra ADC
descriptionHtml:
This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon's world-class technical team at HQ2 in Arlington, VA, working with some of the best and brightest engineers while developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative technology companies anywhere.

Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX) Astra ADC provides the foundational services that every Amazon builder depends on to develop, deploy, and operate software from continuous deployment orchestration to testing infrastructure and configuration management. Our team owns and operates critical ASBX services across Amazon's most secure and isolated environments, including Apollo (deployment), Pipelines (continuous delivery), Test on Demand/Hydra (integration testing), AppConfig (feature management), Multi-Region (resource replication), Builder MCP, and AIM (AI agent infrastructure). We ensure these services maintain parity, reliability, and security across all partitions.

A successful Engineer joining the team will do much more than write code and triage problems. They will operate services at scale in air-gapped environments where standard commercial tooling doesn't exist, drive cross-partition deployment parity, and build the automation that keeps Amazon's most sensitive workloads shipping safely. They will dive deep into complex distributed systems issues and work diligently to improve the builder experience.

The ideal candidate will:

- Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.
- Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in large-scale, distributed environments. You understand networking technology, how services communicate across isolated boundaries, and regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and technical post-mortem discussions to identify root causes of complex issues.
- Love to code. Whether it's building deployment automation, creating AI-powered operational tooling, or solving complex cross-partition orchestration problems, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems. You have a solid understanding of software development methodology and CI/CD practices.
- Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions that enable thousands of Amazon builders to ship software reliably across multiple isolated regions. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow delivery at massive scale.
This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.


A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing deployment health across isolated regions, checking alarms and on-call handoffs. Mid-morning, you're deep in a code review for a cross-partition automation fix, then jump into a design discussion on how to bring a new ASBX service capability to air-gapped environments. After lunch, you troubleshoot a deployment pipeline issue, tracing it from orchestration logs to a configuration mismatch, and ship the fix before end of day. Between the technical depth and the autonomy to own problems end-to-end, no two days look the same.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- 2+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby

title: Sr. Data Scientist, EU FBA Supply Chain BIE team
descriptionHtml:
Do you see a seemingly impossible problem and instinctively think “I can figure this out”? Do you have insatiable curiosity and a drive to turn messy, ambiguous questions into rigorous, data-driven answers? Do you want your analysis to change how one of Amazon’s largest businesses runs its supply chain in Europe?

If so, this role is for you.

Our team owns the most ambiguous and complex analytical problems in EU FBA (Fulfilment by Amazon) Supply Chain. Leaders come to us when a question has no playbook: nobody has defined the problem yet; the data does not sit in a dashboard, and the answer needs both scientific rigor and sound business judgement.

As a Data Scientist on this team, you will define problems as well as solve them. You will design the analytical approach, choose methods from a wide toolkit (statistical modelling, experimentation, forecasting, optimization, and machine learning where it earns its place), and deliver insights that shape supply-chain strategy for our EU marketplaces.

A partner BI team in India owns classic data engineering, dashboarding, and periodic reporting, with support from colleagues in Luxembourg. The role therefore splits roughly 70% science and 30% BI enablement and partner-team support. Your focus stays on advanced, ambiguous data science, but you will also apply strong BI-engineering fundamentals (SQL, pipelines, self-service data, and clear reporting) to unblock yourself, support a newer and more junior partner team, and make your science land in the business.

You will work on problems such as forecasting inbound volumes and fulfilment-center capacity, measuring the causal impact of inbound placement and AWD (Amazon Warehousing and Distribution) adoption on cost to serve and seller in-stock rates, designing and analyzing seller-facing experiments on inbound and value-added services, and optimizing removal and recovery decisions for unsellable inventory. You will also help build generative AI (GenAI) tools and agents that put data science directly into the hands of the business.

You will work closely with product managers, program managers, supply-chain stakeholders, and partner data teams, translating between business needs and technical reality and building consensus on what the data says and what we should do about it.


Key job responsibilities
• Lead complex, ambiguous EU FBA Supply Chain problems autonomously, defining the problem and the solution approach rather than executing a predefined analysis.
• Select and apply the right data science methods (e.g. statistical inference, design of experiments, time-series forecasting, clustering and classification, and causal analysis) to deliver decision-grade insights with quantified impact.
• Partner with product managers, program managers, and supply-chain stakeholders to turn ambiguous business questions into tractable analytical problems, and present results to senior leadership.
• Source and combine complex, cross-domain datasets; write robust SQL and, where needed, build or refine the ETL pipelines and data models your analysis depends on.
• Set standards for reporting and self-service artefacts (e.g. Quick Sight or Tableau dashboards and KPI tracking) and unblock the business where needed, while the partner BI team owns build and run.
• Coach and support a newer, more junior partner BI team: share knowledge, review work, and help raise the analytical and engineering bar across locations.
• Drive best practices in analytical rigor, reproducibility, data quality, and operational excellence.


A day in the life
• Work with stakeholders to understand supply-chain priorities and reframe fuzzy questions into well-posed problems.
• Design the analytical approach, weigh trade-offs between methods, and validate your data, assumptions, and results.
• Write and review SQL and Python and strengthen the pipelines or reporting your analysis relies on.
• Communicate findings in written narratives and reviews for technical and management audiences.
• Mentor partner-team members and unblock BI work that supports the wider organization.


About the team
Our team owns the most ambiguous and complex analytical problems in EU FBA (Fulfilment by Amazon) Supply Chain. Leaders come to us when a question has no playbook: nobody has defined the problem yet; the data does not sit in a dashboard, and the answer needs both scientific rigor and sound business judgement.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in causal modeling like graphical models, causal Bayesian network, potential outcomes, A/B testing, experiments, quasi-experiments, and data science workflows
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
- Experience identifying and solving complex problems through data analysis
- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior management

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS Tools and Technologies (Redshift, S3, EC2)
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience with supply chain modeling and other statistical analysis tools
- Experience providing technical leadership and mentoring other engineers for best practices on data engineering
- Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets
- Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages

title: Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
Der operative Geschäftsbereich ist das Herz von Amazon. Ein effektiv ablaufender Betrieb trägt dazu bei, dass Artikel bearbeitet und rechtzeitig an unsere Kund:innen versendet werden. Als Operations Lead erlebst Du, wie alle unterschiedlichen Teile des Betriebs funktionieren und trägst zu einem reibungslosen Ablauf bei.
Du fungierst als erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für Teammitglieder während ihrer Schicht und hilfst ihnen beim Befolgen der Prozesse, die Deine Manager:innen eingeführt haben. Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung und benutzt analytische Systeme, die zum Erfolg unseres Unternehmens beitragen.

Key job responsibilities
- Messung und Überwachung von Arbeitsflüssen, Verfolgen der Leistung am Standort und Bereitstellung wichtiger Schichtinformationen an die Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:innen im Betrieb, um für schichtübergreifende Operational Excellence zu sorgen
- Unterstützung und Schulung von Mitarbeitenden, damit diese großartige Leistungen erbringen können, und Beaufsichtigung ihrer täglichen Aufgaben
- Unterstützung des/der Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei Projekten zur Prozessverbesserung, Förderung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfelds und Erhöhung des Mitarbeiterengagements
- Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, um Lösungen für häufige Probleme zu finden oder Bedürfnisse in wichtigen Leistungsbereichen zu erfüllen
- Nutzung von Datenanalysen, um Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung von Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität zu finden

A day in the life
Als Operations Lead arbeitest Du an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte. Du unterstützt Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Durchführung des Schichtplans. Du hilft bei der Vorbereitung von Schichtbesprechungen mit Deinem Team und überwachst Verfahren und Abläufe. Damit stellst du sicher, dass Sicherheitsregeln, Qualitätssicherungsprozesse und die Prioritäten für den Tag befolgt werden.
Probleme, die Du bemerkst, eskalierst Du an Deine:n Manager:in. Gelegentlich agierst Du auch selbst als Schichtleiter:in und bietest Deinen Mitarbeitenden die notwendige Anleitung, um ihre Aufgaben zu erledigen. Bei Bedarf unterstützt Du Deine:n Schicht-/Bereichsleiter:in bei der Schichtplanung und sorgst dafür, dass zu Stoßzeiten genügend Teammitglieder eingeteilt sind.

About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) ist für schwere oder sperrige Artikel wie Möbel und große Haushaltsgeräte zuständig. Unser Team verantwortet den gesamten Service von der Beschaffung über die Lieferung bis hin zu Produktrücksendungen. Die erweiterte Kundenbetreuung unterscheidet diesen Service von den anderen. Neben der Lieferung von Sperrgut erledigen wir auch das Auspacken, Montieren und Installieren der Neuware und kümmern uns auf Wunsch um den Abtransport der Altgeräte. Unser Fokus liegt auf Sicherheit, Produktivität und Innovation. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Kund:innen sperrige Artikel einfacher und bequemer kaufen und erhalten können.
Wir haben ehrgeizige Pläne, darunter den Ausbau unseres Netzwerks spezieller Logistik- und Verteilzentren im gesamten Vereinigten Königreich und in Europa. Unsere Kolleg:innen an den Logistikstandorten arbeiten gelegentlich auch in der Nachtschicht. Die meisten unserer Teammitglieder arbeiten jedoch tagsüber. Unser Team umfasst Mitarbeitende aus den Bereichen Betriebswirtschaft, Lieferkette, Supply Chain, Business Intelligence und Programmmanagement. Wir alle spielen eine entscheidende Rolle dabei, diesen Teil unseres Unternehmens weiterzuentwickeln.

- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Datenanalytik und deren Anwendung zur Problemerkennung
- Erfahrung mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem Betriebsumfeld, beispielsweise in Logistik, Einzelhandel, Gastgewerbe oder im Kundenservice

title: Ops Support Expert, NASC, North America Supply Chain (NASC)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is a global leader in e-commerce and cloud computing, headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Since its inception in 1995, Amazon has strived to be the world's most customer-centric company, catering to a global customer base, which includes not only consumers but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). Our platform empowers
world-class retail brands and individual sellers to increase sales and reach new customers.

The Process Associate (Level 3) executes defined workflows in an SOP-driven environment, ensuring tasks are completed accurately, consistently, and within SLA timelines. The role requires strict adherence to standard operating procedures, with a focus on quality, productivity, and compliance.

The role operates in a fast-paced environment and requires a self-starter with strong attention to detail and analytical rigor. The candidate should be able to work effectively across teams, partners, and leadership, using data to drive clear and structured communication. The role also requires the ability to independently identify and resolve issues with minimal guidance.

Key job responsibilities
• Execute tasks in line with defined SOPs, ensuring accuracy and turn around time adherence
• Perform input validations and follow checklists to ensure completeness of outputs
• Identify and flag defects, exceptions, and SOP gaps to relevant stakeholders
• Maintain process compliance and documentation standards
• Support volume spikes and task transitions based on business needs
• Navigate internal tools and use MS Office (especially Excel) to track, analyze, and manage data workflows
• Make sound decisions when handling ambiguous or incomplete information
• Adapt to changing priorities, volume spikes, and task transitions without impacting metrics
• Participate in training and cross-skilling across multiple tasks
• Identify operational challenges and recommend improvements, including automation and process enhancements
• Work in rotational shifts within a 24/7 environment with weekly offs on any two days

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written English communication skills
- 1+ years of relevant work experience.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured instructions
- Analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to manage repetitive tasks across different workflows with high accuracy

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL
- Experience in operations or SOP-driven environments
- Familiarity with quality metrics and audit processes
- Ability to handle multiple tasks with quick turnaround times
- Key Metrics: Productivity (TPH/Output per hour), Quality/Error Rate, SLA/TAT adherence, SOP compliance

title: Seasonal MyHR Live Support Sr. Advisor
descriptionHtml:
This is a contract role

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.

Key job responsibilities
• Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees.
• Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
• Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
• Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases.
• Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
• Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
• Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience handling confidential information
- Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
- Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

title: Sr. HR Manager, NACF
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. Through the combination of employee engagement and technology, PXT empowers Amazonians whose dedication and creativity consistently deliver exceptional customer experiences.

The Senior HR Manager is part of the NACF senior leadership team, partnering with leaders at multiple levels to develop strategies, set goals, and deliver business results. You'll own the end-to-end employee experience at the site(s), championing a culture of safety, inclusion, and service. This role requires balancing automation with human insight—leveraging technology, AI, and real-time data to enhance decision-making and support transformational initiatives. You'll lead a high-performing HR team, implementing strategies across employee engagement, talent management, and organizational effectiveness. Success demands strategic thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to drive scalable solutions across sites and regions.

The Senior HR Manager is a strategic, high-judgment leader responsible for delivering operational excellence and scalable PXT impact across the most complex sites. They translate enterprise people strategies into site execution, strengthen leadership capability, and drive systemic improvements in culture, performance, and risk.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility, ensuring personal connection and hands-on leadership where needed.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and create sustainable HR strategies that drive improvements in attrition, attendance, and engagement while setting clear vision for the HR team. Model, train, and coach behavioral expectations and hold operations and HR teams accountable for timely resolution of concerns and maintaining service excellence.

- Work closely with Business Leader(s) as a strategic partner on all people-related decisions, providing leadership coaching and constructive feedback to enhance their capabilities while collaborating on strategies for equitable hiring, retention, development, and performance optimization to build strong, engaged teams.

- Establish effective partnerships with specialized HR functions, including centers of excellence and shared services (e.g., compensation, staffing, recruiting). Challenge status quo and leverage technology to drive improved performance and employee experiences, scaling solutions across the site, region and beyond.

- Collaborate with site and regional leadership teams to harmonize site-specific priorities in alignment with broader organizational goals, with particular focus on diversity & inclusion, employee experience, and talent management initiatives. Use data-driven insights to inform strategy and measure impact.

- Lead, champion, and ensure follow-through on organizational and operational change initiatives. Remove barriers that impede change adoption, balance automation with human judgment, and respond resourcefully to new demands, priorities, challenges or obstacles. Demonstrate high judgment in decision-making while maintaining strong risk management and compliance standards.

- Drive adoption and optimization of HR technology solutions to enhance efficiency, data accuracy, and employee experience. Lead the HR team in developing digital fluency, leveraging analytics for decision-making, and utilizing AI to streamline processes while maintaining a human-centered approach.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic partnership and hands-on people management. You'll navigate multiple priorities, from leadership development to employee engagement initiatives. Balancing immediate needs with long-term objectives, you'll respond to time-sensitive matters while driving strategic workforce planning. Using cutting-edge AI-powered analytics, you'll derive real-time insights to tackle challenges in attrition, attendance, and engagement. You'll collaborate closely with business leaders, guiding them through critical decisions and change management processes. Your expertise will be crucial in analyzing key performance indicators and implementing data-driven solutions. From the production floor to strategy meetings, you'll keep a pulse on workplace culture while steering organizational initiatives. You'll develop and empower your team to leverage innovative HR technologies, enhancing decision-making and operational efficiencies. In this fast-paced environment, you'll have numerous opportunities to innovate and create meaningful impact across your site(s) and broader organization.

About the team
Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs) within North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) are fast-paced environments that utilize robotics, scanning machines, and computer systems that track and allow the delivery of millions of items (and smiles) to households daily.

NACF PXT is a talent cultivator where Amazonians gain a depth of experience and expertise nurtured to grow, flourish and thrive in other business lines across Amazon. Our HR Leaders provide strategic and tactical leadership direction, executing our people initiatives, providing internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement in locations with up to 6,000 associates. NACF's PXT teams are flexible, thoughtful, socially responsible, and are always planning for the future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- 7+ years of human resources leadership, or 7+ years of leadership in operations/customer service/retail/distribution/logistics/healthcare/hospitality/manufacturing experience
- Experience supporting hourly, front-line, and salaried employee populations
- Experience supporting or leading employee-focused processes including onboarding, benefits, investigations, training or talent management
- Proficiency in HR data analysis, including experience translating metrics into actionable workforce strategies and measurable business outcomes

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA
- 5+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, including roles with expanding scope and responsibility
- Knowledge of employment law, employee relations, and compliance requirements
- Experience managing complex employee relations and organizational health initiatives
- Expertise in full-cycle talent management, including strategic workforce planning, talent acquisition, performance management, leadership development, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness
- Track record of building and developing high-performing HR and/or Operations teams
- Experience leading successful HR initiatives in fast-paced operational environments
- Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to influence, communicate effectively, and manage conflict
- Ability to advance technology initiatives, including AI integration and emerging tools, to drive operational excellence
- Experience partnering with, coaching, and guiding senior leaders as a strategic HR business partner

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

title: InfraOps Support Manager, Operations Management Center (OMC)
descriptionHtml:
The InfraOps Support Manager leads a two-tiered team of engineers within Amazon's Operations Management Center (OMC) -a 24/7/365 team that keeps the technology inside Amazon's 400+ corporate office buildings running across Networking, Audio-Visual (AV), and Print services.

As one of OMC's regional managers, this role owns a segment of the team's follow-the-sun coverage (the model in which AMER, EMEA, and APAC teams hand work across time zones for continuous 24/7 coverage). The manager balances hands-on technical leadership with people management: they run day-to-day operations to meet service levels, develop and coach engineers, build and maintain operational mechanisms, drive operational inspection and continuous improvement, and partner closely with Service Managers/Owners and IT Services partner teams. They work with minimum supervision to deliver operational changes and projects focused on infrastructure services, and thrive in an ambiguous, collaborative environment while building high-performing teams.

Key job responsibilities
On a typical week, an InfraOps Support Manager will:

1. Operational Leadership & Service Delivery

Keep the 24/7 operation healthy and meeting its commitments.

Lead the team to deliver results, ensure the operation runs properly, meets SLAs, and drives the right customer outcomes across Networking, AV, and Print.

Audit work queues and SLA adherence; audit engineers' work to ensure results are high-quality.

Own a portion of follow-the-sun coverage: build and maintain gap-free shift schedules and a sustainable on-call rotation that supports 24/7 operations without burning out engineers.

Manage difficult problems and escalations, identify and mitigate immediate risks before they become roadblocks, and decide when to handle directly versus escalate.

Make operational trade-offs across time, quality, and resources.

2. Operational Inspection & Continuous Improvement

Inspect the operation and make it measurably better.

Perform operational inspection: establish and run mechanisms (e.g., weekly operations reviews) that inspect performance metrics and drive corrective action.

Prioritize root-cause resolution and process improvements; partner with teams to improve mechanisms and drive enhancements.

Dive deep into incident causes, and establish, iterate, and deploy best practices across OMC and its partner teams.

Identify and optimize workflows and best practices for operational excellence.

3. People Management & Talent Development

Build and grow a high-performing team.

Hire, attract, and onboard bar-raising talent; own customized onboarding plans that ramp new engineers quickly.

Set clear performance expectations and provide regular feedback; hold regular 1:1s and team meetings.

Evaluate engineers against the appropriate role guidelines, participate in calibration, and clearly document performance and progression.

Coach and develop engineers toward their career goals; lead the promotion process for those consistently performing at the next level.

Address underperformance by clearly documenting the required change, communicating it respectfully with a timeframe, and seeking guidance from HR and leadership as needed.

Navigate challenging conversations with empathy, escalating or seeking HR/leadership guidance when appropriate.

Create and continuously improve a team environment where every engineer feels valued, trusted, connected, and informed, and support work-life harmony across time zones.

4. Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Represent the team up, down, and across.

Work closely with Service Managers/Owners and IT Services partner teams to resolve escalations and align priorities.

Communicate the team's mission, vision, and priorities, helping engineers see how their work contributes to organization goals.

Be clear and concise in verbal and written communication (narratives, WBR/MBR/QBR); put the right people in the room; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three levels above.

Write clear documentation and may be accountable for Correction of Error (COE) write-ups.

5. Technical Leadership

Stay close enough to the technology to lead it well.

Maintain a solid understanding of the design approaches and technologies used by the team (Networking, AV, Print) to guide technical decisions and trade-offs.

Lead the team through building, implementing, and managing solutions to difficult operational problems.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of leading technology teams as a information technology operations manager experience, or Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 4+ years of professional or military experience
- Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP(S), DNS, and TCP/IP
- 2+ years of Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM experience
- Experience in technical support

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of developing a team of technical professionals across multiple locations experience
- Experience in managing an engineering team operating at scale
- Experience supporting video conference and teleconference equipment
- Experience hiring, developing and promoting engineering talent
- ITIL V3 certification

title: Software Development Manager, Prime Video Premium Ad Products, Amazon Prime Video Ads
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead the engineering team building Prime Video Advertising's premium ad products. Prime Video Advertising reaches 315MM+ monthly viewers across 20 countries and is on a path from $5.3B in 2026 to an aspirational $10B by 2029, with premium products among the fastest-scaling parts of that business. This is a builder-and-leader role at the intersection of high growth and hard technical problems: you will own the multi-year technical strategy for the portfolio, grow and develop a team of senior engineers, and be accountable for delivering enterprise-scale ad-serving capabilities in a fast-moving, ambiguous space. You will set direction across partner teams spanning Prime Video, Publishers Technology, PAS, and ADSP, and turn today's manual, managed-service setup into self-service experiences that reach thousands of advertisers. If you want outsized impact on a rapidly expanding business, come help us work hard, have fun, and make history.

Key job responsibilities
Own the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and delivery for Prime Video's premium ad products — Sponsorships, FITO, and Streamweaver — across two or more annual planning cycles.

Lead the engineering strategy to make Sponsorship a first-class citizen in Publishers Technology's deal model, replacing behaviors scattered across IMS CBP templates, PubTech Rules, and bespoke systems with native, runtime-enforced ad-serving logic.

Drive the architecture for Streamweaver's expansion beyond Prime Video to FAST, Live Sports, Fire TV, Twitch, and Stores — including cross-publisher session awareness, roadblocking coordination, and the deal model that unifies the buy.

Resolve the platform gaps blocking scale: self-service campaign activation in ADSP, removal of the collection-slot ceiling that constrains title targeting, and a real-time inventory/calendaring backend that prevents overbooking at the point of purchase.

Set and hold a high engineering bar — system design, operational excellence, on-call health, and quality — for enterprise systems that serve premium ad experiences globally.

Grow, coach, and develop a team of senior software engineers; hire to close capability gaps; and create a culture of ownership, rapid experimentation, and measurable customer impact.

Build relationships and earn trust with partner teams (Prime Video, PubTech, PAS, ADSP, FAA/Forecasting, Ads Trust) and represent the team's strategy to senior leadership in planning, reviews, and escalations.

Reduce operational load structurally — turn recurring on-call and setup toil into platform automation rather than perpetual manual work.

A day in the life
No two days are the same, but most balance people leadership, technical direction, and cross-team execution. You coach engineers in 1:1s, push for simple, flexible designs in reviews, and keep sprints focused on what matters. You partner with product and partner-team leaders to turn ambiguous needs into clear roadmaps, and you clear the dependencies and escalations only you can. You go deep where it counts — a design, a build-vs-reuse tradeoff, an operational issue — while keeping the multi-quarter picture in view. On any given day one workstream (Streamweaver, for example) might need a launch-readiness call while another needs a partner team unblocked. Throughout, you balance shipping reliably today with building for the years ahead, and invest in the mechanisms and culture that let the team move fast without you in the critical path.

About the team
We are the Amazon Prime Video Ads Engineering team within APM Prime Video Advertising. We build the premium ad products — Sponsorships, First Impression Takeover (FITO), and Streamweaver, our cross-Amazon storytelling platform — that let a single advertiser tell one coordinated brand story across Prime Video, Fire TV, Twitch, and Stores, and that generate roughly 1.5x more revenue per ad hour than standard video ads. Our charter is scaling that impact: extending storytelling to new surfaces, opening self-service and automated creative workflows, and making Sponsorship a native, first-class capability in the Publishers Technology stack. It's a rare chance to own a premium product line with a real shot at becoming one of the largest ad businesses in streaming.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience

descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) in Canberra to work with our Public Sector customers. In this role, you'll work closely with customers to understand their technical requirements and business objectives, designing and implementing tailored cloud solutions. You'll be a key player in the pre-sales process, providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the customer's cloud journey.

In this role, you'll be responsible for creating and leading the solution design to address customer business outcomes (CBO). Operating as the conduit between ProServe Account Executives and our Proserve Delivery Teams, you’ll ensure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and optimize ProServe and/or our partners to maximize customer business outcomes. As a PCA you are a trusted advisor to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions to address customer challenges. As a technical SME, you will share knowledge within the organization, through mentoring, training, creation of reusable artifacts and process improvements. A critical aspect of this role involves hands-on technical engagement with customers, particularly in the rapidly evolving areas of Agentic AI and Generative AI (GenAI).

Your experience in designing technical solutions within the technology/consulting sector, will equip you with the ability to architect complex, scalable, and secure cloud solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer, translating technical concepts into business value. Your success as a PCA will be linked to impacting sales, and the successful implementation of the customer solutions.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Note: Successful candidate will need to hold or be able to attain an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency clearance (see https://www.agsva.gov.au/applicants/eligibility-and-suitability)

Key job responsibilities

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: AWS Sr. Partner Sales Manager, TMEGS Partner Sales
descriptionHtml:
The Partner Sales Manager (PSM) is a quota-carrying sales professional responsible for co-sell execution from partner selection through close, driving partner-delivered revenue across an industry-aligned territory. The role requires matching partner capabilities to active customer needs, positioning joint value to field and customer stakeholders, and maintaining pipeline discipline across one or more sales territories.

Operating across AWS Marketplace, cloud migrations, and Generative AI, the PSM engages customer, partner, and AWS field stakeholders to build pipeline, increase partner-led deal flow, and deliver revenue against quota.

The ideal candidate operates with minimal direction, prioritizes decisively, escalates with context when deals exceed scope, and builds credibility through consistent execution.

Key job responsibilities
SALES — Revenue Achievement, Co-Sell Execution & Partner Solution Positioning
Achieve Revenue Targets: Own direct quota accountability across an industry-aligned territory, co-selling with GSI/SIs and ISVs. Prospect, qualify, develop, and close partner-delivered opportunities through joint pursuit plans that align partner capabilities to specific customer outcomes. Maintain pipeline accuracy across AWS and partner CRM systems, advance deals from qualification to close, and deploy co-sell funding mechanisms to compress sales cycles.

Execute Co-Sell Motions: Co-sell with GSI, SI, and ISV partners to accelerate pipeline and close revenue. Engage partners early in joint accounts to shape deals and establish credibility. Position joint solutions alongside field sellers by connecting partner capabilities to specific customer outcomes. Structure deals to simplify procurement and compress sales cycles.

Drive Migration-Attached Revenue: Lead cross-functional deal progression for migration opportunities — coordinating GSI/SI delivery partners, positioning solution options (mainframe modernization, DC exit, VMware displacement, app rationalization), and building multi-stakeholder consensus across procurement, IT leadership, and business owners. Accelerate client migration of legacy environments to AWS at scale.


ALLIANCES — Strategic Partner Development & Industry Ecosystem Building
Develop Strategic Partner Relationships: Build and deepen partner relationships that unlock new line-of-business personas and buying centers within customer accounts. Drive pipeline creation through joint account planning, QBRs, and targeted scale campaigns with the One Partner Team — mapping partner capabilities to high-priority workloads and active customer initiatives to generate qualified co-sell opportunities.

Shape Partner Co-Sell Deals Through AWS Marketplace: Identify, structure, and advance partner-sourced opportunities that solve customer challenges in areas such as regulatory compliance, data modernization, security, and digital transformation — aligning the right ISV solution to the right business outcome.

Accelerate Marketplace Adoption: Articulate the financial and operational benefits of consolidated ISV purchasing to procurement, vendor management, and business stakeholders. Position Marketplace as the single platform where clients evaluate and purchase partner solutions — simplifying procurement and reducing cost.


OPERATIONS — Execution Rigor & Cross-Functional Orchestration
Own Territory Strategy: Mobilize cross-functional resources across field sales, solution architects, AWS Professional Services, business development, and partner delivery organizations to drive sales velocity. Develop and execute territory plans that map specific partner capabilities to customer transformation priorities — Marketplace adoption, migration programs, and Generative AI readiness — with defined owners, timelines, and success metrics.

Maintain Operational Discipline: Ensure CRM accuracy, forecast precision, and program utilization tracking. Use AI tools to produce pipeline briefs and risk assessments for leadership. Execute through the OneTeam model, holding cross-functional stakeholders accountable to shared commitments.

Deliver Against Goals and Mitigate Risk Proactively: Identify blockers early, escalate with context and proposed resolution paths, route field feedback to close execution gaps, and engage the right stakeholders to unblock stalled deals — accelerating close and protecting partner and customer trust.

title: Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Preferred qualifications

title: Ingénieur Automaticien (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Présent en France depuis plus de vingt ans, Amazon s'appuie sur des sites ancrés dans les régions pour servir des millions de clients chaque jour.

Le centre de distribution de Chalon-sur-Saône est l'un des premiers ouverts en France — le troisième établissement du réseau français. Ce site historique et stratégique porte en lui des années d'exploitation industrielle, des équipements éprouvés, des systèmes à faire évoluer. C'est précisément ce qui rend le défi intéressant.

Au sein de l'équipe Reliability, Maintenance & Engineering (RME), vous êtes l'interface entre la fiabilité opérationnelle, la modernisation technique et l'impact direct sur les clients. Votre expertise y trouvera un terrain d'application concret et durable.


Key job responsibilities
- Santé et sécurité : appliquer et promouvoir rigoureusement les meilleures pratiques sur tous les systèmes automatisés, identifier les risques de manière proactive et contribuer à l'objectif zéro incident — la santé et sécurité de chaque membre de l'équipe guide chaque décision technique.
- Fiabilité opérationnelle : superviser, diagnostiquer et optimiser les systèmes automatisés critiques (convoyeurs, systèmes de tri, réseaux industriels) pour maximiser la disponibilité des équipements et garantir la fluidité des opérations 24h/24.
- Amélioration continue : analyser les données de performance, identifier les marges de progrès et mettre en œuvre des solutions concrètes pour fiabiliser les installations et intégrer de nouvelles technologies sur un site en pleine évolution.
- Expertise technique et documentation : programmer selon la norme IEC 61131-3, interpréter les schémas techniques et maintenir une documentation précise et à jour de l'ensemble des systèmes — essentiel sur un site à fort historique technique.
- Collaboration et transmission : travailler avec les équipes françaises et internationales du réseau RME, partager l'expertise avec les techniciens et élever le niveau de compétences collectif du site.


A day in the life
En tant qu’ingénieur automaticien, vous assurerez le bon fonctionnement des principaux systèmes automatisés. Vous travaillerez avec nos machines d’automatisation, des convoyeurs aux systèmes de tri, et veillerez à ce qu’elles fonctionnent de manière optimisée. Si quelque chose n’a pas fonctionné ou peut être amélioré, vous prendrez l’initiative de trouver et de mettre en œuvre une solution.
Vous partagerez également votre expertise avec vos proches collaborateurs·trices. Vous veillerez à ce que vos ingénieurs techniciens restent à l’avant-garde des dernières nouveautés en matière de dépannage des appareils et de maintenance préventive, afin de maintenir nos systèmes d’automatisation en parfait état.

About the team
Rejoignez une équipe d'experts passionnés qui garantit l'excellence opérationnelle de notre réseau logistique européen. Nous combinons expertise technique pointue, esprit analytique et collaboration étroite pour maintenir nos installations au meilleur niveau.

Basic qualifications

- Diplôme de niveau Bac+2 minimum (BUT, BTS, Licence pro) ou diplôme d'école d'ingénieurs en automatisme, génie électrique ou électronique industrielle.
- Expérience confirmée en automatisation par automate programmable (PLC) et diagnostic dans un environnement de production continue.
- Expérience pratique sur convoyeurs, systèmes de tri ou équipements mécatroniques en environnement industriel.
- Maîtrise de la manutention automatisée, de la visualisation des flux et du contrôle de processus.
- Français courant indispensable ; anglais professionnel requis pour la documentation technique et les échanges avec les équipes internationales.
- Compétences techniques (au moins une)
- Programmation Ladder : Siemens (TIA Portal / Step 7), Allen-Bradley (Studio 5000) ou Codesys.
- Ignition SCADA ou plateformes IHM équivalentes.
- Réseaux industriels : EthernetIP, Profinet, Profibus, AS-i.
- Variateurs de fréquence, passerelles de sécurité, dispositifs I/O distribués.

Preferred qualifications

- Connaissance des normes de sécurité fonctionnelle ISO 13849 et IEC 62061.
- Expérience sur des installations industrielles à fort historique technique ou en environnement multi-sites.
- Maîtrise de méthodologies de gestion de projet (Agile, Waterfall) et sens de la planification.
- Certification Six Sigma ou expérience en analyse de données et amélioration des processus.
- Diplôme spécialisé en informatique industrielle, robotique ou automatisme avancé.

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

title: Innovation & Design Engineer, Worldwide Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon has created one of the most sophisticated supply chains in the world. From the introduction of Amazon Prime, to the use of drones for package delivery, Amazon has consistently driven change from the front of the pack.

Amazon is now searching for a handful of innovative and solutions oriented engineers to be a part of our global initiative of developing and delivering next generation of world-class fulfillment and transportation systems. If the idea of using ground-breaking technologies to develop intermodal logistics systems on an unprecedented scale has your attention, then keep reading.

As an Innovation and Design Engineer, you will be able to work with some of the most talented engineers in the design and development of physical distribution systems around the globe. A successful candidate will have an established background in developing high-performance physical systems, a strong technical problem solving ability, excellent project management skills, and an internal motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced and often ambiguous environment. Amazon’s culture encourages innovation and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems.

Come help us make history.

Key job responsibilities
- Invent, design, and implement engineering solutions to complex material flow/transformation and human/machine efficiency problems throughout the global Amazon supply chain.
- Lead and coordinate design and innovation efforts to develop optimal solutions for the transportation network through equipment specification, material flow, process design, site layout, and intellectual property considerations.
- Collaboration with internal teams and external vendors to generate high quality, cost effective solutions in very short periods of time.
- Simultaneously manage multiple projects and tasks while effectively influencing, negotiating, and communicating with internal and external business partners, contractors and vendors.
- Provide technical leadership for large-scale engineering projects.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits for you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Our team shapes the future of Amazon's fulfillment network from the earliest stage of design process. Within Worldwide Design and Engineering, you'll govern the design inputs that guide billions in infrastructure investment and define how Amazon serves customers globally. This role demands strategic thinking at both macro levels (tracing how one input change ripples through the network) and micro levels (mastering the operational detail behind each formula). You'll earn trust with senior stakeholders, dive deep into complex data to challenge assumptions, and own the inputs that teams across Amazon build on. We're seeking an exceptional leader who brings structure to ambiguity, weighs hard trade-offs, and delivers impact at scale. Your work here will carry into every generation of Amazon buildings to come.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in management of engineering design projects
- Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
- 2+ years of Design/Innovation, research & development, manufacturing, process, industrial engineering, or related experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Engineering (any domain) or foreign equivalent, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
- Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
- Experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high-speed manufacturing
- Experience in technical leadership for industrial engineering projects or programs
- Experience in running SQL queries and data mining

title: Developer Advocate, Developer Experience
descriptionHtml:
Are you a developer who loves sharing knowledge and building bridges between technology and people? Do you get excited about explaining complex technical concepts in simple terms? Are you passionate about helping other developers succeed and growing developer communities? If you're a natural teacher with deep technical expertise and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you!

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Developer Advocate to join our team in Tokyo, Japan. In this role, you'll spearhead our developer engagement efforts across Japan, driving adoption of AWS services and fostering a thriving developer ecosystem.

Key job responsibilities
As a Developer Advocate, you'll create engaging technical content, including tutorials, blog posts and sample applications, that helps developers succeed with our platform. You'll represent our company at conferences, meetups, and online events, delivering technical talks and workshops that educate and inspire. You'll gather developer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and work closely with our engineering teams to ensure our platform meets developer needs. Your role will involve building and nurturing relationships with developer communities, contributing to open-source projects, and establishing yourself as a trusted voice in the technical community.

A day in the life
Your typical day might begin with reviewing and responding to developer questions on our community forums, followed by working on a technical blog post. You might spend the middle of your day collaborating with the product team on upcoming features, sharing insights gathered from the developer community.

After lunch, you could be recording a tutorial video demonstrating best practices, then joining a remote meetup to give a technical presentation. Later, you might work on code samples for an upcoming workshop or participate in planning discussions for a developer conference.

Throughout the day, you're engaging with developers on social media, sharing insights, and staying current with industry trends while maintaining your technical expertise through hands-on coding.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
- 8+ years of full stack development experience
- Strong programming skills in one or more modern programming languages
- Experience creating technical content (blogs, tutorials, hands-on workshops)
- Excellent communication and public speaking skills, with experience delivering technical content to developers of varied backgrounds.
- Demonstrable experience engaging with developer communities, including meetups, conferences, or active participation on platforms like GitHub, Stack Overflow, or developer forums.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience working with AWS Services
- Willingness to travel as required

descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wanted to solve a mystery or be part of solving a case? Are you fascinated by detective stories or crime shows on TV? Do you love to catch bad actors, build ML models and solve complex problems. If so, working on the WWOS Tech team as an Applied Scientist is the place for you!

We detect theft, fraud and organized crime happening across our global supply chain and operations for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the cost savings of Amazon's inventory losses.

The primary role of an Applied Scientist within Amazon is to address business challenges through building a compelling case, and using data to influence change across the organization. This individual will be given responsibility on their first day to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Decisions and tools made in this role will have significant impact to the customer experience, as it will have a major impact on all the fraud investigations happening across Amazon operations.

Ideal candidates will be a high potential, strategic and analytic graduate with a PhD in ( Research, Statistics, Engineering, and Supply Chain) ready for challenging opportunities in the core of our world class operations space. Great candidates have a history of building fraud detections, detecting organized crime and the ability to use data and research to make changes. This individual will need to be able to work with a team, but also be comfortable making decisions independently, in what is often times an ambiguous environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Own KPIs that measure theft/fraud management performance and efficiencies.
- Detect and automate theft, fraud MOs
- Detect organized crime rings and bad actor clusters
- Perform end to end evaluation of operational defects, system gaps, and scaling challenges (both system and operational).

- Integrate ML detection models via software applications

We believe that building a culture that is welcoming and inclusive is integral to people doing their best work and is essential to what we can achieve as a company. We actively recruit people from diverse backgrounds to build a supportive and inclusive workplace. Our team puts a high value on work-live balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development
