title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.

descriptionHtml:
Account Manager (AM) supporting a strategic Artificial Intelligence program for the Intelligence Community. The AM leads a cross-functional team of AWS professionals spanning Solutions Architecture, Enterprise Support, and Professional Services to deliver cloud computing and AI solutions to mission-critical national security customers. This role requires a balance of technical leadership with senior executives, deep expertise in Cloud Computing and Artificial Intelligence, and the ability to translate complex mission requirements into scalable cloud-native solutions. The AM drives strategic account growth, manages the full customer lifecycle, and serves as the primary point of contact for executive stakeholders. Strong problem-solving, communication, and relationship management skills are essential, along with the ability to navigate the unique procurement and security requirements of the Intelligence Community.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance.

Key job responsibilities
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for senior Intelligence Community executives, developing and executing strategic account plans that align AWS cloud and AI capabilities with customer mission objectives. Lead a cross-functional AWS team—including Solutions Architects, Professional Services, and Enterprise Support—to deliver integrated, mission-focused solutions. Translate complex IC requirements into scalable cloud-native and AI-driven architectures that meet stringent security and compliance standards. Build and maintain executive-level relationships with program managers, technical directors, and contracting officers through regular business reviews and strategic planning sessions. Drive revenue growth by managing a robust pipeline across AI, cloud migration, and mission modernization, while navigating IC-specific procurement vehicles such as IDIQs, task orders, and OTAs. Collaborate with partners to develop joint go-to-market strategies and proposals. title: Sr. Distribution Partner Development Manager, Malaysia, APJ Partner Development
descriptionHtml:
Come and join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as we redefine the IT Industry. We are building a business that has the potential to be at least as big as the Amazon.com retail business and are seeking world class candidates to contribute to this effort. As the Malaysia Distribution Partner Development Manager, you will help scale the delivery of industry leading, transformative partner programs that support the AWS distribution partner cohort in building and differentiating their high-value products, solutions and services that accelerate AWS Distribution Partners in building a successful cloud practice.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an incredibly fast-growing business. The ideal candidate is experienced in building partner programs and has a proven ability to learn new technologies fast. The Distribution Partner Development Manager can effectively influence both technical and non-technical audiences up to the senior executive level. A primary responsibility of this role will be to execute a strategy for acquiring and nurturing a requisite set of Distributors and partners across multiple technology stacks. The ability to identify, prioritize and build relationships with the most strategic of these partners is essential. The right individual will need to focus on driving top line revenue growth and customer adoption through these partners. They will also work to ensure each partner chooses AWS as the preferred platform for their customers.
This role will challenge both your creative and analytical skills. You will build relationships with business stakeholders within AWS and with AWS distribution partners, become a subject matter expert in the distribution channel segment and drive both new partners and new sales campaigns in support of AWS Channel Partners.


Key job responsibilities
• Support the execution of the technology services distribution programs in Malaysia and in other ASEAN countries
• Develop structured processes around onboarding, enabling and supporting distribution partners for business and operations
• Work across regional sales and partner teams to nurture a cohort of strategic distribution partners that add significant value to AWS Channel Partners
• Serve as a key member of the AWS distribution team in helping to define and deliver the overall go-to-market strategy
• Own reporting of the distribution business and participate in regular business reviews with leadership and stakeholders
• Utilize salesforce.com and other internal Amazon systems to track key performance metrics
• Willingness to travel 20% and travel mostly in ASEAN.


A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.

Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Fire TV Devices Business Development Team
descriptionHtml:
The vision of the Fire TV organization is to create devices that allow our customers to experience the streamed content, games and apps that they most enjoy from all the range of TVs, brands they like across the world. Fire TV has focused on finding and engaging with the user's content and presenting it on the 'best screen in the house'.

As our device-maker partners grow their global footprint, we are looking for a Solutions Architect who can be the technical bridge between Amazon product and engineering teams and external partners, including original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), original design manufacturers (ODMs), system-on-chip (SoC) vendors, and component suppliers.

In this role you will combine technical knowledge of device hardware/software, Cloud Services, and AI/Voice services with the business acumen to engage partner leadership at the CTO level. You will guide partners through the full product lifecycle, from reference architecture selection and hardware bring-up to software integration and global launch. If you are a curious, collaborative problem-solver who thrives where technology meets business development, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Act as the trusted technical advisor to partner CTO-level executives, translating their business goals into technology strategies that accelerate time-to-launch for devices shipping globally.
- Advise partners across the full Fire TV stack — device hardware/software, cloud and streaming services, and Alexa voice integration — helping them adopt new capabilities and deliver innovative customer experiences.
- Collaborate with internal product, engineering, and UX teams to represent partner and end-customer needs, shaping product specifications and roadmap priorities.
- Lead technical reviews of Fire TV device specifications and capabilities to share best practices and resolve integration challenges.
- Build scalable self-service tooling and reusable reference artifacts that help partners onboard and integrate more efficiently.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a video call alongside an OEM engineering team working through a hardware bring-up issue on a new SoC platform, followed by a design review with the Fire TV software team to align on an upcoming integration milestone. After lunch you could be drafting a technical best-practices guide for partner onboarding, then joining a business development call to advise on the feasibility of a new device concept. You will regularly travel to meet partners and teammates around the world, building the relationships that turn ideas into products customers love.

About the team
The Fire TV Devices Business Development and Solutions Architecture team partners with TV manufacturers and SoC vendors worldwide to bring Fire TV-powered smart TVs to customers globally. Our team is distributed across multiple regions, and we work where hardware, software, and business strategy meet. We are investing in AI-powered tooling and self-service platforms to help partners integrate faster while maintaining the high-quality customer experience Fire TV is known for. If you want to shape how millions of people interact with their television, this is the team to join.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience with one or more of: embedded systems / consumer devices, cloud-based or streaming media services, or voice/AI-driven experiences — including how they integrate into an end-to-end product
- Experience working directly with external partners (OEM/ODM, content/streaming, or platform partners) in a technical advisory, integration, or solutions role
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Mandarin and English

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience spanning more than one layer of the stack — e.g., device + cloud, streaming service + client integration, or voice/AI services integrated into a consumer product
- Experience working cross-functionally with business development, product, and partner engineering teams to land technical deals
- Familiarity with the TV / smart display / streaming devices (silicon vendors, panel makers, ODMs, content/streaming providers)

title: Principal Product Manager, Freight Express, Amazon Supply Chain Services
descriptionHtml:
You are a Principal Product Manager who has owned product at scale inside complex, rapidly growing organizations the kind of environment where the hardest part is not shipping features, but setting a durable product direction that senior leaders and multiple teams align to. You think in systems and economics, you are relied on to be right a lot, and you have a track record of turning a messy, multi-dependency problem into a single product that customers choose.

You bring deep analytical judgment you are comfortable diving into unit economics, reliability and performance data, and the cost and margin structure of a product, and you use that insight to decide where to place the long-term bets. You are equally strong at influencing across organizations without direct authority, aligning operations, network, commercial, finance, compliance, and engineering leaders behind one plan, and engaging senior leadership to secure investment and drive high-stakes decisions.

The domain for this role is Freight Express at Amazon Air Cargo how Amazon moves freight gateway-to-gateway, extends it into a true door-to-door experience, and connects international lanes into the domestic network across the US and EU. Deep freight, transportation, or logistics experience is a strong plus, but it is not the gate. If you have operated a product at scale, reason fluently from data and economics, and have influenced broadly across a large organization, we want to talk to you we will bring you up the domain curve.

The Product: Freight Express
Freight Express spans three connected layers. The opportunity is to define a single, coherent product promise across all of them — not a stack of disconnected legs.

Gateway-to-gateway — the existing Amazon Air Cargo airport-to-airport experience, from booking through air movement to arrival.
End-to-end with ground — extend the product into a door-to-door experience by integrating first-mile and last-mile ground into a single, reliable freight offering.

International — enable international lanes to feed into the domestic Freight Express network, connecting cross-border origins into the end-to-end product.

You will own the Freight Express product experience across both the US and EU, accounting for the regulatory, operational, and commercial differences between regions while holding a consistent product bar — deciding where the product converges across regions and where it must adapt.



Key job responsibilities
Own the end-to-end product strategy for Freight Express and define the product customer-back across all three layers. Make the hard trade-offs between operational feasibility and customer experience, decide when to build versus influence a platform or operations team’s roadmap, and ensure capabilities land in the right long-term home. Set strategy that other senior leaders and teams align to.

Deep-dive the data and economics:
Instrument the product and define success metrics up front, then dive deep into lane economics, transit-time and connection reliability, first- and last-mile ground performance, customs and cross-border delays, and the cost and margin structure of the end-to-end product. Measure actual performance against the product promise and the business case, identify the highest-impact quality gaps from the data (connection misses, ground exceptions, customs delays, failure modes), and feed them back into the product and network.

Influence and lead across organizations:
Drive alignment across air gateway operations, ground first/last-mile carriers, international and customs operations, commercial, finance, compliance, and engineering — across the US and EU, without direct authority. Translate hard operational constraints (gateway cutoffs, ground pickup/delivery timing, cross-border clearance) into a single recommended path, eliminate fragmented ownership and missed handoffs across the air-to-ground and international-to-domestic seams, and unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations.

Own the full product lifecycle and quality:
Run the product cycle end to end — product definition and strategy, capability enhancement that closes gaps across the air and ground legs and the international feed, performance measurement, and continuous quality improvement. Continuously evolve the product based on customer feedback, operational quality and cost, and P&L outcomes.


A day in the life
Set the strategic direction for the Freight Express product across teams — aligning air, ground, international, commercial, and engineering around one gateway-to-gateway-to-door product definition.
Deep dive into data (lane economics, connection and on-time performance, ground first/last-mile reliability, customs and cross-border delays, customer feedback) to shape the roadmap and decide where to invest for maximum reliability and margin impact.

Run the product cycle end to end — move initiatives from strategy to requirements to capability launch, then measure outcomes, surface quality gaps, and feed them back into the next iteration.
Partner with engineering and operations leaders across the US and EU to shape network and product design, ensuring the product scales and holds its service promise in both regions.

Unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations; frame program narratives for senior leadership — connecting network and product progress to business outcomes.
Spend time with Ops teams and in the network — air gateways and ground legs — to pressure-test whether the product performs for shippers in the real world.

What this takes
Someone who toggles between deep product and operational insight and strategic product leadership — owning the full product cycle across air and ground, domestic and international, US and EU — and turning a complex multi-modal, multi-region network into a single reliable Freight Express product that shippers choose.

Basic qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.  Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.

Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.  Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders management.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

title: Senior Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes
Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardise processes across the EU network

A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an EU-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- 4 years UK certified apprenticeship
- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience working as a technical lead
- Experience in electrical or mechanical engineering
- Experience in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments, or experience in similar environments
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in Mechatronics or a related technical field
- Experience in vendor management
- Experience with robotic maintenance
- Experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead
- Experience working with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards in accordance with OEM requirements
- Experience of multi-contractor management
- Experience with PLC-controlled automation
- Experience working with CMMS software, or experience in planning, scheduling and auditing maintenance activities
- Bachelor's degree in relevant field of operations

title: Teamleiter Instandhaltung (m/w/d), RME Team
descriptionHtml:
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

Schichtmuster: Diese Rolle beinhaltet die Arbeit in Schichtmustern, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können.

WIR BIETEN:

- Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon.
- Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und die Chance, an verschiedenen Schulungen und Seminaren teilzunehmen, die von Amazon und externen Partnern angeboten werden.
- Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket mit beschränkten Mitarbeiteraktien (Restricted Stock Units durch die Amazon.com, Inc.) und Mitarbeiterrabatt.
- Zusätzliche Leistungen wie z.B. Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und eine Lebens- und Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung.
- Familienbonus (Einmalzahlung für Mütter sowie Eltern in Elternzeit).
- Ein kostenloses Mitarbeiterhilfeprogramm (auch für Familienmitglieder) für eine Beratung bei beruflichen oder privaten Angelegenheiten.
- Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld und unser Tandemprogramm helfen dir, Kontakte zu knüpfen und ein internes Netzwerk aufzubauen.

Besuche uns auf www.aboutamazon.de für eine virtuelle Tour durch unsere Logistikzentren und um mehr über Amazon als Arbeitgeber zu erfahren.

Key job responsibilities
- Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards
- Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf
- Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung
- Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen
- Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk

A day in the life



Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren.

Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften.

Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können. Mit den Kenntnissen und Erfahrungen, die Du sammelst, wirst Du Dich zu weiteren Führungspositionen weiterentwickeln.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren.

Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben.

Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt. Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden.

Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK) oder Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Zusätzlich, eine abgeschlossene Qualifikation als Industriemeister, Handwerksmeister oder Staatlich Geprüfter/Anerkannter Techniker oder mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung
- Praktische Erfahrung im Führen von Teams
- Erfahrung in der Automatisierung und Instandhaltung von Förderanlagen
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Grundsprachkenntnisse in Englisch

Preferred qualifications

- Verständnis von SPS-basierten Steuersystemen und gesetzlichen Compliance-Anforderungen
- Erfahrung im Gebrauch von computergesteuerten Wartungsmanagementsystemen, um proaktive Wartungsmaßnahmen zu planen und reaktive Maßnahmen aufzuzeichnen
- Studienabschluss, vorzugsweise in einem technischen Fachgebiet oder in Betriebswirtschaft

title: Principal Tech Business Development, Amazon Retail Ad Service
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Retail Ad Service to lead strategic partnerships that transform how retailers and advertisers connect with shoppers. Amazon Retail Ad Service (RAS) is seeking a Principal Tech Business Development leader to focus on strategic deals, partnerships, and go-to-market strategy for our international markets. This role will work closely with the Amazon Retail Ad Service product and leadership team, Amazon Ads senior management, cross business-unit BD teams, and other corporate functions to drive unique partnership opportunities. The candidate will be part of a team that is responsible for externalizing Amazon Ads technology for third-party retailers. This role is responsible for developing and executing high impact, complex, partnerships, and includes managing relationships and negotiations for customer and partnership deals which have long-term implications for Amazon. This position offers an opportunity to innovate and bring to life first-in-category initiatives and build cross functional relationships inside one of the world’s most innovative, customer-centric companies. This role also owns defining the strategy, customer frameworks and prioritization, developing and owning pipeline metrics, and influencing product and tech roadmaps to enable long-term growth.

We are seeking an innovative, entrepreneurial, creative, analytical, technical, and strategic thinker, who wants to build transformative partnerships to support our ongoing innovations and growth. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys solving complex problems, works effectively with cross-functional counterparts and thrives in a fast-paced setting that is constantly evolving. Proving you have high judgement, strong capabilities to earn trust, and are comfortable working in ambiguous, highly-visible situations is critical for this position.

Key job responsibilities
• Own strategic customer relationships and negotiations.
• Own the executive relationships with strategically important customer and partner companies in the sector; institute regular mechanisms to cultivate trust and drive alignment with Amazon’s priorities. Provide executive sponsorship when needed for other BD efforts and act as the executive escalation management resource for Amazon leaders.
• Develop and align the go-to-market strategy and goals/planning for Amazon Retail Ad Service.
• Develop scalable insight-driven narratives with sound recommendations.
• Develop a durable strategic framework to constantly evaluate new ideas based on business potential, opportunity size and strategic fit.
• Develop innovative commercial strategies and partnership ideas that drive material business impact for the business.
• Influence senior commercial, technical and product stakeholders to drive alignment around new ideas and initiatives, debate tradeoffs and make high-judgment decisions related to critical partnerships and cross product initiatives
• Work with cross-functional teams including Product, Operations, Engineering, Legal, Finance, and senior management to execute on the relationships.
• Systems thinker who understands the commercial workflows and product/technical frameworks relevant to the sector.
• End-to-end deal experience; structuring and negotiating complex partnership agreements such as advertising deals, complex digital media transactions, and strategic ad technology relationships.
• Strong financial acumen with the ability to analyze income, balance sheet and cash flow statements. Can construct an operating P&L, model deals, and articulate cost/benefit analyses.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll focus on building and nurturing strategic relationships with key retail and advertising partners. You might spend your morning analyzing market opportunities and developing partnership frameworks, then transition into executive-level negotiations with potential partners. Throughout the day, you'll collaborate with our product, engineering, and operations teams to align on go-to-market strategies and ensure partnerships are structured for long-term success. You'll also work to influence senior stakeholders across Amazon on critical initiatives, presenting data-driven recommendations and navigating complex tradeoffs. Your work directly shapes how we expand Amazon's advertising technology to third-party retailers and helps define what's possible in the retail advertising space.

About the team
We are building the future of retail advertising by enabling retailers to launch and scale their own ads businesses using Amazon's proven ad-technology. Our team partners with some of the industry's most innovative companies to create first-in-category solutions that connect advertisers with shoppers across multiple retail platforms. We're looking for someone who shares our vision of transforming the advertising landscape and who thrives in collaborative environments. You'll work alongside talented product managers, engineers, and commercial leaders who are committed to solving complex problems and delivering customer-centric solutions. Joining our team means being part of a group that values strategic thinking, cross-functional partnership, and the drive to build something meaningful in a rapidly evolving industry. To learn more about Amazon Retail Ad Service, visit https://advertising.amazon.com/retail-ad-service.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing, negotiating and executing business agreements
- Experience in a professional field or military
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience solving problems with technology in the Media & Entertainment Industry

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager (Indirect), Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings daily. As we rapidly become the world's largest consumer of corporate services in many categories, the Corporate Strategic Procurement team is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to join our team. This role is uniquely positioned at the nexus of business units across Amazon, and offers singular vision into a broad spectrum of cross-company initiatives and strategies on a global scale. Using this unique insight, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will build and lead sourcing engagements for both existing and newly emerging categories of spend, as well as negotiate multi-faceted partnership agreements for Amazon's high-growth businesses worldwide. Strategic Sourcing Managers own complex categories across multiple business units and regions, often in markets with limited competition and pricing transparency, and lead transformational sourcing initiatives with global scope. Strategic Sourcing Managers are expert practitioners in creating competitive environments, and have a strong bias for decisionmaking rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence C-level vendor relationships by advising senior Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business unit and corporate goals, and they raise the bar for sourcing peers across the global team. Successful candidates must work well in a fast-paced and often ambiguous arena, and will be rewarded by working alongside highly collaborative and entrepreneurial colleagues in an environment that feels much more "startup" than "big company". Spend categories under management include indirect categories such as Logistics, Technology, such as Software, Hardware, Data Purchase, Telecommunication, Cybersecurity, among others. If you are an experienced sourcing professional with a passion for serving customers and for driving change and impact on a global scale, then we would love to talk with you.

Key job responsibilities
- Owning one or more complex (sub-)categories across multiple business units and/or regions, developing and executing (sub-)category strategies
- Developing global sourcing strategies to deliver against business objectives for internal clients, and achieving sustainable relationships with suppliers.
- Managing categories in markets with limited competition and limited pricing transparency, proactively identifying and mitigating supplier, commercial, and ESG risk.
- Evaluating supplier core competencies and competitive positioning using industry cost models and bench-marking analysis.
- Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities, including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, negotiations, and supplier consolidation.
- Leading transformational sourcing projects with complex, global scope, coordinating work across team members and regions.
- Working with business and finance leaders to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, focusing on total cost of ownership, and value creation beyond cost savings.
- Presenting sourcing strategies, recommendations, and decisions to senior leaders up to three levels above you.
- Contributing inputs to annual and long-range operating plans (OP1, OP2, and three-year forecast).
- Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement processes and maintaining procurement ethics in accordance with Amazon's global policies.
- Preparing and holding business reviews with stakeholders to review vendor performance, future opportunities, and/or challenges.
- Mentoring and sharing best practices with sourcing peers across the global team.


A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. After lunch, you're on a negotiation call with a strategic supplier's C-suite to finalize contract terms, then pivoting to a spend review with Finance to validate savings actuals against targets. You'll close the day by coaching a business partner through the supplier evaluation framework for an upcoming engagement. No two days look the same — you'll balance long-range strategic planning with hands-on execution, often managing five or more active sourcing engagements simultaneously across different stages of the lifecycle.





About the team
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) manages Amazon's indirect spend across Employee Services, Marketing, Professional Services, Technology, Logistics, and Real Estate & Facilities. We're a global team of sourcing professionals who combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to deliver sustainable value at scale. Our culture values deep ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action — we move fast, but we move smart. You'll be joining a team where your work is visible to senior leadership and directly tied to Amazon's bottom line.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in an indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience with practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, etc.)
- 2+ years of relevant strategic sourcing and category management in categories such as logistics, IT, professional services, support or maintenance spend, supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in a non-mandated, indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience owning complex sourcing categories across multiple business units and/or regions
- Experience managing categories in markets with limited competition or limited pricing transparency, including proactive supplier risk management
- Experience leading transformational or cross-regional sourcing initiatives with global scope
- Experience advising and presenting sourcing strategy to senior executives and influencing C-level vendor relationships
- Experience contributing to annual or long-range operating plans
- Experience mentoring peers or coordinating sourcing work across a distributed team

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads is seeking a Principal Product Manager, Technical to lead yield optimization and demand diversification for Streaming TV Ads across Amazon's video properties, including Prime Video, Twitch, and Fire TV. In this role, you will own the product vision and roadmap for features that maximize advertising yield and expand the breadth of advertisers we serve — from outcome-based optimization and programmatic capabilities to features that attract local and small business advertisers into streaming TV for the first time.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the revenue engine of one of the fastest-growing businesses in advertising. Amazon's Streaming TV Ads reach hundreds of millions of viewers globally across premium long-form content, live and interactive streaming, and the connected TV home screen. You will build the products that determine how effectively we connect this supply with advertiser demand, using Amazon's first-party signals and machine learning to deliver measurable outcomes at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for yield optimization and demand diversification across Prime Video, Twitch, and Fire TV advertising, driving clarity in ambiguous problem spaces from concept through launch and iteration
- Lead outcome optimization products end-to-end that enable advertisers to buy against business results, partnering with applied science and engineering teams to develop ML-driven models, bidding algorithms, and targeting capabilities
- Design and execute experimentation strategies to validate new yield approaches, ad formats, and auction mechanisms, using data to make trade-off decisions and iterate quickly
- Build programmatic and self-service capabilities that lower barriers to entry for advertisers of all sizes, expanding the breadth of demand across our video properties
- Drive cross-functional execution with engineering, science, design, sales, and measurement teams to launch and scale features globally, influencing priorities across organizations

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing A/B test results from a new auction mechanism and deciding whether the signal warrants scaling or pivoting. By midday, you could be whiteboarding an ML model architecture with applied scientists or defining requirements for a self-service campaign tool aimed at small business advertisers. In the afternoon, you lead an alignment discussion with partners across ads and video to resolve a prioritization question on your roadmap. Between meetings, you analyze yield curves across inventory types to spot optimization opportunities and draft a vision document for a new product bet you are developing.

About the team
The Streaming TV Ads team within Amazon Ads is responsible for advertising monetization across Prime Video, Twitch, and Fire TV. Together, these properties reach hundreds of millions of viewers across premium long-form content, live and interactive streaming, and the connected TV home screen. We are a team of builders who are passionate about experimentation, applied science, and using Amazon's unique assets to create advertising experiences that deliver results for advertisers while respecting the viewer experience. We are investing in new optimization capabilities, programmatic access, and tools that will broaden who can advertise on streaming TV — and this role is central to that mission.

descriptionHtml:
AWS is building data center infrastructure to support our digital way of life, and the public conversation around that growth — power demand, grid reliability, and water use, — is increasingly shaped by regulators, policymakers, elected officials, and community stakeholders. The Energy & Water team is looking for a Senior Manager in Public Affairs, to lead how we engage in that conversation.

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to water: you understand industry trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage with the right internal and external stakeholders, and translate that understanding into the right messaging, You are the expert who shows up, engages authentically with community members, organizations, public officials, builds lasting relationships , and contributes to an informed, transparent, and productive public dialogue. You will be one of a small cohort of 3–4 regional representatives who collectively own how the Energy & Water team builds public engagement, in coordination with our policy, legal, community, comms, and economic development partners.

Position includes up to ~25-30% travel

Key job responsibilities
Public Representation:
Represent Water in public and community settings — open houses, boot camps, hearings, and stakeholder forums— building trusted relationships with officials, regulators, and community stakeholders.

Engage with regulatory bodies, agency staff, elected officials, and policy stakeholders alongside our Public Policy and Legal teams, representing the Water perspective accurately and with sound judgment.

Field live questions about water use, wastewater — including detailed questions from engaged community members and advocacy groups

Engage authentically on water topics in real time — accurately representing Amazon's approach and genuinely addressing community questions

Water Messaging and Content Ownership

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to water: you understand industry and sector trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage credibly with regulatory bodies and policy audiences, and you translate that understanding into the right messaging, delivered in the right tone, to the right stakeholders.

Develop and maintain talking points, FAQs, and Q&A guidance on energy and water topics for use by the broader team, Comms, and cross-functional partners

Provide the water subject matter foundation to develop materials and translate complex topics into channel-specific formats

Serve as a key resource when the team needs to respond quickly to emerging topics or prepare a spokesperson

Cross-Functional & Team Support

Serve as the Water liaison to Public Policy, Legal, Community Engagement, and Economic Development partner teams, aligning on messaging, sequencing, and tone before positions reach external audiences

Work closely with the External Engagement team to ensure Water subject matter is well-represented in event programming

Coordinate with Water SMEs to stay current on technical data (FAQ maintenance, approved stats, updated infrastructure positions)

Support regional leads and the broader team with ad hoc communications needs — presentations, talking points for senior stakeholders, positioning for emerging issues

Drive negotiations and agreements to support community benefit water projects as needed

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: System Manufacturing Engineer, Graviton server development team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, as part of Amazon, is the team behind AWS (Amazon Web Services) Graviton — the industry's most advanced Arm-based server CPU — and we operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

We're looking for System Manufacturing Engineer to be part of defining, shaping and integrating solutions to next generation of our cloud platforms.

As a System Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll own the development, testing, and monitoring of the manufacturing health of Amazon Graviton server products. You’ll be part of a team integrating new silicon, hardware, firmware, and software into a revolutionary system architecture.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with hardware design teams to drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Test (DFT), providing early feedback that reduces cost, defects, and ramp risk.
- Work with design partners and contract manufacturer (CM/ODM) sites to set up assembly, test, and burn-in processes, tooling, and fixtures that enable reliable manufacturing of Graviton-based servers.
- Define functional, stress, and in-circuit test coverage; drive first-pass yield up and defect/DPPM rates down through data-driven root cause analysis.
- Review, identify, and qualify second-source components to enable continuity of supply.
- Continuously assess process capability and innovate to simplify processes, reduce cost, and shorten cycle time across Graviton server development and manufacturing.
- Own defect containment, RMA root-cause, corrective/preventive actions (CAPA), and continuous improvement of production quality and reliability.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams — design, SI/PI, firmware, supply chain, and quality — to improve product design, processes, and quality.
- Work with upstream vendors and downstream customers to optimize the entire value stream and build joint processes that drive better cost and cycle time.
- Willingness to travel 4–6 times per year (approximately 1 week per trip) to design partner and manufacturing sites.

About the team
Our Graviton System group owns the design, manufacturing, and health of the Arm-based server fleet powering Amazon EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud). We work close to the metal — across firmware, board bring-up, diagnostics, and hardware debug — to keep servers running and return failed units to production fast. In close partnership with design partners, data center operations, and hardware engineering teams, we bring new server platforms into the fleet and drive them to launch faster, healthier, and more reliably, at a scale that directly impacts millions of customers around the world.
If you are a systems, HW, or SW engineer who thrives on hard problems at the intersection of hardware and software, enjoys root-causing failures on real servers, and wants to see your work make a measurable difference across a global fleet — we would love to talk.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent.
- 6+ years of experience bringing hardware products from design through mass production- including production test development, process development, and yield management.
- 6+ years experience with electronics manufacturing processes (SMT, assembly, system integration, test, and burn-in) and the supporting test equipment.
- Demonstrated ability to conduct manufacturing bring-up, failure analysis, and root cause investigation in both a lab and a production environment -on-site and at external CM/ODM partner sites.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience ramping server, networking, or data center hardware, especially multi-socket or GPU/AI platforms.
- Experience with production testing of DDR4/5, PCIe Gen4/5/6, CXL, and 100/400GbE.
- Knowledge of SPC, DOE, Six Sigma, and yield/data analytics.
- Experience in sustaining engineering, root cause analysis, ECOs, yield improvement, and vendor/CM support.
- Experience with Bash, Python, or SQL for data analysis, automation, or process monitoring; familiarity with AI-assisted tools.
- Exposure to networking, storage, or Linux-based servers.
- Strong technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration across design, test, firmware, supply chain, and manufacturing teams.

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Catalog
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. With AWS, you can requisition compute power, storage, and other services – paying as you go for only the resources you need. Within AWS, our Catalog solutions span Glue Data Catalog, Lake Formation, and DataZone. We offer customers a comprehensive inventory of an organization's assets, enrich this view through metadata, and provide data discovery, governance, trust, and query routing functionality. Catalogs are at the forefront of modern Analytics, acting as the bridge between the consumption layer and data services. They effectively enable Engines to query information and allow humans and AI to find semantic meaning in data. Our suite of Catalog services make it easy to set up a secure data lake in days. A data lake is a centralized, curated, and secured repository that stores all your data, both in its original form and prepared for analysis. A data lake enables you to break down data silos and combine different types of analytics to gain insights and guide better business decisions.

Joining the AWS Catalog organization gives you the opportunity to:
- Work on a disruptive product that’s still in its early stages
- Solve challenging problems that will revolutionize database computing in the cloud
- Build a product that will leverage the scale of resources available in the cloud
- Work for a company that’s a recognized leader in the cloud computing space
- Be involved in the fast growing, big data space

We are looking for developers with expertise and passion for building large-scale data-intensive systems and distributed systems. In particular, we are looking for developers that want to work on the next generation big data systems that will transform data management on AWS and across the industry.

Experience with large scale data analytics, big data platforms, highly available/fault tolerant systems, replicated data storage, and operating complex services running in the cloud are all pluses.



Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will have responsibility for:
- Translating functional and technical requirements into detailed architecture and design
- Coding and testing complex system components
- Participating in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world leader in providing a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world!

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data centre industry. You will be responsible for innovating, deploying, optimising, and maintaining the automation systems within the data centres. Automation systems consist of building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space.

As a Controls Engineer you will:

Perform controls root cause analysis.
Schedule and supervise Quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS.
Provide vendor management.
Develop scope of work for site improvement projects.
Support Global Controls projects team.
Work under tight project timelines.
Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate difficult situations.
Review controls sequence of operation and provide feedback to design.
Financially manage service invoices.
Provide technical assistance to internal customers during life cycle of the data center.
Participate in a global on-call schedule.
Grow in technical ability by learning a multitude of different automation platforms.

Controls Engineer may also perform the following:
Ensure data center controls are deployed in accordance with scope of work (SOW) and specifications.
Develop building automation controls drawings and wiring diagrams.
Size controls valves and damper actuators and select controls devices.
Review and provide feedback on mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) drawings.
Develop controls bill of material (BOM).
Develop and modify controls logic programming.
Develop and modify graphical user interface.
Act in a project sponsor capacity.

Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon MQ
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MQ is a managed AWS service for Apache ActiveMQ and RabbitMQ that streamlines setup, operation, and management of message brokers on AWS. Every day we make it easier for developers to build applications that use the rich features and power of open-source message brokers. We partner with the maintainers of the RabbitMQ and Apache ActiveMQ open source projects to continually evolve and improve the projects with new features and optimizations.
