title: Sr. Risk Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, & Compliance (RISC)
descriptionHtml:
Do you enjoy designing and implementing solutions to ambiguous and complex problems? Are you looking to expand your scope of impact and influence strategic decision making? Are you in the market for a new, exciting challenge where you are empowered to use your ingenuity to innovate? If so, we are looking for talented people like you to join our Regulatory, Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) solution delivery team.

The RISC team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies. In this role, you will work closely with legal, business teams, selling partner experience and support teams, operational excellence, product, BI and data science/engineering teams to deliver high-impact end-to-end safety and compliance solutions. Think of this role as a non-technical "solution architect" where you will be given autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective policy enforcements to ensure product safety and compliance worldwide.

The Senior Risk Manager drives the development and implementation of new tools and programs that advance the store's global safety and compliance efforts. This role requires influencing cross-functional stakeholders, planning strategic projects with legal and business partners, securing team commitments, and developing daily, weekly, and monthly metrics while ensuring compliance with Amazon quality standards and regulatory program expectations.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Own and deliver complex, cross-cutting initiatives by partnering with legal, business, tech, and operational excellence teams—bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder efforts.
• Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across multiple organizations; align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, secure commitments, and drive decisions forward—even when you don't own the teams doing the work.
• Build the Mechanisms That Keep Us Sharp: Design and run the operating cadences (business reviews, launch readiness checkpoints, intake processes) that ensure our safety and compliance controls launch with quality and consistency every time.
• Own the Metrics That Matter: Define, develop, and maintain the daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics that give the team and leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where to focus next.
• Find the Friction and Fix It: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate redundant work, and drive automation opportunities that free up risk managers to focus on the high-judgment, high-impact work they do best.
• Raise the Quality Bar: Establish and maintain standards for control launches and program deliverables, ensuring every enforcement we ship meets Amazon's quality expectations and regulatory requirements.
• Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with leadership to translate business priorities and legal requirements into clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines that teams can actually execute against.
• Build Tools and Frameworks That Scale: Champion the development of new tools, templates, and repeatable playbooks that accelerate the team's ability to launch safety and compliance programs worldwide.
• Write with Clarity and Purpose: Author crisp, well-structured documents—SOPs, program updates, leadership narratives—that make complex information accessible and drive informed decision-making.
• Be the Operational Backbone: Keep the trains running. Maintain visibility across workstreams, remove blockers, track commitments, and create the organizational structure that makes everyone on the team more effective at their jobs.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship

AI experiences including our conversational insights agent are built directly on the foundation you own. You'll partner closely with the teams building those experiences, giving them the data contracts, certified metrics, and latency guarantees they need to succeed, and closing the data and metric gaps that stand between a good answer and a great one. title: Digital Sovereignty Specialist Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
AWS is hiring a Digital Sovereignty Specialist Solutions Architect for Spain, Portugal, Italy, and Southern Europe. You will help customers and public sector organizations move workloads to AWS when sovereignty, security, and regulatory requirements decide what can run in the cloud.

Organizations in highly regulated industries and the public sector across Southern Europe are deciding now how to meet their sovereignty requirements. You will be their technical counterpart for the AWS European Sovereign Cloud and for the sovereignty controls available in AWS Regions. You will also build on the work AWS has done with national cybersecurity authorities in the region, such as secure configuration guidance and landing zone templates aligned with national security frameworks.

Specialist Solutions Architects are part of the AWS sales organization. They bring deep domain expertise to customers with complex problems and work closely with account teams, AWS Professional Services, and Partners to help customers get to production.

This role is based in Madrid, Lisbon, or Rome. Native or professional proficiency in Spanish and professional proficiency in English are required. Italian and Portuguese are highly valued.

Key job responsibilities
- Advise customers, partners, and public sector organizations in Spain, Portugal, Italy, and Southern Europe on running workloads with sovereignty requirements on the AWS European Sovereign Cloud and in AWS Regions
- Lead the technical response to RFIs and RFPs that include sovereignty, security, and compliance requirements
- Work with national cybersecurity authorities, together with AWS security assurance and public policy colleagues, on cloud security guidance, secure configuration guides, and landing zone templates
- Deliver briefings, workshops, and architecture reviews for customers and partners, and speak at industry events
- Bring customer requirements to AWS service teams and turn field experience into whitepapers, blogs, and reusable content

A day in the life
Most weeks combine customer and partner meetings, time for focused work, and collaboration with colleagues across EMEA. A typical week might include a working session with a bank's security leaders on their sovereignty requirements, a review of the technical answers in a public sector tender with the account team, and preparation for a workshop with a national cybersecurity authority. You also set aside time to write, whether that is a secure configuration guide, a blog post, or feedback to an AWS service team based on what you hear from customers.

About the team
The Sovereignty Technology team helps customers, partners, and public sector organizations across EMEA adopt AWS. We cover the AWS European Sovereign Cloud and sovereignty controls in AWS Regions, and we work with regulated enterprises, software vendors and system integrators building sovereign offerings, national regulators, and EU institutions. Team members are based in several European countries.

In this role you will build expertise in European security and sovereignty frameworks, work directly with AWS service teams on the features customers ask for, and represent AWS with regulators and at industry events. You will have access to mentorship, knowledge sharing, and other career resources to help you grow.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- 5+ years in a technical role involving cloud architecture, security, or infrastructure
- 2+ years architecting or operating solutions on AWS
- Experience with security, compliance, or regulatory requirements for cloud workloads (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, ENS, C5)
- Professional proficiency in Spanish and English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience working with national regulators, cybersecurity agencies, or standards bodies on cloud security guidance, accreditation, or certification
- Knowledge of digital sovereignty and cloud security frameworks in the EU (e.g. ENS, CPSTIC, EUCS, C5)

title: Senior Hardware Reliability Engineer, Reliability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Devices is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile electronic devices. Amazon devices started with originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Amazon Echo. Amazon reliability team aims to develop reliable and robust products that delight our customers. In this role, as a Sr. Hardware Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for the reliability engineering of our new and emerging robotic devices.

The Role:

As a Senior Hardware Reliability Engineer, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff and outside partners to drive key aspects of product definition, execution and test. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment. You will be responsible for the test and validation of robotic devices. You should have a good understanding of Reliability statistics/Reliability tests and/or solid understanding of electrical and robotic products to influence design for reliability to:

- Identify and validate product risks, including but not limited to electrical system, mechanical system, and work with design teams to mitigate them
- Define test methodology and test coverage to assure product reliability
- Provide hands-on experimental design and execution
- Perform reliability prediction of failure mechanisms on products under development and products in the field

Basic qualifications

- Experience in component selection and understanding of component reliability
- Experience in Robotics, including reliability of motors, sensors, and high power electronics.
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Engineering, Material Science, Physics, or a related field and 7+ years of experience in the job offered or in a related occupation.
- Experience with hardware reliability testing such as vibration & shock testing, fatigue testing, electrical stress testing, ESD testing, and thermal stress testing.
- Experience in data analytics, statistical analysis. Able to perform DFMEA, reliability analysis such as lifetime analysis, acceleration factor studies, reliability modeling and reliability allocation.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or foreign equivalent in Engineering, Material Science, Physics, or a related field and 5+ years of experience in the job offered or in a related occupation.
- Experience with failure analysis techniques: Electrical debug, Cross sectioning, dye and pry and microscope
- Knowledge of the following fields: Consumer, Industrial, and Automotive Electronics, and Building Standards.
- This position will require some domestic and international travel
- Experienced communication skills in writing and presenting.

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon

- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

You will process requests for access to protected data, evaluating use cases against data-handling policy. Where needed, you will write queries to validate findings across datasets. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. This role will include both day and night shifts.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions

descriptionHtml:

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

As part of the AWS Connect, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Connect is a highly disruptive cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Amazon Connect is the result of the ten years of development that went into building the tools Amazon uses to provide its award winning customer service at massive scale and launching it as a publicly available AWS service. With Amazon Connect, you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and the large ecosystem of AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free, easy-to-use, extensible, and natural customer experience. With this technology, we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them.

We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems. descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Field Engineer to join our Infrastructure Reliability Programs (IRP) team within Operational Infrastructure Services (OIS). In this role, you will support mission-critical network infrastructure projects across Amazon fulfillment centers, ensuring reliable and secure operations. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and program teams to execute infrastructure deployments and migrations in a fast-paced environment.

Move Off Corp (MOC) is an S-team goal and multi-year Stores cross-cutting mandate to remove Amazon's Corporate (CORP) network's security, availability, and scalability risks from all current and future Operations (Ops) buildings and enable Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) to reduce login impersonations threats (FAQ 1). After successfully externalizing all Greenfield site types in 2022-25, the MOC program shifted in 2025 to complete the removal of the CORP network in all Brownfield sites by the end of 2027.

While this job is currently showing out of MIA1, this job can be filled out of any site. Travel up to 75% of the time is expected during the peak of the program.

• Support site infrastructure assessments, site walks, and readiness reviews

• Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and contribute to continuous improvement of deployment and migration processes
• Document project progress, site conditions, and technical findings accurately and in a timely manner
• Support the commissioning and decommissioning of network equipment as part of site lifecycle activities

title: Safety Investigations Analyst, Middle Mile Investigations
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're dedicated to becoming the most customer-centric company on Earth. To achieve this goal, we seek exceptionally talented, bright, and driven individuals. Amazon is currently looking for a Safety Investigations Analyst to join Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) within NAST Safety and Compliance.

The Safety Investigations Analyst owns investigation of Middle Mile transportation incidents end to end, from intake through documented finding, across Amazon's carrier programs: Relay Motor Carrier (RMC), Relay Motor Carrier LineHaul (RMCLH), Relay Motor Carrier Box Truck (RMCBT), and Amazon Freight Partner (AFP).

In this role you will conduct comprehensive incident investigations using telematics, video, and law enforcement records; apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria; identify trends across regions, programs, and carriers; recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices; and serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and external counsel. Findings inform network-level changes intended to reduce incident frequency and severity.

The successful candidate writes clearly for senior audiences, reaches defensible conclusions from incomplete information, and works independently across competing deadlines.

Key job responsibilities
Investigation

- Own assigned incident investigations end to end, from intake through documented finding, across RMC, RMCLH, RMCBT, and AFP.
- Collect and preserve evidence including telematics, dash camera footage, law enforcement records, and carrier documentation.
- Apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria and video review standards.
- Write investigation narratives documenting what occurred and the factors identified, each sourced to verifiable data.
- Serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and, when assigned, external counsel.

Analysis and enforcement

- Identify trends across regions, carrier programs, and individual carriers, and surface them to the Program Manager.
- Recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices.
- Query multiple data systems to extract and reconcile investigation data.

Operating rhythm

- Maintain case records and queue status in the systems of record, keeping tracking current and auditable.
- Review recurring vendor investigation reports for completeness, and escalate vendor performance issues.
- Report investigation status, closure metrics, and case aging to the Program Manager on a recurring cadence.
- Propose improvements to investigation process and standard work.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with the queue: new incidents overnight, open evidence requests, cases aging. You pull telematics and video on an assigned collision and chase the law enforcement report and carrier documentation. By afternoon you are writing the narrative, sourcing every line. Some events bring outside counsel into the file, and you are the person who knows what happened. A pattern you flagged last month across two regions becomes a recommendation your Program Manager takes to an enforcement decision. No two investigations are the same, and what you document today shapes what the network changes next quarter.

About the team
Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) sits within NAST Safety and Compliance. We investigate transportation incidents across Amazon's Middle Mile carrier programs, document what happened from verifiable evidence, and surface patterns that inform how the network operates. The team is small and geographically distributed. Analysts own their cases rather than a shared queue, and the written product carries to senior leaders who act on it. We are building our standard work now, so you will help shape how this function operates rather than inherit a finished process. If you want ownership and are comfortable with ambiguity, you will do well here.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Are 18 years of age or older

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with end-to-end project management

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon 1P Lending
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help millions of customers in Latin America get fair, simple and transparent credit? Amazon's 1P Lending team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II (SDE II) to design and build the systems behind our lending products in Brazil and Mexico.

You'll build and own services that handle customer onboarding, credit decisioning, loan servicing, repayments, and integration with local partners and regulators. These are critical financial systems, so they must be correct, secure, auditable and highly available.

You'll be part of a team of engineers in São Paulo and work closely with engineering teams in India and with Product, Risk, Finance and Compliance partners in Brazil and Mexico. You'll own features from design to production, help shape the team's architecture, and see your work directly affect customers' access to credit.

We're looking for a strong engineer with high ownership. You should enjoy solving hard problems, write high-quality code, and care about how your systems behave in production.

Key job responsibilities
Design and build: Design, write, test and launch scalable, reliable services and features for lending products in Brazil and Mexico.
Own your systems from start to finish: Take features from requirements and technical design through deployment, monitoring and ongoing improvement.
Contribute to architecture: Write and review design docs, weigh technical trade-offs, and help shape the team's system architecture with senior engineers and the SDM.
Build for financial services: Build in the security, data privacy, auditability and correctness that regulated lending systems need, including local requirements in Brazil and Mexico.
Work across geographies: Work with engineering teams in India and partner teams in Brazil and Mexico on shared services, integrations and launches.
Run what you build: Take part in on-call, debug production issues, lead root-cause analysis and make lasting fixes.
Raise the bar: Do thorough code reviews, improve engineering practices, and mentor junior engineers and interns.
Work with business partners: Partner with Product, Risk and Compliance to turn customer and regulatory needs into technical solutions.

A day in the life
On a given day you might:

Write the design doc for a new repayment-scheduling service.
Review a teammate's code and suggest a simpler approach.
Pair with an engineer in India to debug an integration issue.
Work with Risk to understand a new credit-decisioning rule.
Ship a feature to production and watch its metrics after launch.
You'll split your time between design, coding, operations and working with your team and partners.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Construction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative throughout the full construction lifecycle. You play an integral role in delivering the built facilities and infrastructure that power Amazon's logistics network — including sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings — through new builds, retrofits, and expansions.

In this role, you serve as the primary point of interface between Amazon and its external partners — developers, general contractors, design engineers, and authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ) — while collaborating closely with internal stakeholders responsible for equipping, furnishing, and operating our facilities. You are accountable for the safe, on-time, in scope, and on-budget delivery of construction projects, and you bring a disciplined approach to budget management, schedule oversight, contract execution, and quality assurance.

You operate with a high degree of independence within your assigned region, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining clear and transparent communication with all project stakeholders. This role combines construction management, engineering, project planning, contract management, and facilities delivery — and requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America.

This role requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America, with potential travel to all North America locations based on business needs. Relocation assistance may be provided. Must be open to servicing Chicago area as well as Florida.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Champion Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams; hold everyone accountable to a safety-first culture
- Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to maintain regulatory compliance and ensure seamless project execution
- Lead or assist in negotiations with regulatory bodies as required for permitting and approvals

Project & Construction Management
- Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously — ranging from small renovations to large-scale ($100M+) new facility builds — from design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- Serve as Amazon's owner's representative and primary integrator between construction execution teams and internal stakeholders (operations, equipment, IT, etc.)
- Review construction documents, drawings, and specifications for conformance to Amazon's building standards and design guidelines
- Identify and resolve design conflicts, schedule clashes, and coordination gaps with other Amazon execution teams
- Conduct detailed reviews of contractor bid packages, budgets, and schedules to identify and resolve discrepancies
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Own comprehensive budget tracking, cashflow forecasting, and cost management across assigned projects
- Review, analyze, and respond to all proposed cost and time change requests submitted by external project teams
- Negotiate construction, procurement, and labor contracts with developers and general contractors; present formal documentation for approval when required
- Ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements
- Advise on the impact of changes in scope, schedule, cost, and permitting

Contractor & Stakeholder Management
- Audit contractor performance to ensure skills, competencies, and resources are appropriate for the work being performed
- Ensure contracted resources deliver work that meets duration and quality targets; address and resolve underperformance issues
- Coach and guide project teams — including developers, design engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders — throughout the full project lifecycle
- Inform developers and contractors of projected changes in resource or work demand to enable proactive planning
- Partner with teams responsible for base building management transition and oversight of all turnover documentation

Communication & Reporting
- Maintain clear, concise, and transparent communication with all internal and external stakeholders on project status, risks, and key developments
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project data
- Participate in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions
- Prepare reports, specifications, and technical analyses to define design requirements, equipment needs, and services for expansion and remodel projects

Innovation & Continuous Improvement
- Provide critical review of current design standards to identify value engineering and design enhancement opportunities
- Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the construction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices
- Identify and implement process improvements that drive better outcomes across safety, cost, schedule, and quality

A day in the life
Each day, you act as Amazon's owner on the ground — ensuring the safe, on-time, and on-budget execution of construction projects across your region. Your day may include:
- Coordinating with general contractors on project status, upcoming milestones, and emerging risks
- Reviewing and responding to RFIs, submittals, change order requests, and schedule updates
- Participating in AOC meetings and driving accountability across the project team
- Conducting site visits to verify construction quality and safety compliance
- Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
- Collaborating with internal stakeholders on facility readiness, equipment coordination, and operational handover planning
- Reviewing design documents and providing feedback to engineering and design partners

About the team
At Amazon, the GES NA D&C team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, or in a related construction discipline
- 5+ years of project management experience spanning design phase through construction completion and operational handover
- 5+ years of experience negotiating construction, procurement, and/or labor contracts
- 5+ years of proficiency with AutoCAD and/or Building Information Modeling (BIM), and scheduling software (Primavera, MS Project, or similar)
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or similar)
- Demonstrated success communicating project requirements to diverse audiences including senior leadership, public officials, vendors, and operational teams
- Experience in facilities management, including planning, design review, implementation, and project controls for new and existing structures
- Experience managing concurrent projects in a program management capacity
- CMIT/CMAA or PMP certification or equivalent

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Transform
descriptionHtml:
With roughly seven out of eight enterprise workloads still running on-premises or on mainframe, the opportunity to help the world's largest organizations move to the cloud is enormous. AWS Transform is building a platform that combines AI-driven automation with deep infrastructure and software engineering to analyze, plan, and execute large-scale application migrations. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will work across the full stack, from designing the distributed systems and services that power migration workflows to building the intelligent agents that reason about complex legacy environments.

You will own the design and delivery of features and components, from understanding customer needs through implementation, testing, and production operations. You will work with senior engineers on system design, write high-quality, well-tested code, and help operate the services you build. Your work will directly shape how enterprises move their most critical workloads to AWS. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to make sure what you build turns into real customer outcomes. If you are excited about solving hard, high-impact problems with strong engineering fundamentals and applied AI skills, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and operate distributed services and AI-powered agents that analyze legacy codebases, plan migration strategies, and execute transformations end to end.
Drive the end-to-end design of the features you own, making trade-offs across scalability, performance, and security, and communicate across teams to influence architectural decisions on shared interfaces and infrastructure.
Write well-documented, production-quality code that sets an example for others, and make sure solutions are testable and easy for others to extend.
Play a key technical role on the team in aligning engineering work with customer needs, turning requirements into product features and delivering them incrementally.
Mentor teammates through design and code reviews, foster engineering best practices, and take part in interviewing and recruiting.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a design review where you present your approach for a new service component that automates a migration step previously done by hand. After working through the details with a senior engineer, you shift to writing and reviewing code, working on infrastructure plumbing one hour and refining an agent's decision logic the next. In the afternoon you meet with your product manager and a customer-facing teammate to go over feedback from an enterprise customer pilot and turn it into improvements for your feature. You wrap up by updating operational dashboards and tuning alerts for a service you helped launch.

About the team
AWS Transform sits within the Agentic AI organization at Amazon Web Services and is focused on building the next generation of autonomous migration services. The team partners closely with go-to-market, professional services, and enterprise customers to turn complex modernization challenges into repeatable, well-engineered solutions that blend systems infrastructure with applied AI.

We are at an early and exciting stage of product development, which means your contributions will directly shape the platform's architecture and roadmap. We value curiosity, collaboration, and a willingness to experiment, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can do their best work.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Software Dev Manager, SBS Core Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Specialized Businesses Security (SBS) organization is seeking a Software Development Manager to lead Core Engineering, the software engineering team that designs and builds production-ready software for all of SBS. Security teams across SBS find more issues than people can triage, route, and fix by hand, and AI-paced software development is widening that gap. Your team closes it.
You will own the shared platforms that take security capability from research to production, surface findings inside the tools builders already use, and give the organization an automated answer to "what do we own, and what does this vulnerability affect?" You start from the customer. Your customers are the SBS security teams who depend on your platforms and the builder teams who receive their output, and it is your job to decide what gets built for whom and why.
This is a forward-driving role. You will set the team's technical direction, turn a demand-driven backlog into a prioritized platform roadmap, and build a team that delivers measurable security outcomes at Amazon scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the roadmap, architecture, and operational health of a portfolio of security platforms used by security teams and builders across Amazon

- Turn AI security capability built by a partner research team into self-service production services with API, IDE, and build-pipeline integration

- Work backwards from SBS security teams and builder teams to set priorities across competing requests, and say no to work that does not meet the bar

- Build, hire, and develop a team of software engineers; delegate ownership of components and grow engineers into technical leads

- Drive integrations into platforms your team does not own, and manage the upstream dependencies that put your commitments at risk

- Define and report on the metrics that matter: adoption, precision, time from finding to fix, and engineering hours removed from security operations

- Represent the team in business reviews, operating plans, and cross-org prioritization discussions

A day in the life
You start the morning with your engineers on the AI pentest service, deciding how to hold precision as you open it to every Amazon builder. Midday you meet the AI Engineering lead to line up their next model milestones with your delivery plan, then review a design for a self-service framework that lets builder teams connect their own ticketing tools. In the afternoon you sit with the Vulnerability Intelligence team to work out what the asset inventory must expose to replace their manual triage, and you push back on a request that would pull the team into one-off work. You close the day with a 1:1 on an engineer's path to technical lead and a draft of the narrative for your next business review.

About the team
Core Engineering is the software engineering team for Amazon's Specialized Businesses Security (SBS) organization. It sits within the Core Services organization, and it's remit covers all of the teams within SBS: it builds and operates the shared platforms that SBS security teams, and the builders they support, depend on to secure our products and services for Amazon's customers. The team turns AI security research into self-service production services, routes security findings to the engineers who own the code, and gives the organization an accurate view of what it owns and what a new vulnerability affects. Its customers are security teams across penetration testing, detection engineering, vulnerability intelligence, and business security, plus builder teams across Amazon's devices and specialized businesses.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Risk Specialist I, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Risk Specialist I drives regulated waste compliance across the 2-4 sites they support. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage competing priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-pace operations environment. If you are motivated by solving regulatory compliance problems in the field, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the execution and delivery of regulated waste compliance projects and activities, including developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and inspection routines, to mitigate identified risks across the sites you support.
- Apply risk management methods such as waste compliance audits and site inspections to monitor compliance thresholds, test controls, and take corrective action when findings arise.
- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and work with process owners to improve conformance, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.
- Prepare clear and concise documentation, including status reports, audit results, metrics, and project communications, so the right information reaches the right audience at the right time.
- Travel expected up to 50% of the time.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin by reviewing incoming risk-related requests and prioritizing your project tasks. You will spend time conducting audits or risk assessments, updating documentation, and coordinating with compliance operations and partner teams. Throughout the day, you will track project milestones, resolve roadblocks, and communicate progress to stakeholders. You will also look for ways to streamline existing processes and ensure your risk area stays aligned with current regulations and team objectives.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to protecting Amazon's customers and business by proactively managing risk across a broad range of areas, from regulatory compliance to operational resilience. We work closely with legal, operations, and business partners to deliver practical risk solutions and build a strong culture of compliance. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- 2+ years of experience in environmental compliance, regulated waste management, or workplace risk investigations
- Experience interpreting and applying environmental regulations (RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules)
- Experience collecting and analyzing data to identify compliance gaps and drive corrective actions

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience managing a regulated waste program across multiple sites, including hazardous waste accumulation, manifesting, and disposal
- Hazardous waste certification such as RCRA or DOT (49 CFR) training, or 40-hour HAZWOPER

title: ASIC Formal Verification Engineer I, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
In Annapurna Labs we are at the forefront of hardware co-design not just in Amazon Web Services (AWS) but across the industry. The work we do is cutting-edge and internet-scale while also being deeply important to our customers. We design and build every component of our hardware and software to come together into products that our customers use for accelerated computing: either Machine Learning acceleration, or FPGA acceleration. We get our hands dirty, from creating our own silicon, pushing the electrons in the right direction, ensuring our hardware is functional and healthy, and managing the full lifecycle of our systems at the huge scale and complexity of AWS. If you're interested in "building a complete product" from inception to delighted customers, Annapurna is a fantastic choice.
As a member of the Machine Learning Acceleration team you will be responsible for defining and checking the specification of critical hardware modules using formal methods and industrial model checkers.
You will be a part of a world class pre-silicon hardware design team. The job entails understanding requirements of specific hardware blocks and writing functional descriptions of correct behavior. Specifications are written in hardware description languages like Verilog and System Verilog Assertions (SVA). Using industrial model checkers you will then learn techniques for proving the hardware being designed matches the modeled specification. Advances proof techniques, such as modeling abstractions, and inductive reasoning will be utilized. Automation techniques and scripting flows are also leveraged to accelerate proof techniques.
About the team
Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new team members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skillset.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences.
Work/Life Harmony
Our team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Basic qualifications

• To qualify, applicants should have earned (or will earn) a Bachelors or Masters degree
• Completed coursework or prior internship experience with formal methods (SW/HW)
• Coursework or prior internship experience in the basics of computer architecture.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience or previous technical internship(s) with hardware model checkers: JasperGold, or VC Formal.
• Experience or previous technical internship(s) with RTL Verilog.
• Knowledge of formalization techniques.
• Experience with scripting languages, such as Python, or TCL.
• Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
• Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly

title: HR Consultant Apprentice - 24 month Fixed Term Contract
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about people, and curious about what makes a great workplace actually work? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon as an HR Consultant Apprentice - a role where the decisions you support shape the day-to-day experience of thousands of employees.

HR at Amazon isn't about admin and policy for their own sake. Our teams sit alongside business leaders, using data, insight, and well-designed mechanisms to help managers lead well, grow their people, and make fair, consistent decisions at real scale.

As an apprentice, you'll learn this craft by doing it. You'll start by supporting the fundamentals and, over time, take on real responsibility - getting closer to the business, forming your own point of view, and learning how to influence outcomes rather than simply respond to requests.

A day in the life can involve:

- Partnering with managers and stakeholders to offer expert, practical HR guidance

- Contributing to diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

- Supporting the delivery of HR strategy for the lines of business you work with

- Using people data to spot trends and shape fair, consistent decisions

- Helping standardise and improve best practice across teams

This role suits someone who's genuinely curious about people and comfortable with a bit of grey - not every answer is in a handbook. You'll build credibility with colleagues at every level, ask good questions, and bring empathy and sound judgement to situations that are rarely black and white. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster, so you'll be encouraged to form a view and act on it early.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship you'll put newfound knowledge into practice every day, supported by first-class coaching, tailored development, and rewarding work that will empower you to reach new heights and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a vast range of experiences and skills while working towards the HR Consultant Partner Level 5 apprenticeship standard and the CIPD Level 5 certification in People Management. As a working student, your focus is to complete your studies in your 20% off-the-job time, developing the skills, knowledge, and behaviours to work towards successful graduation. You'll be set goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over a 24-month period, starting in September. Your apprenticeship will combine classroom/virtual-based training to cover knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, and mentoring from our experienced team members.

We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups – including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities – provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're also continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer, so you'll have the resources and support to develop into a well-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- Hold 5 GCSEs at grade 4-9 (A-C) or above (or equivalent) including Maths and English and 3 A Levels or equivalent qualifications (at grade C or above) or a T-Level Pass
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 24 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine interest in people, behaviour, and what makes a workplace work well - whether through study, a part-time role, volunteering, or simply being the person others come to
- Some experience of working with or helping others in any setting (for example a customer-facing role, team project, club, or community activity)
- Confidence working with information and data - spotting patterns, drawing sensible conclusions, and using evidence to support a view
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and adapt how you talk to different people
- Comfortable handling sensitive situations with empathy and good judgement
- Well-organised, with the ability to manage your own time and balance studying alongside working

title: Buying & Supplier Manager II, Robotics Supply Chain - Procurement
descriptionHtml:
Is your passion inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work affects the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you will fit right in here at Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we cannot even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

The Robotics Supply Chain organization sources a portfolio of robotics technology and is responsible for getting the right materials to the right place at the right time to support our network of global fulfillment and transportation solutions. It’s an operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon globally and is driven by data and metrics. The Supply Chain team is seeking an experienced Buying and Supplier Manager to manage the timely and efficient material delivery to AR sites by mitigating supply risks and addressing supply chain constraints. This role will support supplier performance management, supplier relationship management, purchase order execution, and escalation resolution.

The Buying and Supplier Manager will drive operational excellence through robust vendor management and performance frameworks—ensuring suppliers meet delivery, quality, and cost targets while proactively addressing risks and implementing corrective actions. The role will also lead the deployment of tools and systems that automate procurement workflows and enable real-time supplier performance monitoring, improving efficiency, visibility, and accountability across the supply base.

This role requires strong cross-functional collaboration and data-driven approach to scale procurement operations, enhance supplier reliability, and support the growing needs of Amazon’s Robotics Supply Chain.

Key job responsibilities
Own various aspects of supply chain management from ordering, assessing supplier capacities and delivery risks to resolving delivery challenges, and communicating risks to stakeholders.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and suppliers to monitor and improve supplier performance.
Be a critical escalation point for materials and service delivery risks with internal stakeholders and suppliers.
Proactively identify supply chain risks, implement robust mitigation strategies, and communicate potential disruptions and mitigative actions to stakeholders to maintain business continuity.
Drive supply chain delivery performance by owning key metrics, addressing constraints, and influencing stakeholders to resolve bottlenecks effectively.
Ensure that purchase orders are placed on-time and receive delivery commitments from the supply base.
Identify and implement tools and systems to optimize the process
Improve processes and mechanisms to optimize resources and value delivery for the Robotics organization

A day in the life
Your morning begins reviewing supply risk dashboards and delivery status updates for robotics components being shipped to manufacturing plants as well as directly to fulfillment sites. You spot a potential delay from a key component supplier and quickly jump on a call with their core operational team—and sometimes their executives—to work through solutions and secure an expedited delivery plan.

Throughout the day, you're monitoring supply chain risks, managing direct shipments to sites, and collaborating with teams across engineering, operations, and logistics. When a materials shortage threatens a site launch, you bring stakeholders together to identify alternatives and work with suppliers—including at the executive level—to negotiate solutions and secure backup capacity. You're also working to automate tactical procurement tasks, allowing you to focus more on monitoring at-risk items and developing proactive mitigation strategies with vendors.

You spend time analyzing supplier performance data, handling escalations, and keeping everyone informed of supply chain risks. Periodically, you visit vendors on-site to strengthen relationships, engage with their leadership teams, and work through long-term supply chain improvements face-to-face.

As the role evolves, you'll shift from hands-on tactical execution to strategic oversight—monitoring risk indicators, collaborating with suppliers and their executives on preventive solutions, and building sustainable supply chain frameworks for the future.

It's a dynamic role where you're constantly solving problems, building supplier relationships at all levels, and ensuring Amazon's robotics operations run smoothly.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. - Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis

title: Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician
descriptionHtml:
The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Key job responsibilities
- Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
- Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites

A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks like painting and plumbing and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or cutting-edge tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

- Served a full Engineering indentured apprenticeship and/or hold NVQ Level 3 in a relevant Engineering subject
- Relevant experience as a qualified engineer

- Advanced proficiency in the local language verbally and in writing

- Experience in condition-based monitoring
- Experience working with print and apply machines
- Experience in fault-finding and maintaining conveyor or automation systems

descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an exceptional Systems Engineer to join our world-class Central Technical Operations Services (C-TOS) team as an Incident Manager. As the first line of defense for maintaining high availability on the Amazon Retail Website, our C-TOS group provides critical incident response and management for the entire Amazon ecosystem. When issues arise that could impact our hundreds of millions of customers worldwide, our skilled Incident Managers spring into action to make event durations shorter, less frequent, and less severe.

This is immensely important, high-stakes work. The Amazon Retail Website is where we directly engage and delight our global customer base - any disruption can have a real impact on real people. That's why our C-TOS Incident Managers are so vital; leveraging deep operational expertise and the latest incident management tools, they work quickly to mitigate customer-impacting events.

This is an excellent opportunity to join one of Amazon's world-class engineering teams, working alongside some of the best and brightest minds in technology. Our engineers are encouraged to build solutions that enhance our incident management practice, including tooling and processes, as well as fix software problems - and then share those innovations across the organization. You'll have access to mentoring programs, regular tech talks with technical leaders, and well-defined career paths for motivated engineers who want to contribute to our culture of operational excellence and customer-focused innovation. The C-TOS team is globally distributed, with groups in Austin, Dublin, and Sydney providing 24/7 coverage, each working 10-hour shifts for 4 days per week.
#techjobsau

title: Process Design Engineer, Quick Commerce Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Quick Commerce Process Design is looking for an innovative, solutions-oriented Process Design Engineer to help build the operational processes and standards behind Amazon's next-generation, sub-30-minute delivery network. Do you want a high level of ownership in solving complex, undefined problems? Does the challenge of designing processes and small-format, temperature-controlled fulfillment sites, from the ground up, with no legacy playbook, appeal to you? If so, we have the job for you!

We're looking to add high-impact engineers to our team. In this role, you'll collaborate with internal teams, operations, and external vendors to define, standardize, and document the processes that QC sites run on, and translate them into clean, design-ready inputs for building-design teams. Your work will span a variety of site concepts and template-based design solutions across ambient, chilled, and frozen operations. You'll work alongside a highly skilled, highly engaged team in a fast-paced and often ambiguous greenfield environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop Process & Material Handling design solutions for QC sites such as process design, material flow, equipment specification, and site layout by supporting modern operations running 24/7.

• Define, standardize, and document operational processes into repeatable modules and design-ready inputs (requirements, volumes/rates, adjacencies, constraints) that building-design teams consume.

• Collaborate with internal teams, external vendors, and stakeholders, including Operations, WHS, and Ergonomics, to produce high-quality, cost-effective solutions on tight timelines.

• Manage multiple projects and tasks concurrently, communicating and coordinating effectively with internal partners, contractors, and vendors.

• Apply data-driven analysis (throughput, rate, capacity, utilization) to evaluate design options and support decisions with clear cost, efficiency, and scalability tradeoffs.

• Partner with Operations to identify pain points, discover problems, and surface improvement opportunities across the value chain.

• Communicate technical solutions and recommendations clearly to partners and leadership.

• Up to 50% travel requirement to visit sites and support projects.

A day in the life
You start your morning with a briefing from your AI assistant, a snapshot pulled from the information sources you've built, surfacing the latest from operations, your ongoing projects, and progress against long-term goals. With priorities clear, you move into deep work: producing high-quality process packages, such as SOPs, policy documents, flow diagrams, and value stream maps, that become the standard sites run on.

Mid-morning, you partner with the tech team to reconcile your time-study and ergonomics findings against real-world data through a dashboard you're building with actual cycle times, error rates, process yield, and DPMO. From there, you shift to a site working on new equipment designed to improve ergonomics and eliminate safety incidents. In the afternoon, you join operations, supply chain, and WHS to shape the process design behind a new initiative.

You close the day by reviewing an AI-generated summary from your project-management systems for the input for next week's leadership business review and prepare for your business trip to the next site to observe, learn, and get feedback from operations.

You move fluidly between hands-on design, data analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and the standards work that scales across the network.

About the team
The Quick Commerce (QC) Process Design team defines, standardizes, and maintains the operational processes and standards behind Amazon's sub-30-minute delivery network. We own the full lifecycle of a process from diagnosing operational problems, to designing and standardizing the solution, to shaping it into clean, design-ready inputs that building-design teams build from, to maintaining and improving it as the network scales.

Through this ownership, we create standardized, repeatable process and module definitions, spanning ambient, chilled, and frozen operations, that drive efficiency, safety, and speed across the QC network.

Our dedication to standardization and continuous improvement sets the benchmark for how a new, fast-growing quick-commerce business operates by supporting Amazon's commitment to operational excellence and exceptional customer service.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in industrial or manufacturing engineering
- 3+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, and MS Project) at an advanced level

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
- Experience with Six Sigma tools and Lean techniques
- Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
- Experience with retrofits, launches, or automation deployments
