title: Onsite Medical Representative, Workplace Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
El Representante Médico en Sitio (OMR, por sus siglas en inglés) es el profesional de salud responsable de la atención médica de primer contacto en el Centro de Distribución o Estación de Entrega. Su función principal es atender lesiones y malestares de los asociados mediante primeros auxilios, identificar de forma proactiva riesgos ergonómicos y de seguridad en las tareas operativas, y contribuir a la implementación del programa de bienestar del sitio.
#AmazonMexico


Key job responsibilities
• Realizar la clasificación inicial (triaje) de asociados que se presenten con lesiones o malestares, brindar primeros auxilios y, cuando sea necesario, canalizarlos a un proveedor médico externo.
• Documentar y mantener actualizados todos los registros de atención médica proporcionada a los asociados.
• Administrar los botiquines de primeros auxilios: llevar el control de inventario, reabastecer insumos y asegurar que el equipo utilizado esté limpio y en condiciones de uso.
• Capacitar a gerentes y asociados en temas de prevención, primeros auxilios y protocolos de emergencia.
• Elaborar y entregar bitácoras diarias de actividad al equipo de liderazgo del sitio.
• Generar un análisis mensual de todos los incidentes de salud y seguridad ocurridos en el sitio.
• Asistir y participar de forma constante en las reuniones de inicio de turno ("stand-up").
• Rotar turnos según las necesidades operativas del sitio. Este puesto es presencial y no admite trabajo remoto.


A day in the life
Reportarás directamente al Gerente de WHS (Seguridad, Salud y Bienestar en el Trabajo). Serás el representante médico asignado a un sitio específico, donde administrarás la sala de AmCare: atenderás casos de prevención de salud ocupacional y emergencias médicas, gestionarás el inventario y la adquisición de insumos médicos, e inspeccionarás periódicamente el equipo de emergencia (DEA, camillas, botiquines). descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a fast paced technology company and a leader in the world of data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. We are currently expanding our infrastructure management team and are looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level.

The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people in all levels, sponsoring projects and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation. All candidates should be willing to work both independently and managing their teams effectively. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. In addition to strong knowledge in Data Centers, hardware and network repair, candidates will create documentation, innovate solutions, participate in site-level project work, and fix complex problems within the Data Center Space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. title: Enterprise Network Support Specialist, eero
descriptionHtml:
At eero, we pride ourselves on providing every customer an exceptional experience. Our mission is to make technology in homes and businesses just work — through fast, reliable, secure connectivity. Fixing connectivity in the home is, however, just the start. We're working on the building blocks of small business solutions and smart homes by designing our own hardware, enabling it with seamless software, and tying it all together in the cloud.
We are seeking an Enterprise Network Support Specialist to join our growing Enterprise Support team in London. You'll own complex network cases from first contact to resolution, working directly with enterprise customers across corporate, retail, ISP, and managed-service environments. You'll combine deep networking expertise with customer partnership to solve multi-site deployment challenges and shape the future of enterprise support at eero.
This role will be working out of our office in London, United Kingdom, providing an opportunity to work with an amazing team of intelligent, motivated, and supportive colleagues, and be part of a growing global company that offers a range of career opportunities.


Key job responsibilities
As an Enterprise Network Support Specialist, you will:
• Own enterprise customer cases end-to-end, managing triage, troubleshooting, resolution, and documentation whilst serving as the primary point of contact throughout the customer journey.
• Diagnose and resolve complex multi-site eero deployments, applying advanced networking knowledge to environments involving VLANs, routing, switching, 802.1X/RADIUS, captive portals, and WAN architecture.
• Configure and troubleshoot network devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, managed switches, and wireless access points in high-density enterprise environments.
• Collaborate with specialised teams by escalating to Network Support Engineers (NSE) and engineering teams when cases require additional expertise, whilst retaining overall case ownership and accountability.
• Document and share technical solutions from complex cases to build team runbooks, identify trending issues, and communicate insights to product and engineering teams.
• Participate in on-call support for enterprise incidents, including multi-site outages and partner escalations, ensuring timely response and resolution.
• Provide guidance, mentoring, and on-the-job training to help junior team members continuously learn and improve.


A day in the life
As an Enterprise Network Support Specialist, you'll be the primary point of contact for enterprise customer cases, taking ownership from initial triage through final resolution. Your day involves diagnosing complex multi-site eero deployments, working with overlays and spokes, VLANs, 802.1X/RADIUS, captive portals, managed switches, and high-density wireless environments. You'll collaborate with our Network Support Engineers (NSE) and product teams via Slack when cases require specialised depth, whilst maintaining accountability for customer outcomes. You'll document each complex case to build our team's knowledge base, identify trending issues, and inform product improvements. You'll also participate in a shared on-call rotation to support enterprise incidents, including multi-site outages and partner escalations. Occasionally, you may travel within the UK and internationally (less than 15% of the time) to support on-site enterprise deployments or partner escalations.

About the team
We're building eero's Enterprise Support function from the ground up, and you'll be instrumental in establishing how we serve our most complex customers. Our team partners closely with partner success, engineering, and product teams to ensure customer success whilst feeding critical insights back into product development. We serve customers across diverse industries, from retail and corporate environments to ISPs and managed-service providers, each with unique network architectures and business requirements. We're committed to doing the engineering work to find the right answer, not just the fast one, and we value technical depth paired with clear communication. As part of this founding team, you'll help define our support culture, processes, and standards whilst directly influencing how eero evolves to meet enterprise needs.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or experience in network and operating system support
- Experience in managing and troublshooting network, or experience in technical support
- CCNA or equivalent level networking certification, or High school or equivalent diploma
- Experience in Network protocols like DNS/DHCP/TCP, or experience managing full application stacks from the OS up through custom applications and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience recognizing a challenge and working with a variety of teams and data sources to diagnose the problem and recommend solutions
- Experience writing and publishing technical documents or equivalent
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Advanced networking knowledge including VLANs, routing, switching, 802.1X, RADIUS, captive portals, multi-site and multi-WAN architecture, and wireless infrastructure (802.11).

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in French, Spanish, German or Italian
- Experience with programming/scripting (Batch, VB, PowerShell, Java, C#, Chef, Perl, Ruby and/or PHP), or experience with automation and any version control tools and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- CCNP or equivalent advanced networking certification.
- Experience with logging and monitoring platforms such as AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, or similar tools.
- Knowledge of retail point-of-sale network requirements and PCI compliance considerations.
- Experience managing or supporting Managed Service Provider relationships.
- Familiarity with multi-dwelling unit (MDU) or bulk deployments and their associated topology challenges.
- Experience deploying and supporting high-density wireless environments with 100 or more concurrent clients per access point.
- Background supporting a product through early-stage launch or foundational team phases.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for an AI Security Engineer with strong insight and passion for security to ensure our AI applications are designed and built to the highest standards. You bring AI security talent and expertise to a fast-paced environment where you will be relied upon to partner with our talented software development teams in building secure AI applications.

As an AI Security Engineer, you will work with software development teams to ensure the security of AI applications. You will review code for security issues, build frameworks to help developers create more secure software, and adjust designs to improve protection. You will also perform security research, analyze bug reports, conduct risk assessments, develop automation, maintain documentation, and create tools that reduce security risks. Your work drives secure, reliable AI applications for Amazon's customers.
